`launcher/README-linux.md`:

```md
# Ultimate Mortal Kombat 3 PC port on Linux

The release is a launcher, not the game: it builds the game on your machine
from **your own** `.ipa` of *Ultimate Mortal Kombat 3* for iPhone, and then
starts it. Nothing of the game is in the download.

## 1. What you need

- **The .ipa:** *Ultimate Mortal Kombat 3* **version 1.2.59** for iPhone
  (the file is about 300 MB, `UMK3.ipa` or similar), from a copy you own.
  Other versions are refused: the build checks the binary inside it.
- **x86-64 Linux** with a desktop (X11 or Wayland).
- **SDL2 and a graphics driver**, which almost every desktop already has.
  The game ships the SDL2 and OpenGL *headers* it compiles against, so the
  `-devel` / `-dev` packages are **not** needed. If SDL2 itself is missing:

  | Distribution | Command |
  |---|---|
  | Debian, Ubuntu, Mint, Pop!_OS | `sudo apt install libsdl2-2.0-0` |
  | Fedora, Nobara | `sudo dnf install SDL2` |
  | Arch, Manjaro, SteamOS | `sudo pacman -S sdl2` |
  | openSUSE | `sudo zypper install libSDL2-2_0-0` |

  OpenGL is loaded when the game starts (`libGL.so.1`, from Mesa or your
  GPU's driver); with the renderer set to **Vulkan** the game needs
  `libvulkan.so.1` instead (`vulkan-loader` / `libvulkan1`).
- The compiler (Zig) is downloaded by the launcher the first time, into
  `~/.local/share/umk3-launcher/toolchain` (about 60 MB). Nothing is installed
  system-wide.

## 2. Unpack it somewhere you can write to

The game is built **into the launcher's own folder**, and keeps its saves,
settings (`umk3.ini`), logs and mods there. So unpack it in your home, not in
`/opt` or anything owned by root:

```sh
tar -xzf UMK3-PC-<version>-linux-x64.tar.gz -C ~/Games
cd ~/Games/UMK3-PC-<version>-linux
```

## 3. Build and play

**With the launcher's window:**

```sh
./UMK3-Launcher
```

COMPILE YOUR .IPA, pick the file, wait for the five steps, then PLAY.
`./install-shortcut.sh` adds the launcher to your application menu.

**From a terminal (no window, scripts, CI):**

```sh
./build-game.sh ~/Downloads/UMK3.ipa
```

It runs exactly the launcher's build, prints each step, and exits 0 when the
game is ready. Then start the game itself:

```sh
./umk3-game
```

It must be started from its folder or by its full path: it reads `res/`
beside the executable (`res/` is what the build extracts from your `.ipa`).

## 4. Files

| | |
|---|---|
| `UMK3-Launcher` | the launcher (Electron) |
| `build-game.sh` | the build without the window |
| `umk3-game` | the game, once built |
| `res/` | the game's data, extracted from your `.ipa` |
| `umk3.ini` | settings: the launcher's and the in-game menu's (Esc) |
| `logs/` | the build's and the game's logs: attach them to an Issue |
| `mods/` | mods (the launcher's MODS section) |
| `eos.ini` | internet play; see `eos.ini.example` |

## 5. Renderer

GRAPHICS > RENDERER in the launcher, or Esc > GRAPHICS > RENDERER in the
game: **OpenGL** (the default) or **Vulkan**. Changed in the game, it takes
effect at the next start. If Vulkan cannot start, the game draws with
OpenGL and says so in its log.

## 6. Internet play

ONLINE over the internet uses Epic Online Services, 64-bit only. The
release brings the project's `eos.ini` when it has one; to use your own
product, see `eos.ini.example`. Without it ONLINE works on the local network.

## 7. When something fails

Open an Issue with the launcher's output (run it from a terminal) and the
`logs/` folder. A build that stops says at which of the five steps.

```

`launcher/app/README.md`:

```md
# UMK3-Launcher (Electron)

Replaces the old plain-Win32 `launcher.c` with the same settings, build and
Play loop, drawn as an arcade-cabinet shell.  Everything is self-contained in
this folder's sources; Node.js is only needed to build and package it, not to
run it.

## Layout

```
launcher/app/
  main.js            Electron main: window, root detection, IPC (compile/play/config)
  preload.js         contextBridge API (window.umk3.*); renderer has no Node
  lib/ini.js         umk3.ini reader/writer, byte-for-byte the launcher.c format
  lib/root.js        finds the game folder (launcher\build_game.ps1 mark)
  lib/build.js       runs launcher\build_game.ps1, streams log + block progress
  renderer/          the arcade UI (HTML/CSS/JS, no framemarks/jQuery)
  test/              node --test unit tests for the config format
  build/icon.ico     launcher icon
```

## Run in development

```sh
cd launcher/app
npm install
npm start                 # uses the repo root as the game folder
```

The game folder is found by walking up from the working directory and from
the executable until `launcher\build_game.ps1` or `umk3-game.exe` is found;
`UMK3_ROOT` overrides it.  A portable exe extracts to a temp folder, so when
Windows has no recollection of the folder the player is asked once and the
choice is remembered in `%APPDATA%\umk3-launcher\root.json`.

## Tests

```sh
npm test                  # node --test test/*.js
```

The tests pin the `umk3.ini` format that `runtime/game_main.c:read_config`
expects (width/height/fullscreen/widescreen/language/debug_keys,
`key_<name>=<VK>` lines) and the launcher defaults from `launcher.c`.

> The game-side of `widescreen` is a DRAFT: `game_main.c` parses the key and
> `draw_gl.c` keeps the 2D in the centred 3:2 rectangle, but
> `LIMEDS_Set3dMode` is not widened yet, so a rebuilt game with
> `widescreen=1` stretches the 3D. See the top of `docs/PROGRESS.md`.

## Package it

```sh
cd launcher/app
npm run dist              # -> dist/win-unpacked/ (the app, unpacked)
```

`make_release.py <dist/win-unpacked> <out>` puts that folder in the release
as `launcher\bin\` and compiles `launcher/stub/umk3_launcher_stub.c` into the
`UMK3-Launcher.exe` at the top of the game folder. The stub sets `UMK3_ROOT`
and the working folder to the game folder, starts `launcher\bin\UMK3-Launcher.exe`
and exits.

**Why not the single portable .exe any more:** it unpacked ~270 MB to `%TEMP%`
at every start, 9.3 s before the window showed (measured 2026-10-15); unpacked,
the window shows in 0.7 s (about 5 s the very first time, cold). `npm run
portable` still builds the old single file.

One launch blocker to know about:
- `signAndEditExecutable` is off (winCodeSign needs admin rights to unpack);
  the window icon is supplied at runtime by the app itself.

## Updates

`lib/update.js`: the newest GitHub release of the repository (pre-releases
count) against `app.getVersion()`, i.e. `package.json`'s `version` -- **bump
it for every release**, or players are never told. The release needs its
`UMK3-PC-<version>.zip` asset (make_release.py `--zip`). Installing writes
`update\apply.ps1`, started through WMI so it outlives the launcher; it
mirrors decomp, runtime, tools and launcher, keeps umk3.ini and res, reopens
the launcher, and the page then recompiles (`update/installed.json`).

## Design notes (the iOS-style brief, since 2026-10-09)

- Frameless midnight-blue/near-black window with a nebula background, now
  **resizable** (min 560x620) with a maximize/restore titlebar button; the
  layout is flex so it scales to any size.
- iOS-style dark menu: frosted grouped list (`backdrop-filter` blur, 14 px
  radius, hairline separators), the active row tinted iOS-blue with a glowing
  blue dot, caption MENU/OPCIONES etc, system font, footer "UMK3 IOS".
- All panels are frosted cards (no metal rivets); no Xbox button chips (status
  bar only).
- Buttons flip instantly to iOS-blue/gold on hover/focus, `transition: none`.
- Block-style progress bar (24 segments), step titles, streamed build log.
- Short synthesized beeps on hover/select (WebAudio), no audio assets.
- Settings are saved to `umk3.ini` on every change; **PANTALLA ANCHA (16:9)**
  writes `widescreen=1`. The 16:9 resolutions (1280x720 … 3840x2160) sit after
  the native 3:2 ones in the resolution list.

`launcher/app/cli.js`:

```js
/*
 * cli.js -- the game compiled from a .ipa without the launcher's window: the
 * same pipeline as COMPILE YOUR .IPA (lib/build.js), for a terminal, a
 * script or a machine without a desktop (CI).
 *
 *     ./build-game.sh  <your UMK3 1.2.59 .ipa> [--arch x64|x86] [--root DIR]
 *     build-game.cmd   <your .ipa> [--arch x64|x86]
 *
 * Those two run this file with the launcher's own Electron as Node
 * (ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1), so nothing else needs installing; from the
 * repository, `node launcher/app/cli.js <ipa> --root .` works as well.
 *
 * The game goes where the launcher puts it: the folder the launcher runs
 * from (the release's folder), or --root. That folder must be writable. The
 * exit code is the build's: 0 when the game is ready.
 */
const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');
const bld = require('./lib/build');
const ini = require('./lib/ini');

function usage(msg) {
    if (msg)
        console.error(msg);
    console.error('usage: build-game <your UMK3 1.2.59 .ipa> [--arch x64|x86] [--root DIR]');
    process.exit(2);
}

/* the release's folder: where the launcher keeps the game (main.js
 * getWritableExeDir), whatever the current directory is */
function defaultRoot() {
    if (process.env.UMK3_ROOT)
        return path.resolve(process.env.UMK3_ROOT);
    if (process.env.APPIMAGE)
        return path.dirname(process.env.APPIMAGE);
    const exeDir = path.dirname(process.execPath);
    /* Windows: launcher\bin\UMK3-Launcher.exe, the game two folders up */
    if (path.basename(exeDir).toLowerCase() === 'bin' && path.basename(path.dirname(exeDir)).toLowerCase() === 'launcher')
        return path.dirname(path.dirname(exeDir));
    if (/node(\.exe)?$/i.test(process.execPath))
        return process.cwd();
    return exeDir;
}

async function main() {
    const args = process.argv.slice(2);
    let ipa = null, root = null;
    let arch = process.platform === 'win32' ? 'x64' : 'x64';

    for (let i = 0; i < args.length; i++) {
        if (args[i] === '--arch') arch = args[++i];
        else if (args[i] === '--root') root = path.resolve(args[++i] || '.');
        else if (args[i] === '-h' || args[i] === '--help') usage();
        else if (!ipa) ipa = path.resolve(args[i]);
        else usage('one .ipa only');
    }
    if (!ipa) usage();
    if (!fs.existsSync(ipa)) usage('no such file: ' + ipa);
    if (arch !== 'x64' && arch !== 'x86') usage('--arch is x64 or x86');
    if (arch === 'x86' && process.platform !== 'win32') usage('the 32-bit build is Windows only');
    root = root || defaultRoot();
    try {
        fs.accessSync(root, fs.constants.W_OK);
    } catch {
        usage('cannot write to ' + root + ': the game is built there; give a writable folder with --root');
    }

    console.log('UMK3: building into ' + root);
    let last = -1;
    const code = await bld.build(root, ipa, arch, m => {
        if (!m) return;
        if (m.text) console.log(m.text);
        else if (typeof m.pct === 'number' && m.pct !== last) last = m.pct;
    });
    const ok = code === 0 && ini.gameReady(root, arch);
    console.log(ok ? 'UMK3: the game is ready in ' + root : 'UMK3: the build failed (' + code + ')');
    process.exit(ok ? 0 : 1);
}

main().catch(e => {
    console.error(e && e.stack || e);
    process.exit(1);
});

```

`launcher/app/lib/build.js`:

```js
'use strict';

const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');
const { spawn } = require('child_process');
const { ensureToolchain, describeError } = require('./toolchain');
const { extractIpaPipeline } = require('./extract/ipa');
const { compileGame } = require('./compile');

let g_isCancelled = false;

/* Step boundaries as percentages of the build */
const STEPS = [
    { lo: 0,  hi: 18, title: 'Preparing compiler toolchain' },
    { lo: 18, hi: 25, title: 'Reading iOS binary from .ipa' },
    { lo: 25, hi: 42, title: 'Extracting data tables and assets' },
    { lo: 42, hi: 90, title: 'Compiling game sources' },
    { lo: 90, hi: 100, title: 'Linking final executable' },
];

function resolveSourceRoot(root) {
    if (fs.existsSync(path.join(root, 'src', 'runtime'))) {
        return root;
    }
    if (process.resourcesPath && fs.existsSync(path.join(process.resourcesPath, 'src', 'runtime'))) {
        return process.resourcesPath;
    }
    const repoFallback = path.resolve(__dirname, '../../..');
    if (fs.existsSync(path.join(repoFallback, 'src', 'runtime'))) {
        return repoFallback;
    }
    return root;
}

/**
 * Runs the complete build pipeline: toolchain -> extraction -> compilation.
 * Calls onData({ text, pct, step, phase }) per event.
 */
async function build(root, ipa, arch = 'x64', onData = () => {}) {
    g_isCancelled = false;

    const srcRoot = resolveSourceRoot(root);
    const buildDir = path.join(root, 'build');
    fs.mkdirSync(buildDir, { recursive: true });

    try {
        // Step 1: Ensure toolchain
        onData({
            text: '== 1/5 Preparing compiler toolchain...',
            step: 1,
            phase: STEPS[0].title,
            pct: 5,
        });

        const zigExe = await ensureToolchain(p => {
            const pct = Math.round(STEPS[0].lo + (p.pct / 100) * (STEPS[0].hi - STEPS[0].lo));
            onData({
                text: p.phase,
                step: 1,
                phase: p.phase,
                pct,
            });
        });

        if (g_isCancelled) {
            onData({ text: 'Build cancelled by user.', pct: -1 });
            return -1;
        }

        // Step 2 & 3: Extract IPA & Generate Tables & Extract Assets
        onData({
            text: '== 2/5 Inspecting .ipa and extracting assets...',
            step: 2,
            phase: STEPS[1].title,
            pct: 20,
        });

        const isLow32 = arch === 'x64';
        await extractIpaPipeline({
            ipaPath: ipa,
            destDir: root,
            buildDir,
            rootDir: srcRoot,
            isLow32,
            onProgress: p => {
                let mappedPct;
                let step = 3;
                if (p.pct < 40) {
                    step = 2;
                    mappedPct = Math.round(STEPS[1].lo + ((p.pct - 20) / 20) * (STEPS[1].hi - STEPS[1].lo));
                } else {
                    step = 3;
                    mappedPct = Math.round(STEPS[2].lo + ((p.pct - 40) / 60) * (STEPS[2].hi - STEPS[2].lo));
                }

                onData({
                    text: p.phase + (p.file ? ` (${p.file})` : ''),
                    step,
                    phase: p.phase,
                    pct: mappedPct,
                });
            },
        });

        if (g_isCancelled) {
            onData({ text: 'Build cancelled by user.', pct: -1 });
            return -1;
        }

        // Step 4 & 5: Compile & Link
        onData({
            text: '== 4/5 Compiling sources in parallel...',
            step: 4,
            phase: STEPS[3].title,
            pct: 45,
        });

        const targetOs = process.platform === 'win32' ? 'windows' : 'linux';
        await compileGame({
            rootDir: srcRoot,
            buildDir,
            destDir: root,
            targetArch: arch,
            targetOs,
            zigExe,
            onProgress: p => {
                let mappedPct;
                let step = 4;
                if (p.pct < 92) {
                    step = 4;
                    mappedPct = Math.round(STEPS[3].lo + ((p.pct - 42) / 50) * (STEPS[3].hi - STEPS[3].lo));
                } else {
                    step = 5;
                    mappedPct = Math.round(STEPS[4].lo + ((p.pct - 92) / 8) * (STEPS[4].hi - STEPS[4].lo));
                }

                onData({
                    text: p.phase,
                    step,
                    phase: p.phase,
                    pct: mappedPct,
                });
            },
        });

        onData({
            text: 'Build finished successfully! The game is ready.',
            step: 5,
            phase: 'Completed',
            pct: 100,
        });
        return 0;
    } catch (err) {
        onData({
            text: `Build failed: ${err.message || describeError(err)}`,
            pct: -1,
            phase: 'Error',
        });
        return -1;
    }
}

function cancelBuild() {
    g_isCancelled = true;
    return true;
}

function play(root, exeName) {
    const exePath = path.join(root, exeName);
    if (!fs.existsSync(exePath)) {
        return false;
    }

    if (process.platform !== 'win32') {
        try {
            fs.chmodSync(exePath, 0o755);
        } catch (_) {}
    }

    const child = spawn(exePath, [], {
        cwd: root,
        detached: true,
        stdio: 'ignore',
        windowsHide: false,
    });
    child.unref();
    return true;
}

module.exports = {
    build,
    cancelBuild,
    play,
    STEPS,
};
```

`launcher/app/lib/compile.js`:

```js
'use strict';

const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');
const os = require('os');
const { spawn, execSync } = require('child_process');

function getCSourceFiles(dir) {
    if (!fs.existsSync(dir)) return [];
    return fs.readdirSync(dir)
        .filter(f => f.endsWith('.c'))
        .map(f => path.join(dir, f));
}

/* State files that hold the machine's side of the game -- the clock and the
 * sound table, the low heap, the network session: a save state keeps them,
 * a rollback of an online fight does not (src/runtime/savestate.h). */
const NO_ROLLBACK = ['lime_menu', 'lime_platform', 'lime_app', 'wav', 'limeMPGameSpecific'];

/**
 * ONLINE over the internet (src/runtime/mp_eos.c, Port, not in the binary):
 * the Epic Online Services SDK, which is not in the repository. Found through
 * UMK3_EOS_DIR, or a TOOLS/eos folder in the root or any folder above it.
 * Returns that folder, or null: then the game plays on the local network
 * alone.
 */
function findEosDir(rootDir) {
    const has = d => d && fs.existsSync(path.join(d, 'SDK', 'Include', 'eos_sdk.h'));
    if (has(process.env.UMK3_EOS_DIR)) return process.env.UMK3_EOS_DIR;
    let d = path.resolve(rootDir);
    for (;;) {
        // tools/eos too: a package made on Windows merges TOOLS/ into tools/
        for (const t of ['TOOLS', 'tools']) {
            const c = path.join(d, t, 'eos');
            if (has(c)) return c;
        }
        const up = path.dirname(d);
        if (up === d) return null;
        d = up;
    }
}

function isStateFile(srcPath, buildDir) {
    const filename = path.basename(srcPath);
    const normalized = srcPath.replace(/\\/g, '/');
    const normalizedBuild = buildDir.replace(/\\/g, '/');

    if (normalized.includes('/src/decomp/')) return true;
    if (normalized.includes('/src/runtime/lime/')) return true;
    if (normalized.startsWith(normalizedBuild)) return true;

    const stateRuntimeNames = [
        'gamecode_globals.c',
        'gamecode_globals64.c',
        'gamecode_stubs.c',
        'lime_menu.c',
        'lime_platform.c',
        'lime_app.c',
        'wav.c',
        'fight_runtime.c',
    ];

    if (normalized.includes('/src/runtime/') && stateRuntimeNames.includes(filename)) {
        return true;
    }

    return false;
}

/**
 * Compiles a single source file into an object file.
 */
function compileSingleFile(zigExe, args, rspPath) {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        // Write arguments to response file to avoid CLI length limits on Windows
        const rspContent = args.map(a => a.startsWith('-') ? a : `"${a.replace(/\\/g, '/')}"`).join('\n');
        fs.writeFileSync(rspPath, rspContent, 'utf8');

        const child = spawn(zigExe, ['cc', `@${rspPath}`], {
            stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'pipe'],
            windowsHide: true,
        });

        let stderr = '';
        child.stderr.on('data', d => { stderr += d.toString('utf8'); });

        child.on('close', code => {
            if (code === 0) {
                resolve();
            } else {
                reject(new Error(`Error compiling ${path.basename(rspPath, '.rsp')}: ${stderr || 'code ' + code}`));
            }
        });

        child.on('error', reject);
    });
}

/**
 * Runs tasks with a concurrency pool.
 */
async function runWithPool(tasks, concurrency, onItemComplete) {
    let index = 0;
    const running = new Set();
    const results = [];

    async function next() {
        if (index >= tasks.length) return;
        const currentIdx = index++;
        const task = tasks[currentIdx];
        const promise = task().then(
            res => {
                onItemComplete(currentIdx, null);
                return res;
            },
            err => {
                onItemComplete(currentIdx, err);
                throw err;
            }
        );

        running.add(promise);
        promise.finally(() => running.delete(promise));

        if (running.size < concurrency && index < tasks.length) {
            next();
        }

        return promise;
    }

    const initialBatches = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < Math.min(concurrency, tasks.length); i++) {
        initialBatches.push(next());
    }

    while (running.size > 0) {
        await Promise.race(running);
        if (index < tasks.length) {
            next();
        }
    }
}

/**
 * Orchestrates the full native compilation of UMK3.
 */
async function compileGame({
    rootDir = path.resolve(__dirname, '../../..'),
    buildDir,
    destDir,
    targetArch = 'x64',
    targetOs = process.platform === 'win32' ? 'windows' : 'linux',
    zigExe,
    onProgress = () => {},
}) {
    const isWindows = targetOs === 'windows';
    const isLow32 = targetArch === 'x64';
    const objDir = path.join(buildDir, isLow32 ? 'obj64' : 'obj');
    fs.mkdirSync(objDir, { recursive: true });

    // 1. Gather all source files
    const sources = [
        path.join(rootDir, 'src/runtime/game_main.c'),
        path.join(rootDir, 'src/runtime/debug_menu.c'),
        path.join(rootDir, 'src/runtime/settings_menu.c'),
        path.join(rootDir, 'src/runtime/pad_nav.c'),
        path.join(rootDir, 'src/runtime/profiles.c'),
        path.join(rootDir, 'src/runtime/mods.c'),
        path.join(rootDir, 'src/runtime/draw_gl.c'),
        path.join(rootDir, 'src/runtime/gamecode_stubs.c'),
        path.join(rootDir, 'src/runtime/mp_net.c'),
        path.join(rootDir, 'src/runtime/mp_eos.c'),
        path.join(rootDir, 'src/runtime/online_ui.c'),
        path.join(rootDir, 'src/runtime/lime_menu.c'),
        path.join(rootDir, 'src/runtime/lime_platform.c'),
        path.join(rootDir, 'src/runtime/lime_app.c'),
        path.join(rootDir, 'src/runtime/wav.c'),
        path.join(rootDir, 'src/runtime/fight_runtime.c'),
        path.join(rootDir, 'src/runtime/savestate.c'),
        path.join(rootDir, 'src/runtime/rollback_probe.c'),
        path.join(rootDir, 'src/runtime/rollback.c'),
        path.join(rootDir, 'src/runtime/smooth_models.c'),
    ];

    if (isWindows) {
        sources.push(
            path.join(rootDir, 'src/runtime/platform/win32_gl.c'),
            path.join(rootDir, 'src/runtime/platform/win32_audio.c'),
            path.join(rootDir, 'src/runtime/platform/ui_alert.c'),
            path.join(rootDir, 'src/runtime/render/rgl_d3d12.c')
        );
    } else {
        sources.push(
            path.join(rootDir, 'src/runtime/platform/sdl_gl.c'),
            path.join(rootDir, 'src/runtime/platform/sdl_audio.c'),
            path.join(rootDir, 'src/runtime/platform/ui_alert.c')
        );
    }
    /* what draws: every GL call through rgl_front.c, to OpenGL or to the
     * Vulkan / Direct3D 12 fixed-function layer (src/runtime/render) */
    sources.push(
        path.join(rootDir, 'src/runtime/render/rgl_front.c'),
        path.join(rootDir, 'src/runtime/render/rgl_ff.c'),
        path.join(rootDir, 'src/runtime/render/rgl_vk.c')
    );

    /* SMOOTH MODELS: Blender's Weld and Subdivision Surface (GPL), with the
     * stand-in headers of src/thirdparty/blender/shim */
    const blenderDir = path.join(rootDir, 'src/thirdparty/blender');

    // Glob directory sources
    for (const d of ['src/decomp/gamecode', 'src/decomp/lime', 'src/runtime/lime', 'src/decomp/gamecode/logic',
                     'src/thirdparty/blender']) {
        sources.push(...getCSourceFiles(path.join(rootDir, d)));
    }

    // Generated tables
    sources.push(
        path.join(buildDir, 'logic_tables.c'),
        path.join(buildDir, 'level_info.c'),
        path.join(buildDir, 'seq_data.c')
    );

    // Globals (low32 or standard)
    if (isLow32) {
        sources.push(path.join(buildDir, 'gamecode_globals64.c'));
    } else {
        sources.push(path.join(rootDir, 'src/runtime/gamecode_globals.c'));
    }

    // 2. Base flags
    const baseFlags = [
        '-std=gnu11',
        '-w',
        '-O2',
        '-fno-strict-aliasing',
        '-fno-sanitize=undefined',
        '-fwrapv',
        '-DUMK3_HAVE_MK3',
        '-DUMK3_REAL_GL',
        '-DUMK3_SHELL',
        /* the version crash reports and the session log name (game_main.c,
         * port_report_context): this launcher's, which built the game */
        '-DUMK3_VERSION=' + require('../package.json').version,
        '-I', path.join(rootDir, 'src/runtime'),
        '-I', path.join(rootDir, 'src/decomp/lime'),
        '-I', path.join(rootDir, 'src/decomp/gamecode/logic'),
        '-include', path.join(rootDir, 'src/runtime/savestate.h'),
        '-I', path.join(rootDir, 'src/runtime/platform/vulkan-include'),
    ];

    if (isWindows) {
        baseFlags.push(`-target`, isLow32 ? 'x86_64-windows-gnu' : 'x86-windows-gnu', '-fms-extensions');
    } else {
        if (process.platform !== 'linux') {
            baseFlags.push(`-target`, isLow32 ? 'x86_64-linux-gnu' : 'x86-linux-gnu');
        }
        baseFlags.push('-D_GNU_SOURCE=1', '-D_REENTRANT', '-DUMK3_NO_SDL_MIXER=1', '-D_strdup=strdup', '-D_snprintf=snprintf');
        if (fs.existsSync('/usr/include')) {
            baseFlags.push('-I', '/usr/include');
        }
        if (fs.existsSync('/usr/include/SDL2')) {
            baseFlags.push('-I', '/usr/include/SDL2');
        }
        /* The OpenGL and SDL2 headers come with the game too
         * (src/runtime/platform/linux-include): a desktop without the
         * -dev packages has the libraries but not their headers. Searched
         * after the system's own, which win when they are there. */
        const inc = path.join(rootDir, 'src/runtime/platform/linux-include');
        baseFlags.push('-idirafter', inc, '-idirafter', path.join(inc, 'SDL2'));
    }

    // EOS: 64 bits only (the SDK has no 32-bit Windows or Linux library)
    const eosDir = isLow32 ? findEosDir(rootDir) : null;
    const eosLib = isWindows ? 'EOSSDK-Win64-Shipping.dll' : 'libEOSSDK-Linux-Shipping.so';
    if (eosDir && fs.existsSync(path.join(eosDir, 'SDK', 'Bin', eosLib))) {
        baseFlags.push('-DUMK3_EOS', '-I', path.join(eosDir, 'SDK', 'Include'));
    }

    if (isLow32) {
        baseFlags.push(
            '-DUMK3_LOW32',
            '-fms-extensions',
            '-fno-jump-tables'
        );
    }

    const objFiles = [];
    const tasks = [];

    for (let i = 0; i < sources.length; i++) {
        const src = sources[i];
        const baseName = path.basename(src, '.c');
        const objName = `${String(i + 1).padStart(3, '0')}_${baseName}.o`;
        const objPath = path.join(objDir, objName);
        const rspPath = path.join(objDir, `${objName}.rsp`);
        objFiles.push(objPath);

        const fileFlags = [...baseFlags];
        if (isStateFile(src, buildDir)) {
            fileFlags.push('-DUMK3_STATE_FILE');
            if (NO_ROLLBACK.includes(baseName)) {
                fileFlags.push('-DUMK3_NO_ROLLBACK');
            }
        }
        if (baseName === 'text') {
            fileFlags.push('-DUMK3_NO_LONG_REMAP');
        }
        if (path.dirname(src) === blenderDir) {
            fileFlags.push('-I', blenderDir, '-I', path.join(blenderDir, 'shim'));
        }

        const compileArgs = [...fileFlags, '-c', src, '-o', objPath];
        tasks.push(() => compileSingleFile(zigExe, compileArgs, rspPath));
    }

    // Windows icon resource (.rc)
    if (isWindows) {
        const rcPath = path.join(rootDir, 'src/runtime/umk3_game.rc');
        const resObj = path.join(objDir, 'umk3_game.res');
        objFiles.push(resObj);
        tasks.push(async () => {
            execSync(`"${zigExe}" rc -- "${rcPath}" "${resObj}"`, { stdio: 'pipe' });
        });
    }

    const totalTasks = tasks.length;
    let completedCount = 0;
    const concurrency = Math.max(1, os.cpus().length);

    onProgress({
        phase: `Compiling game code (0/${totalTasks})`,
        pct: 42,
        done: 0,
        total: totalTasks,
    });

    await runWithPool(tasks, concurrency, (idx, err) => {
        if (!err) {
            completedCount++;
            const pct = Math.round(42 + (completedCount / totalTasks) * 48);
            const fileName = path.basename(sources[idx] || 'icon');
            onProgress({
                phase: `Compiling [${completedCount}/${totalTasks}] ${fileName}`,
                pct,
                done: completedCount,
                total: totalTasks,
                file: fileName,
            });
        }
    });

    // 3. Linking
    onProgress({ phase: 'Linking final executable...', pct: 92 });
    const exeName = isWindows ? (isLow32 ? 'umk3-game64.exe' : 'umk3-game.exe') : 'umk3-game';
    const outExe = path.join(destDir, exeName);

    const linkArgs = [...objFiles, '-o', outExe];
    if (isWindows) {
        linkArgs.push(
            `-target`, isLow32 ? 'x86_64-windows-gnu' : 'x86-windows-gnu',
            '-Wl,--subsystem,windows',
            '-lopengl32', '-lwinmm', '-lmsacm32', '-lgdi32', '-luser32', '-lkernel32', '-lws2_32'
        );
        if (isLow32) {
            linkArgs.push('-Wl,--image-base,0x400000', '-Wl,--no-dynamicbase');
        }
        // the 32-bit game is already large-address-aware (4 GB on 64-bit
        // Windows): zig's linker sets it and takes no flag for it
    } else {
        if (process.platform !== 'linux') {
            linkArgs.push(`-target`, isLow32 ? 'x86_64-linux-gnu' : 'x86-linux-gnu');
        }
        linkArgs.push('-no-pie');
        /* the 64-bit directories first: on Fedora and its kin /usr/lib
         * holds the 32-bit libraries (libGL.so.1 "incompatible with
         * elf64-x86-64"), the 64-bit ones are in /usr/lib64 */
        const libDirs = ['/usr/lib64', '/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu', '/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu', '/lib64', '/usr/lib'];
        const want = process.platform === 'linux' || isLow32 ? 2 : 1;      /* ELF class: 2 = 64-bit */
        /* a library of the build's own width (a linker script, not ELF, is
         * taken as it is) */
        const fits = p => {
            try {
                const fd = fs.openSync(p, 'r'), h = Buffer.alloc(5);
                fs.readSync(fd, h, 0, 5, 0);
                fs.closeSync(fd);
                return h.readUInt32BE(0) !== 0x7f454c46 || h[4] === want;
            } catch { return false; }
        };
        for (const dir of libDirs) {
            if (fs.existsSync(dir)) {
                linkArgs.push(`-L${dir}`);
            }
        }
        /* libSDL2.so and libGL.so are the -dev packages' names for the
         * libraries; without them, the libraries themselves by their
         * versioned names, which every desktop has */
        const sysLib = (base, sonames) => {
            for (const dir of libDirs)
                if (fits(path.join(dir, `lib${base}.so`)))
                    return path.join(dir, `lib${base}.so`);
            for (const so of sonames)
                for (const dir of libDirs)
                    if (fits(path.join(dir, so)))
                        return path.join(dir, so);
            return `-l${base}`;
        };
        /* no libGL: render/rgl_front.c loads it when OpenGL draws, so a
         * machine without it can still run the game with Vulkan */
        linkArgs.push(sysLib('SDL2', ['libSDL2-2.0.so.0', 'libSDL2-2.0.so']), '-lm', '-ldl');
    }

    const linkRsp = path.join(buildDir, 'link.rsp');
    const linkRspContent = linkArgs.map(a => a.startsWith('-') ? a : `"${a.replace(/\\/g, '/')}"`).join('\n');
    fs.writeFileSync(linkRsp, linkRspContent, 'utf8');

    await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        const linkChild = spawn(zigExe, ['cc', `@${linkRsp}`], {
            stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'pipe'],
            windowsHide: true,
        });

        let linkErr = '';
        linkChild.stderr.on('data', d => { linkErr += d.toString('utf8'); });

        linkChild.on('close', code => {
            if (code === 0) {
                if (isWindows) {
                    try {
                        const buf = fs.readFileSync(outExe);
                        if (buf.length >= 0x40 && buf.readUInt16LE(0) === 0x5A4D) {
                            const peOff = buf.readUInt32LE(0x3C);
                            if (peOff + 96 <= buf.length && buf.readUInt32LE(peOff) === 0x00004550) {
                                if (isLow32) {
                                    const dllCharOff = peOff + 94;
                                    const dllChar = buf.readUInt16LE(dllCharOff);
                                    buf.writeUInt16LE(dllChar & ~(0x0020 | 0x0040), dllCharOff);
                                } else {
                                    const charOff = peOff + 22;
                                    const ch = buf.readUInt16LE(charOff);
                                    buf.writeUInt16LE(ch | 0x0020, charOff);
                                }
                                fs.writeFileSync(outExe, buf);
                            }
                        }
                    } catch (_) {}
                } else {
                    try { fs.chmodSync(outExe, 0o755); } catch (_) {}
                }
                resolve();
            } else {
                reject(new Error(`Link failed: ${linkErr || 'code ' + code}`));
            }
        });

        linkChild.on('error', reject);
    });

    // The EOS library and the product's eos.ini beside the game
    if (baseFlags.includes('-DUMK3_EOS')) {
        fs.copyFileSync(path.join(eosDir, 'SDK', 'Bin', eosLib), path.join(destDir, eosLib));
        const ini = path.join(eosDir, 'eos.ini');
        if (fs.existsSync(ini)) {
            fs.copyFileSync(ini, path.join(destDir, 'eos.ini'));
        } else {
            onProgress({ phase: `EOS: no ${ini}; online on the local network only`, pct: 99 });
        }
    }

    onProgress({ phase: 'Compilation completed', pct: 100 });
    return {
        success: true,
        exePath: outExe,
        exeName,
    };
}

module.exports = {
    compileGame,
    isStateFile,
};

`launcher/app/lib/extract/ipa.js`:

```js
'use strict';

const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');
const { openZip } = require('./zip');
const { loadMachO } = require('./macho');
const { extractLogicTables } = require('./logic_tables');
const { extractLevelInfo } = require('./level_info');
const { extractSeqData } = require('./seq_data');
const { transformLow32Static } = require('./low32_static');

const WANT_UUID = '90d6f56a18e2303f8f2053b02a42742e';
const WANT_VERSION = '1.2.59';

/**
 * Inspects the given IPA file and returns metadata.
 */
function inspectIpa(ipaPath) {
    const zip = openZip(ipaPath);
    try {
        let appPrefix = null;
        let binEntry = null;
        let plistEntry = null;

        for (const name of zip.namelist()) {
            const m = name.match(/^(Payload\/[^/]+\.app\/)/);
            if (m && !appPrefix) {
                appPrefix = m[1];
            }
            if (/^Payload\/[^/]+\.app\/UMK3$/.test(name)) {
                binEntry = name;
            } else if (/^Payload\/[^/]+\.app\/Info\.plist$/.test(name)) {
                plistEntry = name;
            }
        }

        if (!appPrefix || !binEntry) {
            throw new Error(`${path.basename(ipaPath)} does not contain Payload/UMK3.app/UMK3`);
        }

        let version = 'unknown';
        if (plistEntry) {
            try {
                const plXml = zip.read(plistEntry).toString('utf8');
                const mVer = plXml.match(/<key>CFBundle(?:ShortVersionString|Version)<\/key>\s*<string>([^<]+)<\/string>/);
                if (mVer) {
                    version = mVer[1];
                }
            } catch (_) {
                // Plist parsing failure is non-fatal for inspection
            }
        }

        const rawBin = zip.read(binEntry);
        const { m } = loadMachO(rawBin);
        const cryptid = m.encryption ? m.encryption[2] : 0;

        return {
            appPrefix,
            binEntry,
            plistEntry,
            version,
            uuid: m.uuid,
            cryptid,
            arch: m.arch(),
            isEncrypted: cryptid !== 0,
            isCompatible: m.uuid === WANT_UUID && cryptid === 0,
        };
    } finally {
        zip.close();
    }
}

/**
 * Extracts assets and generates C source tables from the IPA.
 *
 * @param {Object} options
 * @param {string} options.ipaPath Path to the .ipa file.
 * @param {string} options.destDir Target root directory for res/ and assets.
 * @param {string} options.buildDir Target directory for generated .c files.
 * @param {string} [options.rootDir] Repository root path.
 * @param {boolean} [options.isLow32] Whether to generate low32 static globals.
 * @param {boolean} [options.allowMismatch] Proceed even if UUID does not match 1.2.59.
 * @param {function} [options.onProgress] Callback for progress updates: { step, total, file, pct, phase }.
 */
async function extractIpaPipeline({
    ipaPath,
    destDir,
    buildDir,
    rootDir = path.resolve(__dirname, '../../../../'),
    isLow32 = true,
    allowMismatch = false,
    onProgress = () => {},
}) {
    if (!fs.existsSync(ipaPath)) {
        throw new Error(`.ipa not found: ${ipaPath}`);
    }

    onProgress({ phase: 'Inspecting .ipa', pct: 20 });
    const zip = openZip(ipaPath);

    try {
        let appPrefix = null;
        let binEntry = null;

        for (const name of zip.namelist()) {
            const m = name.match(/^(Payload\/[^/]+\.app\/)/);
            if (m && !appPrefix) {
                appPrefix = m[1];
            }
            if (/^Payload\/[^/]+\.app\/UMK3$/.test(name)) {
                binEntry = name;
            }
        }

        if (!appPrefix || !binEntry) {
            throw new Error(`${path.basename(ipaPath)} does not contain Payload/UMK3.app/UMK3`);
        }

        onProgress({ phase: 'Verifying iOS binary', pct: 22 });
        const rawBin = zip.read(binEntry);
        const { m } = loadMachO(rawBin);
        const cryptid = m.encryption ? m.encryption[2] : 0;

        if (cryptid !== 0) {
            throw new Error(`The binary is FairPlay encrypted (cryptid=${cryptid}). A decrypted .ipa is required.`);
        }

        if (m.uuid !== WANT_UUID && !allowMismatch) {
            throw new Error(`The binary UUID is ${m.uuid}, but the decompiler requires version 1.2.59 (${WANT_UUID}).`);
        }

        // 1. Generate logic_tables.c
        onProgress({ phase: 'Generating logic_tables.c', pct: 25 });
        const mapPath = path.join(rootDir, 'tools/build/logic_tables.map');
        const outLogicC = path.join(buildDir, 'logic_tables.c');
        extractLogicTables(rawBin, outLogicC, mapPath);

        // 2. Generate level_info.c
        onProgress({ phase: 'Generating level_info.c', pct: 30 });
        const outLevelC = path.join(buildDir, 'level_info.c');
        extractLevelInfo(rawBin, outLevelC, 'UMK3');

        // 3. Generate seq_data.c
        onProgress({ phase: 'Generating seq_data.c', pct: 35 });
        const outSeqC = path.join(buildDir, 'seq_data.c');
        extractSeqData(rawBin, outSeqC, 'UMK3');

        // 4. Generate gamecode_globals64.c if Low32
        if (isLow32) {
            onProgress({ phase: 'Generating gamecode_globals64.c', pct: 38 });
            const globalsH = path.join(rootDir, 'src/runtime/gamecode_globals.h');
            const globalsC = path.join(rootDir, 'src/runtime/gamecode_globals.c');
            const outGlobalsC = path.join(buildDir, 'gamecode_globals64.c');
            transformLow32Static([globalsH], globalsC, outGlobalsC, 'umk3_globals_fixup');
        }

        // 5. Extract assets: res/* and Info.plist
        onProgress({ phase: 'Extracting game assets', pct: 40 });
        const resDir = path.join(destDir, 'res');
        fs.mkdirSync(resDir, { recursive: true });

        const resPrefix = appPrefix + 'res/';
        const entries = zip.namelist();
        const assetEntries = entries.filter(name => {
            if (name.endsWith('/')) return false;
            return name.startsWith(resPrefix) || name === (appPrefix + 'Info.plist');
        });

        const totalAssets = assetEntries.length;
        let extractedCount = 0;

        for (const name of assetEntries) {
            let rel;
            if (name.startsWith(resPrefix)) {
                rel = name.slice(resPrefix.length);
            } else {
                rel = 'Info.plist';
            }

            const outPath = path.join(resDir, ...rel.split('/'));
            fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(outPath), { recursive: true });
            fs.writeFileSync(outPath, zip.read(name));

            extractedCount++;
            if (extractedCount % 100 === 0 || extractedCount === totalAssets) {
                const pct = Math.round(40 + (extractedCount / totalAssets) * 50);
                onProgress({
                    phase: `Extracting assets (${extractedCount}/${totalAssets})`,
                    pct,
                    done: extractedCount,
                    total: totalAssets,
                    file: rel,
                });
            }
        }

        // Copy additional textures if present
        const addSrc = path.join(rootDir, 'launcher/aditional textures');
        if (fs.existsSync(addSrc)) {
            const addDst = path.join(destDir, 'aditional textures');
            fs.cpSync(addSrc, addDst, { recursive: true });
        }

        // Default umk3.ini
        const iniPath = path.join(destDir, 'umk3.ini');
        if (!fs.existsSync(iniPath)) {
            fs.writeFileSync(iniPath, 'width=960\nheight=640\nfullscreen=0\nlanguage=\n', 'ascii');
        }

        onProgress({ phase: 'Extraction completed', pct: 90 });
        return {
            success: true,
            version: WANT_VERSION,
            uuid: m.uuid,
            assetsExtracted: totalAssets,
        };
    } finally {
        zip.close();
    }
}

module.exports = {
    inspectIpa,
    extractIpaPipeline,
    WANT_UUID,
    WANT_VERSION,
};

`launcher/app/lib/extract/level_info.js`:

```js
'use strict';

const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');
const { loadMachO } = require('./macho');

const LEVEL_INFO = '_Level_Info';
const POOL_AFTER = '_CurrentScene';

function hex2(n) {
    return '0x' + n.toString(16).padStart(2, '0');
}
function hex3(n) {
    return '0x' + n.toString(16).padStart(3, '0');
}
function hex8(n) {
    return '0x' + (n >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(8, '0');
}

/**
 * Extracts anonymous level info string pool and relocations.
 * @param {Buffer|string} machoInput
 * @param {string} outPath
 * @param {string} [sourceName]
 */
function extractLevelInfo(machoInput, outPath, sourceName = 'UMK3') {
    const { data, base, m } = loadMachO(machoInput);

    const syms = new Map();
    for (const s of m.symbols()) {
        if ((s.n_type & 0xe0) === 0 && (s.n_type & 0x0e) === 0x0e) {
            if (!syms.has(s.name)) {
                syms.set(s.name, s.n_value);
            }
        }
    }

    if (!syms.has(LEVEL_INFO)) throw new Error(`Symbol ${LEVEL_INFO} not found in binary`);
    if (!syms.has(POOL_AFTER)) throw new Error(`Symbol ${POOL_AFTER} not found in binary`);

    const info = syms.get(LEVEL_INFO);
    const after = syms.get(POOL_AFTER);
    const allValues = Array.from(syms.values());
    const later = allValues.filter(v => v > info).sort((a, b) => a - b);
    const info_size = later[0] - info;
    const pool_lo = after + 4;
    const pool_hi = info;

    if (allValues.some(v => pool_lo <= v && v < pool_hi)) {
        throw new Error('a symbol inside the string pool: the layout changed');
    }

    const sect = m.sectionForAddr(info);
    if (!sect || sect.segname !== '__DATA' || sect.sectname !== '__data') {
        throw new Error(`${LEVEL_INFO} is not in __DATA,__data`);
    }

    function at(addr, n) {
        const s = m.sectionForAddr(addr);
        const o = base + s.offset + addr - s.addr;
        return data.subarray(o, o + n);
    }

    const pool = at(pool_lo, pool_hi - pool_lo);
    const relocs = [];
    for (let off = 0; off <= info_size - 4; off += 4) {
        const w = at(info + off, 4).readUInt32LE(0);
        if (pool_lo <= w && w < pool_hi) {
            relocs.push([off, w - pool_lo]);
        }
    }

    if (relocs.length === 0) {
        throw new Error('no Level_Info word points into the pool');
    }

    const out = [];
    out.push(`/* Generated by tools/level_info.py from ${path.basename(sourceName)} -- game data, do not commit. */`);
    out.push('#include <stdint.h>\n');
    out.push('/* 32-bit, or a 64-bit build that keeps the game below 4 GB (UMK3_LOW32) */');
    out.push('#ifndef UMK3_LOW32');
    out.push('typedef char umk3_level_info_needs_32bit[sizeof(void *) == 4 ? 1 : -1];');
    out.push('#endif\n');
    out.push(`extern char Level_Info[];  /* ${hex8(info)}, ${info_size} bytes */\n`);
    out.push(`/* ${hex8(pool_lo)}..${hex8(pool_hi)}: the anonymous strings after ${POOL_AFTER.slice(1)} */`);
    out.push(`static char pool[${pool.length}] = {`);
    for (let i = 0; i < pool.length; i += 16) {
        const slice = pool.subarray(i, Math.min(i + 16, pool.length));
        const hexes = [];
        for (let b of slice) hexes.push(hex2(b));
        out.push('    ' + hexes.join(', ') + ',');
    }
    out.push('};\n');

    out.push(`static const uint16_t reloc_off[${relocs.length}] = {`);
    for (let i = 0; i < relocs.length; i += 8) {
        const chunk = relocs.slice(i, i + 8);
        out.push('    ' + chunk.map(r => hex3(r[0])).join(', ') + ',');
    }
    out.push('};');

    out.push(`static const uint16_t reloc_pool[${relocs.length}] = {`);
    for (let i = 0; i < relocs.length; i += 8) {
        const chunk = relocs.slice(i, i + 8);
        out.push('    ' + chunk.map(r => hex3(r[1])).join(', ') + ',');
    }
    out.push('};\n');

    out.push('void umk3_relocate_level_info(void)\n{');
    out.push('    unsigned i;\n');
    out.push(`    for (i = 0; i < ${relocs.length}; i++)`);
    out.push('        *(uint32_t *)(Level_Info + reloc_off[i]) =');
    out.push('            (uint32_t)(uintptr_t)(pool + reloc_pool[i]);');
    out.push('}');

    const content = out.join('\n') + '\n';
    if (outPath) {
        fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(outPath), { recursive: true });
        fs.writeFileSync(outPath, content, { encoding: 'utf-8' });
    }
    return { relocsCount: relocs.length, poolSize: pool.length, content };
}

module.exports = { extractLevelInfo };

`launcher/app/lib/extract/logic_tables.js`:

```js
'use strict';

const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');
const { loadMachO, N_STAB, N_TYPE, N_SECT } = require('./macho');

const N_GSYM = 0x20;
const N_FUN = 0x24;
const N_STSYM = 0x26;
const N_SO = 0x64;
const LOGIC_DIR = '/gamecode/logic/';

function hex8(n) {
    return (n >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(8, '0');
}

function bisectRight(arr, x) {
    let lo = 0, hi = arr.length;
    while (lo < hi) {
        const mid = (lo + hi) >>> 1;
        if (x < arr[mid]) hi = mid;
        else lo = mid + 1;
    }
    return lo;
}

function readMap(mapPath) {
    const native = {};
    const alias = {};
    const objects = new Set();
    const forcedInts = [];

    const lines = fs.readFileSync(mapPath, 'utf8').split('\n');
    for (const rawLine of lines) {
        const line = rawLine.split('#')[0].trim().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
        if (line.length === 0) continue;

        if (line[0] === 'native' && line.length === 3) {
            native[line[1]] = line[2];
        } else if (line[0] === 'alias' && line.length === 3) {
            alias[parseInt(line[2], 16)] = line[1];
        } else if (line[0] === 'object' && line.length === 2) {
            objects.add(line[1]);
        } else if (line[0] === 'int' && line.length === 3) {
            forcedInts.push([line[1], parseInt(line[2], 16)]);
        } else if (line[0] === 'number') {
            // Checked by check_logic_tables
        } else {
            throw new Error(`${mapPath}: bad line ${rawLine}`);
        }
    }
    return { native, alias, objects, forcedInts };
}

function cName(binaryName) {
    const n = binaryName.startsWith('_') ? binaryName.slice(1) : binaryName;
    return n.replace(/\./g, '_');
}

/**
 * Extracts fight engine data tables from the binary into C code.
 * @param {Buffer|string} machoInput
 * @param {string} outPath
 * @param {string} mapPath
 * @param {string} [reportPath]
 */
function extractLogicTables(machoInput, outPath, mapPath, reportPath = null) {
    const { native, alias, objects, forcedInts } = readMap(mapPath);
    const { data, base, m } = loadMachO(machoInput);
    const secs = m.sections;
    const syms = m.symbols();

    // 1. Which names belong to gamecode/logic, per STABs
    let cu = null;
    const logicData = new Set();
    const logicFuncs = new Set();
    for (const { name, n_type } of syms) {
        if (n_type === N_SO && name) {
            cu = name;
        } else if (cu && cu.includes(LOGIC_DIR)) {
            if (n_type === N_GSYM || n_type === N_STSYM) {
                logicData.add(name);
            } else if (n_type === N_FUN && name) {
                logicFuncs.add(name.split(':')[0]);
            }
        }
    }

    // 2. Real (non-STAB) symbols with their sections, sorted by addr
    const real = [];
    for (const { name, n_type, n_sect, n_desc, n_value } of syms) {
        if ((n_type & N_STAB) || (n_type & N_TYPE) !== N_SECT) {
            continue;
        }
        real.push({ val: n_value, name, sect: secs[n_sect - 1], desc: n_desc });
    }
    real.sort((a, b) => a.val - b.val);

    function extent(i) {
        const a = real[i].val;
        const s = real[i].sect;
        let end = s.addr + s.size;
        for (let j = i + 1; j < real.length; j++) {
            if (real[j].val > a) {
                if (real[j].sect === s || real[j].val < end) {
                    end = Math.min(end, real[j].val);
                }
                break;
            }
        }
        return end - a;
    }

    const forcedIntMap = new Map();
    for (const [bname, off] of forcedInts) {
        const hit = real.filter(r => r.name === bname).map(r => r.val);
        if (hit.length === 0) {
            throw new Error(`logic_tables.map: int ${bname}: not in binary`);
        }
        forcedIntMap.set(hit[0] + off, `${bname}+0x${off.toString(16)}`);
    }

    const thumbFuncs = new Map();
    for (const { val, name, sect, desc } of real) {
        if (sect.segname === '__TEXT' && sect.sectname === '__text' && (desc & 0x8) && logicFuncs.has(name)) {
            thumbFuncs.set(val, cName(name));
        }
    }

    const allFnNames = Array.from(thumbFuncs.values());
    const fnCounts = new Map();
    for (const fn of allFnNames) {
        fnCounts.set(fn, (fnCounts.get(fn) || 0) + 1);
    }
    const ambiguous = new Set(allFnNames.filter(fn => fnCounts.get(fn) > 1));

    const objs = []; // [addr, size, cname, bname, sect, zerofill]
    const seen = new Set();
    for (let i = 0; i < real.length; i++) {
        const { val: a, name, sect } = real[i];
        if (!logicData.has(name) || seen.has(a)) continue;
        seen.add(a);
        const zerofill = (sect.flags & 0xff) === 0x1 || (sect.flags & 0xff) === 0xc;
        let cname = alias[a] || cName(name);
        if (zerofill && !objects.has(name)) {
            cname = 'umk3_common_' + cname;
        }
        objs.push([a, extent(i), cname, name, sect, zerofill]);
    }

    const emitted = objs.filter(o => !o[5]);
    const common = objs.filter(o => o[5]);

    const ranges = objs.map(o => [o[0], o[0] + o[1], o[2]]);
    for (let i = 0; i < real.length; i++) {
        const { val: a, name } = real[i];
        if (native[name] && !logicData.has(name)) {
            ranges.push([a, a + extent(i), native[name]]);
        }
    }
    ranges.sort((a, b) => a[0] - b[0]);
    const starts = ranges.map(r => r[0]);
    const nativeTargets = new Set(Object.values(native));

    function target(v) {
        if ((v & 1) && thumbFuncs.has(v & ~1)) {
            const fnName = thumbFuncs.get(v & ~1);
            if (ambiguous.has(fnName)) {
                throw new Error(`a table points at 0x${(v & ~1).toString(16)}, one of several functions named ${fnName}`);
            }
            return ['fn', fnName, 0];
        }
        const i = bisectRight(starts, v) - 1;
        if (i >= 0 && ranges[i][0] <= v && v < ranges[i][1]) {
            return ['data', ranges[i][2], v - ranges[i][0]];
        }
        return null;
    }

    function readBytes(a, n) {
        const s = m.sectionForAddr(a);
        const off = base + s.offset + (a - s.addr);
        return data.subarray(off, off + n);
    }

    const out = [];
    const rep = [];
    const fnRefs = new Set();
    const dataDefs = [];
    const fixups = [];
    let nrel = 0;

    for (const [a, size, cname, bname, s] of emitted) {
        const pad = (4 - (size % 4)) % 4;
        const rawBuf = readBytes(a, size);
        const totalWords = (size + pad) / 4;
        const words = [];
        for (let w = 0; w < totalWords; w++) {
            let val = 0;
            for (let b = 0; b < 4; b++) {
                const idx = w * 4 + b;
                const byte = idx < size ? rawBuf[idx] : 0;
                val |= (byte << (b * 8)) >>> 0;
            }
            words.push(val >>> 0);
        }

        const items = [];
        let orel = 0;
        for (let k = 0; k < words.length; k++) {
            const v = words[k];
            let t = target(v);
            const addrAtWord = a + k * 4;

            if (forcedIntMap.has(addrAtWord)) {
                if (t === null) {
                    throw new Error(`logic_tables.map: int ${forcedIntMap.get(addrAtWord)} is not a relocation candidate; drop the entry`);
                }
                const label = forcedIntMap.get(addrAtWord);
                forcedIntMap.delete(addrAtWord);
                if (reportPath) {
                    rep.push(`int!  ${cname.padEnd(28)} +0x${(k * 4).toString(16).padStart(4, '0')} ${hex8(v)}  (map: a number, not ${t[1]}+0x${t[2].toString(16)})`);
                }
                t = null;
                items.push(`0x${v.toString(16)}`);
                continue;
            }

            if (t === null) {
                items.push(`0x${v.toString(16)}`);
                continue;
            }

            const [kind, tname, off] = t;
            nrel++;
            orel++;
            if (kind === 'fn') {
                fnRefs.add(tname);
            }
            items.push(`UMK3_REL(${tname}, 0x${off.toString(16)})`);
            fixups.push([cname, k, tname, off]);
            if (reportPath) {
                rep.push(`${kind.padEnd(5)} ${cname.padEnd(28)} +0x${(k * 4).toString(16).padStart(4, '0')} ${hex8(v)} -> ${tname}${off ? '+0x' + off.toString(16) : ''}`);
            }
        }

        const exact = a % 4 === 0 && size % 4 === 0;
        if (!exact && orel > 0) {
            throw new Error(`${bname} at 0x${a.toString(16)} is not word-aligned and holds ${orel} relocation(s)`);
        }
        dataDefs.push([cname, bname, a, s, items, size, exact ? null : rawBuf]);
    }

    if (forcedIntMap.size > 0) {
        throw new Error(`logic_tables.map: int ${Array.from(forcedIntMap.values()).sort().join(', ')} is in no emitted object`);
    }

    out.push('/* GENERATED by tools/logic_tables.py -- do not edit, do not commit.');
    out.push(' *');
    out.push(" * Every data object of src/gamecode/logic, read out of the user's own");
    out.push(` * binary (uuid ${m.uuid}) at build time.`);
    out.push(` * ${dataDefs.length} objects, ${nrel} relocated words. */`);
    out.push('#include <stdint.h>');
    out.push('/* A word is 32 bits, as on the device. A 64-bit build keeps the game');
    out.push(' * below 4 GB (UMK3_LOW32): its words are uint32_t (runtime/savestate.h');
    out.push(' * makes uintptr_t one there) and the addresses, which C cannot put in');
    out.push(' * a 32-bit initializer, are written by umk3_logic_tables_fixup(). */');
    out.push('#ifdef UMK3_LOW32');
    out.push('#define UMK3_REL(p, o) 0');
    out.push('#else');
    out.push('typedef char umk3_logic_tables_need_32bit_pointers[sizeof(void *) == 4 ? 1 : -1];');
    out.push('#define UMK3_REL(p, o) ((uintptr_t)(p) + (o))');
    out.push('#endif');
    out.push('');
    out.push('/* One section, binary order: see Layout in tools/logic_tables.py. */');
    out.push('#if defined(__APPLE__)');
    out.push('#define UMK3_LOGIC __attribute__((section("__DATA,__umk3logic")))');
    out.push('#elif defined(__wasm__)');
    out.push('#define UMK3_LOGIC  /* no named sections: order is not guaranteed */');
    out.push('#elif defined(_WIN32) && defined(UMK3_STATE_FILE)');
    out.push("/* the game's save states copy this block too (runtime/savestate.h);");
    out.push(' * "$l" merges it into .umkstd in one piece, its order kept */');
    out.push('#define UMK3_LOGIC __attribute__((section(".umkstd$l")))');
    out.push('#else');
    out.push('#define UMK3_LOGIC __attribute__((section(".data.umk3logic")))');
    out.push('#endif');
    out.push('');

    for (const f of Array.from(fnRefs).sort()) {
        out.push(`extern char ${f}[];`);
    }
    for (const t of Array.from(nativeTargets).sort()) {
        out.push(`extern char ${t}[];`);
    }
    for (const [cname, , , , , , raw] of dataDefs) {
        out.push(`extern ${raw ? 'unsigned char' : 'uintptr_t'} ${cname}[];`);
    }
    for (const [a, size, cname] of common) {
        out.push(`extern ${a % 4 === 0 && size % 4 === 0 ? 'uintptr_t' : 'unsigned char'} ${cname}[];`);
    }
    out.push('');

    for (const [cname, bname, a, s, items, size, raw] of dataDefs) {
        out.push(`/* ${bname}  0x${hex8(a)}  ${s.segname},${s.sectname} */`);
        if (raw !== null) {
            const align = (a & 3) ? (a & -a) : 4;
            out.push(`unsigned char ${cname}[${size}] UMK3_LOGIC __attribute__((aligned(${Math.min(align, 4)}))) = {`);
            for (let k = 0; k < raw.length; k += 16) {
                const slice = raw.subarray(k, Math.min(k + 16, raw.length));
                out.push('    ' + Array.from(slice).join(', ') + ',');
            }
        } else {
            out.push(`uintptr_t ${cname}[${items.length}] UMK3_LOGIC __attribute__((aligned(4))) = {`);
            for (let k = 0; k < items.length; k += 6) {
                const slice = items.slice(k, k + 6);
                out.push('    ' + slice.join(', ') + ',');
            }
        }
        out.push('};');
    }
    out.push('');

    out.push('/* Runtime state: zero, owned through the slot pointers. Zero-filled');
    out.push(' * on the device too, but kept in the section so it stays in order. */');
    for (const [a, size, cname, bname] of common) {
        if (a % 4 === 0 && size % 4 === 0) {
            out.push(`uintptr_t ${cname}[${size / 4}] UMK3_LOGIC __attribute__((aligned(4))) = {0};  /* ${bname} 0x${hex8(a)}, ${size} bytes */`);
        } else {
            const align = (a & 3) ? (a & -a) : 4;
            out.push(`unsigned char ${cname}[${size}] UMK3_LOGIC __attribute__((aligned(${Math.min(align, 4)}))) = {0};  /* ${bname} 0x${hex8(a)}, ${size} bytes */`);
        }
    }
    out.push('');

    out.push('void umk3_logic_tables_fixup(void)');
    out.push('{');
    out.push('#ifdef UMK3_LOW32');
    out.push('    static const struct { uint32_t *at; const char *to; } fix[] = {');
    for (const [cname, k, tname, off] of fixups) {
        out.push(`        { (uint32_t *)${cname} + ${k}, (const char *)${tname} + 0x${off.toString(16)} },`);
    }
    out.push('    };');
    out.push('    unsigned i;');
    out.push('');
    out.push('    for (i = 0; i < sizeof fix / sizeof fix[0]; i++)');
    out.push('        *fix[i].at = (uint32_t)(uintptr_t)fix[i].to;');
    out.push('#endif');
    out.push('}');
    out.push('');
    out.push("/* The word tables by name, for a mod's data.ini (runtime/mods.c). */");
    out.push('const struct { const char *name; void *at; unsigned n; } umk3_logic_names[] = {');
    for (const [cname, , , , items, , raw] of dataDefs)
        if (raw === null) out.push(`    { "${cname}", ${cname}, ${items.length} },`);
    out.push('};');
    out.push('const unsigned umk3_logic_nnames = sizeof umk3_logic_names / sizeof umk3_logic_names[0];');

    const content = out.join('\n') + '\n';
    if (outPath) {
        fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(outPath), { recursive: true });
        fs.writeFileSync(outPath, content, { encoding: 'utf-8' });
    }
    if (reportPath) {
        fs.writeFileSync(reportPath, rep.join('\n') + '\n', { encoding: 'utf-8' });
    }
    return { dataDefsCount: dataDefs.length, nrel, fnRefsCount: fnRefs.size, content };
}

module.exports = { extractLogicTables };

`launcher/app/lib/extract/low32_static.js`:

```js
'use strict';

const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');

const TYPEDEF = /typedef\s+struct\s+\w*\s*\{([\s\S]*?)\}\s*(\w+)\s*;/g;
const FIELD = /([A-Za-z_]\w*)\s*(\[[^\]]*\])?\s*;/;
const TABLE = /^((?:static\s+)?)((?:const\s+)?)(\w+)\s+(\w+)\s*(\[[^\]]*\])?\s*=\s*\{/gm;

function stripComments(s) {
    return s.replace(/\/\*[\s\S]*?\*\/|\/\/[^\n]*/g, ' ');
}

function parseStructs(headers) {
    const out = {};
    for (const h of headers) {
        const src = stripComments(fs.readFileSync(h, 'latin1'));
        let m;
        TYPEDEF.lastIndex = 0;
        while ((m = TYPEDEF.exec(src)) !== null) {
            const body = m[1];
            const name = m[2];
            const fields = [];
            for (let decl of body.split(';')) {
                decl = decl.trim();
                if (!decl || decl.includes('(')) continue;
                const f = FIELD.exec(decl + ';');
                if (f) {
                    fields.push([f[1], decl.includes('P32')]);
                }
            }
            if (fields.some(([, p]) => p)) {
                out[name] = fields;
            }
        }
    }
    return out;
}

function splitTop(s) {
    const items = [];
    let depth = 0;
    const cur = [];
    let q = null;
    let i = 0;

    while (i < s.length) {
        const c = s[i];
        if (q) {
            cur.push(c);
            if (c === '\\') {
                cur.push(s[i + 1]);
                i++;
            } else if (c === q) {
                q = null;
            }
        } else if (c === '"' || c === "'") {
            q = c;
            cur.push(c);
        } else if (c === '(' || c === '{' || c === '[') {
            depth++;
            cur.push(c);
        } else if (c === ')' || c === '}' || c === ']') {
            depth--;
            cur.push(c);
        } else if (c === ',' && depth === 0) {
            items.push(cur.join(''));
            cur.length = 0;
        } else {
            cur.push(c);
        }
        i++;
    }
    if (cur.join('').trim()) {
        items.push(cur.join(''));
    }
    return items;
}

function bodyEnd(s, start) {
    let depth = 0;
    let q = null;
    let i = start;

    while (i < s.length) {
        const c = s[i];
        if (q) {
            if (c === '\\') {
                i++;
            } else if (c === q) {
                q = null;
            }
        } else if (c === '"' || c === "'") {
            q = c;
        } else if (c === '/' && s[i + 1] === '*') {
            i = s.indexOf('*/', i) + 1;
        } else if (c === '{') {
            depth++;
        } else if (c === '}') {
            depth--;
            if (depth === 0) return i;
        }
        i++;
    }
    throw new Error('unbalanced braces');
}

function isNull(v) {
    const s = stripComments(v).trim();
    return s === '0' || s === 'NULL' || s === '(void *)0' || s === '';
}

/**
 * Transforms a C source containing static tables with P32 pointers into
 * runtime-initialized tables for 64-bit low32 builds.
 */
function transformLow32Static(headers, srcPath, outPath, fixupName) {
    const types = parseStructs(headers);
    let src = fs.readFileSync(srcPath, 'latin1');
    const out = [];
    const fix = [];
    let pos = 0;

    const names = new Set();
    TABLE.lastIndex = 0;
    let tm;
    while ((tm = TABLE.exec(src)) !== null) {
        if (types[tm[3]]) {
            names.add(tm[4]);
        }
    }

    src = src.replace(/^(\s*extern\s+)const\s+(\w+\s+(\w+)\s*(\[[^\]]*\])?\s*;)/gm, (match, p1, p2, p3) => {
        return names.has(p3) ? p1 + p2 : match;
    });

    TABLE.lastIndex = 0;
    while ((tm = TABLE.exec(src)) !== null) {
        const structType = tm[3];
        if (!types[structType]) continue;

        const fields = types[structType];
        const tableName = tm[4];
        const isArray = Boolean(tm[5]);

        const openAt = tm.index + tm[0].length - 1;
        const closeAt = bodyEnd(src, openAt);
        const body = src.slice(openAt + 1, closeAt);
        const rows = isArray ? splitTop(body) : ['{' + body + '}'];
        const newRows = [];

        for (let r = 0; r < rows.length; r++) {
            const row = rows[r];
            const t = row.trim();
            if (!t.startsWith('{')) {
                newRows.push(row);
                continue;
            }
            const lead = row.slice(0, row.length - row.trimStart().length);
            const inner = t.slice(1, t.lastIndexOf('}'));
            const vals = splitTop(inner);

            for (let f = 0; f < Math.min(fields.length, vals.length); f++) {
                const [fname, p32] = fields[f];
                if (p32 && !isNull(vals[f])) {
                    const target = isArray ? `${tableName}[${r}].${fname}` : `${tableName}.${fname}`;
                    fix.push(`    ${target} = ${stripComments(vals[f]).trim()};`);
                    vals[f] = ' 0';
                }
            }
            newRows.push(lead + '{' + vals.join(',') + '}' + t.slice(t.lastIndexOf('}') + 1));
        }

        out.push(src.slice(pos, tm.index));
        out.push(tm[1] + tm[3] + ' ' + tableName + (tm[5] || '') + ' = {');
        out.push(isArray ? newRows.join(',') : newRows[0].slice(1, -1));
        pos = closeAt;
    }

    out.push(src.slice(pos));
    out.push('\n\n/* Generated by tools/low32_static.py: the 32-bit pointers the tables\n');
    out.push(' * above hold, written at start (clang cannot initialize them). */\n');
    out.push(`void ${fixupName}(void)\n{\n${fix.join('\n')}\n}\n`);

    const result = out.join('');
    if (outPath) {
        fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(outPath), { recursive: true });
        fs.writeFileSync(outPath, result, 'latin1');
    }
    return { fixupsCount: fix.length, content: result };
}

module.exports = { transformLow32Static };

`launcher/app/lib/extract/macho.js`:

```js
'use strict';

const fs = require('fs');

const FAT_MAGIC = 0xCAFEBABE;
const FAT_CIGAM = 0xBEBAFECA;
const MH_MAGIC = 0xFEEDFACE;
const MH_CIGAM = 0xCEFAEDFE;
const MH_MAGIC_64 = 0xFEEDFACF;

const CPU_TYPE_ARM = 12;
const ARM_SUBTYPES = { 6: 'armv6', 9: 'armv7', 11: 'armv7s' };

const LC_REQ_DYLD = 0x80000000;
const LC_SEGMENT = 0x01;
const LC_SYMTAB = 0x02;
const LC_DYSYMTAB = 0x0b;
const LC_LOAD_DYLIB = 0x0c;
const LC_ID_DYLIB = 0x0d;
const LC_LOAD_WEAK_DYLIB = 0x18 | LC_REQ_DYLD;
const LC_UUID = 0x1b;
const LC_ENCRYPTION_INFO = 0x21;
const LC_VERSION_MIN_IPHONEOS = 0x25;
const LC_FUNCTION_STARTS = 0x26;
const LC_MAIN = 0x28 | LC_REQ_DYLD;

// nlist n_type
const N_STAB = 0xe0;
const N_TYPE = 0x0e;
const N_EXT = 0x01;
const N_UNDF = 0x0;
const N_ABS = 0x2;
const N_SECT = 0xe;
const N_PBUD = 0xc;
const N_INDR = 0xa;

class Section {
    constructor(segname, sectname, addr, size, offset, flags, reserved1 = 0, reserved2 = 0) {
        this.segname = segname;
        this.sectname = sectname;
        this.addr = addr;
        this.size = size;
        this.offset = offset;
        this.flags = flags;
        this.reserved1 = reserved1;
        this.reserved2 = reserved2;
    }

    containsAddr(a) {
        return this.addr <= a && a < this.addr + this.size;
    }
}

class MachO {
    /**
     * 32-bit Mach-O parser (little-endian) for armv6/armv7.
     * @param {Buffer} data
     * @param {number} base Offset of the slice inside the fat binary, or 0 if thin.
     */
    constructor(data, base = 0) {
        this.data = data;
        this.base = base;

        const magic = data.readUInt32LE(base);
        if (magic === MH_MAGIC_64) {
            throw new Error('64-bit Mach-O: not supported');
        }
        if (magic !== MH_MAGIC) {
            throw new Error(`Unexpected Mach-O magic: 0x${magic.toString(16)}`);
        }

        this.magic = magic;
        this.cputype = data.readUInt32LE(base + 4);
        this.cpusubtype = data.readUInt32LE(base + 8);
        this.filetype = data.readUInt32LE(base + 12);
        this.ncmds = data.readUInt32LE(base + 16);
        this.sizeofcmds = data.readUInt32LE(base + 20);
        this.flags = data.readUInt32LE(base + 24);

        this.segments = [];     // [{ segname, vmaddr, vmsize, fileoff, filesize }]
        this.sections = [];     // [Section]
        this.dylibs = [];
        this.uuid = null;
        this.encryption = null; // [cryptoff, cryptsize, cryptid]
        this.symtab = null;     // [symoff, nsyms, stroff, strsize]
        this.dysymtab = null;   // [18 uint32s]
        this.function_starts = null; // [dataoff, datasize]
        this.version_min = null;
        this.entry = null;

        this._parseCommands();
    }

    _parseCommands() {
        let off = this.base + 28;
        const d = this.data;
        for (let i = 0; i < this.ncmds; i++) {
            const cmd = d.readUInt32LE(off);
            const cmdsize = d.readUInt32LE(off + 4);
            if (cmdsize === 0) break;
            this._parseOne(cmd, cmdsize, off);
            off += cmdsize;
        }
    }

    _parseOne(cmd, cmdsize, off) {
        const d = this.data;
        if (cmd === LC_SEGMENT) {
            const segname = d.toString('ascii', off + 8, off + 24).replace(/\0+$/, '');
            const vmaddr = d.readUInt32LE(off + 24);
            const vmsize = d.readUInt32LE(off + 28);
            const fileoff = d.readUInt32LE(off + 32);
            const filesize = d.readUInt32LE(off + 36);
            const nsects = d.readUInt32LE(off + 48);

            this.segments.push({ segname, vmaddr, vmsize, fileoff, filesize });

            let so = off + 56;
            for (let i = 0; i < nsects; i++) {
                const sectname = d.toString('ascii', so, so + 16).replace(/\0+$/, '');
                const ssegname = d.toString('ascii', so + 16, so + 32).replace(/\0+$/, '');
                const addr = d.readUInt32LE(so + 32);
                const size = d.readUInt32LE(so + 36);
                const offset = d.readUInt32LE(so + 40);
                const flags = d.readUInt32LE(so + 56);
                const res1 = d.readUInt32LE(so + 60);
                const res2 = d.readUInt32LE(so + 64);

                this.sections.push(new Section(ssegname, sectname, addr, size, offset, flags, res1, res2));
                so += 68;
            }
        } else if (cmd === LC_SYMTAB) {
            this.symtab = [
                d.readUInt32LE(off + 8),
                d.readUInt32LE(off + 12),
                d.readUInt32LE(off + 16),
                d.readUInt32LE(off + 20)
            ];
        } else if (cmd === LC_DYSYMTAB) {
            const vals = [];
            for (let i = 0; i < 18; i++) {
                vals.push(d.readUInt32LE(off + 8 + i * 4));
            }
            this.dysymtab = vals;
        } else if (cmd === LC_LOAD_DYLIB || cmd === LC_LOAD_WEAK_DYLIB || cmd === LC_ID_DYLIB) {
            const nameoff = d.readUInt32LE(off + 8);
            const s = off + nameoff;
            const end = d.indexOf(0, s);
            this.dylibs.push(d.toString('utf8', s, end >= 0 ? end : s + cmdsize));
        } else if (cmd === LC_UUID) {
            this.uuid = d.toString('hex', off + 8, off + 24);
        } else if (cmd === LC_ENCRYPTION_INFO) {
            this.encryption = [
                d.readUInt32LE(off + 8),
                d.readUInt32LE(off + 12),
                d.readUInt32LE(off + 16)
            ];
        } else if (cmd === LC_FUNCTION_STARTS) {
            this.function_starts = [
                d.readUInt32LE(off + 8),
                d.readUInt32LE(off + 12)
            ];
        } else if (cmd === LC_VERSION_MIN_IPHONEOS) {
            this.version_min = [
                d.readUInt32LE(off + 8),
                d.readUInt32LE(off + 12)
            ];
        }
    }

    arch() {
        if (this.cputype === CPU_TYPE_ARM) {
            return ARM_SUBTYPES[this.cpusubtype] || `arm(sub=${this.cpusubtype})`;
        }
        return `cpu=${this.cputype} sub=${this.cpusubtype}`;
    }

    sectionByName(segname, sectname) {
        for (const s of this.sections) {
            if (s.segname === segname && s.sectname === sectname) {
                return s;
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

    sectionForAddr(addr) {
        for (const s of this.sections) {
            if (s.containsAddr(addr)) {
                return s;
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

    symbols() {
        if (!this.symtab) return [];
        const [symoff, nsyms, stroff] = this.symtab;
        const d = this.data;
        const strbase = this.base + stroff;
        const out = [];
        let o = this.base + symoff;

        for (let i = 0; i < nsyms; i++) {
            const n_strx = d.readUInt32LE(o);
            const n_type = d.readUInt8(o + 4);
            const n_sect = d.readUInt8(o + 5);
            const n_desc = d.readInt16LE(o + 6);
            const n_value = d.readUInt32LE(o + 8);
            o += 12;

            let name = '';
            if (n_strx) {
                const s = strbase + n_strx;
                const e = d.indexOf(0, s);
                name = d.toString('utf8', s, e >= 0 ? e : s + 256);
            }
            out.push({ name, n_type, n_sect, n_desc, n_value });
        }
        return out;
    }
}

function fatSlices(data) {
    if (data.length < 8) return [];
    const magic = data.readUInt32BE(0);
    if (magic !== FAT_MAGIC) return [];

    const nfat = data.readUInt32BE(4);
    const out = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < nfat; i++) {
        const off = 8 + i * 20;
        out.push({
            cputype: data.readUInt32BE(off),
            cpusubtype: data.readUInt32BE(off + 4),
            offset: data.readUInt32BE(off + 8),
            size: data.readUInt32BE(off + 12),
            align: data.readUInt32BE(off + 16),
        });
    }
    return out;
}

function loadMachO(bufferOrPath) {
    const data = Buffer.isBuffer(bufferOrPath) ? bufferOrPath : fs.readFileSync(bufferOrPath);
    let base = 0;
    const slices = fatSlices(data);
    if (slices.length > 0) {
        let found = false;
        for (const sl of slices) {
            if (sl.cputype === CPU_TYPE_ARM && sl.cpusubtype === 9) { // armv7
                base = sl.offset;
                found = true;
                break;
            }
        }
        if (!found) {
            throw new Error('No armv7 slice found in fat Mach-O');
        }
    }
    const m = new MachO(data, base);
    if (m.arch() !== 'armv7') {
        throw new Error(`Expected armv7, got ${m.arch()}`);
    }
    return { data, base, m };
}

module.exports = {
    MachO,
    Section,
    fatSlices,
    loadMachO,
    CPU_TYPE_ARM,
    N_STAB,
    N_TYPE,
    N_EXT,
    N_UNDF,
    N_ABS,
    N_SECT,
    N_PBUD,
    N_INDR,
};

`launcher/app/lib/extract/seq_data.js`:

```js
'use strict';

const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');
const { loadMachO } = require('./macho');

const SEQ_LO = 0x000de242; // the lowest address in seq_lookup's table

function hex4(n) {
    return '0x' + n.toString(16).padStart(4, '0');
}
function hex8(n) {
    return '0x' + (n >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(8, '0');
}

/**
 * Extracts special-move playback scripts.
 * @param {Buffer|string} machoInput
 * @param {string} outPath
 * @param {string} [sourceName]
 */
function extractSeqData(machoInput, outPath, sourceName = 'UMK3') {
    const { data, base, m } = loadMachO(machoInput);

    const sect = m.sectionForAddr(SEQ_LO);
    if (!sect || sect.segname !== '__TEXT' || sect.sectname !== '__const') {
        throw new Error(`${hex8(SEQ_LO)} is not in __TEXT,__const: the layout changed`);
    }

    const hi = sect.addr + sect.size;
    const off = base + sect.offset + SEQ_LO - sect.addr;
    let blob = data.subarray(off, off + hi - SEQ_LO);

    const out = [];
    out.push(`/* Generated by tools/seq_data.py from ${path.basename(sourceName)} -- game data, do not commit. */`);
    out.push('#include <stddef.h>\n');
    out.push(`/* ${hex8(SEQ_LO)}..${hex8(hi)}, __TEXT,__const */`);
    out.push(`static const unsigned short seq_words[${Math.floor((blob.length + 1) / 2)}] = {`);

    const paddedLen = blob.length % 2 !== 0 ? blob.length + 1 : blob.length;
    const words = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < paddedLen; i += 2) {
        const b0 = blob[i];
        const b1 = i + 1 < blob.length ? blob[i + 1] : 0;
        words.push(b0 | (b1 << 8));
    }

    for (let i = 0; i < words.length; i += 12) {
        const chunk = words.slice(i, i + 12);
        out.push('    ' + chunk.map(hex4).join(', ') + ',');
    }
    out.push('};\n');

    out.push('const unsigned char *umk3_seq_addr(unsigned long ios_address)\n{');
    out.push(`    if (ios_address < ${hex8(SEQ_LO)}ul || ios_address >= ${hex8(hi)}ul)`);
    out.push('        return NULL;');
    out.push(`    return (const unsigned char *)seq_words + (ios_address - ${hex8(SEQ_LO)}ul);`);
    out.push('}');

    const content = out.join('\n') + '\n';
    if (outPath) {
        fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(outPath), { recursive: true });
        fs.writeFileSync(outPath, content, { encoding: 'utf-8' });
    }
    return { bytesCount: blob.length, content };
}

module.exports = { extractSeqData };
