`launcher/app/lib/extract/zip.js`:

```js
'use strict';

const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');
const zlib = require('zlib');

/**
 * Pure Node.js ZIP reader using standard 'fs' and 'zlib'.
 * Supports uncompressed (store = 0) and Deflate (method = 8).
 */
class ZipArchive {
    constructor(filePath) {
        this.filePath = filePath;
        this.fd = fs.openSync(filePath, 'r');
        this.entries = new Map();
        this._parse();
    }

    _parse() {
        const stat = fs.fstatSync(this.fd);
        const fileSize = stat.size;
        if (fileSize < 22) {
            throw new Error(`Invalid zip file: file size ${fileSize} too small`);
        }

        // Read up to 66KB from end of file to find End of Central Directory (EOCD)
        const readLen = Math.min(fileSize, 65536 + 22);
        const buf = Buffer.alloc(readLen);
        fs.readSync(this.fd, buf, 0, readLen, fileSize - readLen);

        let eocdOffset = -1;
        for (let i = readLen - 22; i >= 0; i--) {
            if (buf.readUInt32LE(i) === 0x06054b50) {
                eocdOffset = i;
                break;
            }
        }

        if (eocdOffset === -1) {
            throw new Error('Could not find End of Central Directory (EOCD) signature');
        }

        const totalEntries = buf.readUInt16LE(eocdOffset + 10);
        const cdSize = buf.readUInt32LE(eocdOffset + 12);
        const cdOffset = buf.readUInt32LE(eocdOffset + 16);

        // Read the Central Directory
        const cdBuf = Buffer.alloc(cdSize);
        fs.readSync(this.fd, cdBuf, 0, cdSize, cdOffset);

        let pos = 0;
        for (let i = 0; i < totalEntries && pos + 46 <= cdSize; i++) {
            const sig = cdBuf.readUInt32LE(pos);
            if (sig !== 0x02014b50) {
                break;
            }

            const compMethod = cdBuf.readUInt16LE(pos + 10);
            const compSize = cdBuf.readUInt32LE(pos + 20);
            const uncompSize = cdBuf.readUInt32LE(pos + 24);
            const nameLen = cdBuf.readUInt16LE(pos + 28);
            const extraLen = cdBuf.readUInt16LE(pos + 30);
            const commentLen = cdBuf.readUInt16LE(pos + 32);
            const localOffset = cdBuf.readUInt32LE(pos + 42);

            const filename = cdBuf.toString('utf8', pos + 46, pos + 46 + nameLen);
            this.entries.set(filename, {
                filename,
                compMethod,
                compSize,
                uncompSize,
                localOffset,
            });

            pos += 46 + nameLen + extraLen + commentLen;
        }
    }

    namelist() {
        return Array.from(this.entries.keys());
    }

    has(filename) {
        return this.entries.has(filename);
    }

    get(filename) {
        return this.entries.get(filename);
    }

    read(filename) {
        const entry = this.entries.get(filename);
        if (!entry) {
            throw new Error(`File not found in archive: ${filename}`);
        }

        // Read local file header to find exact data start
        const headerBuf = Buffer.alloc(30);
        fs.readSync(this.fd, headerBuf, 0, 30, entry.localOffset);
        if (headerBuf.readUInt32LE(0) !== 0x04034b50) {
            throw new Error(`Corrupt local file header for ${filename}`);
        }

        const nameLen = headerBuf.readUInt16LE(26);
        const extraLen = headerBuf.readUInt16LE(28);
        const dataOffset = entry.localOffset + 30 + nameLen + extraLen;

        const rawData = Buffer.alloc(entry.compSize);
        if (entry.compSize > 0) {
            fs.readSync(this.fd, rawData, 0, entry.compSize, dataOffset);
        }

        if (entry.compMethod === 0) {
            // Stored
            return rawData;
        } else if (entry.compMethod === 8) {
            // Deflate
            return zlib.inflateRawSync(rawData);
        } else {
            throw new Error(`Unsupported compression method ${entry.compMethod} for ${filename}`);
        }
    }

    extractFile(filename, destPath) {
        const data = this.read(filename);
        fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(destPath), { recursive: true });
        fs.writeFileSync(destPath, data);
    }

    close() {
        if (this.fd !== null) {
            fs.closeSync(this.fd);
            this.fd = null;
        }
    }
}

function openZip(filePath) {
    return new ZipArchive(filePath);
}

module.exports = {
    ZipArchive,
    openZip,
};
```

```js
/* umk3.ini reader/writer -- byte-for-byte the same format launcher.c wrote
 * and runtime/game_main.c reads:
 *
 *     width=960      height=640      fullscreen=0   borderless=0
 *     hide_controls=1   (no on-screen stick and buttons)
 *     smooth_anims=1    (fighters' animation frames blended, drawing only)
 *     smooth_models=1   (fighters smoothed: Blender's weld + Catmull-Clark, level 1 or 2)
 *     texture_quality=iphone|ipad|max
 *     arch=x86|x64   (the launcher's own: which game it builds and plays,
 *       umk3-game.exe, 32 bits, or umk3-game64.exe, 64 bits)
 *     ui_size=iphone|ipad   (ipad: the game lays out on 960x640, a smaller HUD)
 *     antialiasing=0|2|4|8|16   aspect=3:2|4:3|16:9|21:9 (3:2 the iPhone's, 4:3 the iPad's;
 *       wider: the fight fills it, the menus stay 3:2)
 *     render_width=1920  render_height=1280   (the 3D resolution; absent =
 *       the window's size)
 *     language=ES    ui=EN           ipa=C:\x\UMK3.ipa
 *     debug_keys=1   skip_intro=1   key_up=87 ... key_moves=77   key_special=72
 *     marco=C:\x\picture.png   (the picture behind the bars in fullscreen)
 *     buttons=5|6    key5_p=85 key5_b=79 key5_k=74 key5_r=76
 *       (the layout, and the five-button layout's own keys; its S is
 *        key_special, the six-button layout's keys are key_hp .. key_run)
 *     pad=auto|off|xinput|054c:0ce6   (player one's pad: the first found,
 *       none, an Xbox pad, or one pad by USB vendor:product)
 *     pad_name=DualSense Wireless Controller   (the launcher's own label)

 * and the six buttons and S, p2key5_<p|b|k|r>=, p2pad=, p2pad_name=,
 * p2pad_<action>= and p2pad5_<p|b|k|r>= -- the same as player one's. The
 * keys default to the game's second set: arrows and the numeric keypad. */
const P2_KEY_NAMES = ['up', 'down', 'left', 'right',
    'hp', 'lp', 'block', 'hk', 'lk', 'run', 'special'];
const P2_KEY_DEFAULTS = {
    up: 38, down: 40, left: 37, right: 39,
    hp: 103, lp: 104, block: 105, hk: 100, lk: 101, run: 102, special: 96,
};
const P2_KEY5_DEFAULTS = { p: 103, b: 105, k: 100, r: 102 };

function defaultConfig() {
    const keys = {};
    for (const name of KEY_NAMES)
        keys[name] = typeof KEY_DEFAULTS[name] === 'number'
            ? KEY_DEFAULTS[name] : KEY_DEFAULTS[name].charCodeAt(0);
    const keys5 = {};
    for (const name of KEY5_NAMES)
        keys5[name] = KEY5_DEFAULTS[name].charCodeAt(0);
    return {
        res: 1,                      /* 960x640: the window */
        rres: 0,                     /* the 3D resolution: 0 = the window's, else RES[rres - 1] */
        fullscreen: false,
        borderless: false,           /* fullscreen without a border, at the desktop's mode */
        antialiasing: 0,             /* 0, 2, 4, 8 or 16 samples */
        uiSize: 'iphone',            /* ui_size=: iphone (480x320) or ipad (960x640: HUD at 1.75 of 2) */
        arch: process.platform === 'win32' ? 'x86' : 'x64',
        renderer: 'opengl',          /* renderer=: opengl, vulkan or d3d12 (Windows) */
        textureQuality: 'iphone',    /* texture_quality=: iphone (the _LOW sheets), ipad (full sheets) or max (full sheets, PNG first, mipmaps) */
        aspect: '3:2',               /* aspect=: 3:2, 4:3, 16:9 or 21:9 */
        widescreen: false,           /* native: widen the 3D view, no stretch */
        debug: false,
        skipIntro: false,            /* skip_intro=1: no publisher logos */
        hideControls: false,         /* hide_controls=1: no on-screen stick and buttons */
        smoothAnims: false,          /* smooth_anims=1: blend the fighters' frames (drawing only) */
        smoothModels: 0,             /* smooth_models=: 0 off, 1 or 2 the subdivision level */
        language: 0,                 /* "" = follow Windows */
        ui: 'EN',                    /* the launcher's own language */
        ipa: '',
        marco: '',                   /* fullscreen bars picture, optional */
        buttons: 5,                  /* the layout the game starts with (its factory default, Settings[4] = 5) */
        pad: 'auto',                 /* pad=: auto, off, xinput or vvvv:pppp */
        padName: '',                 /* pad_name=: how the launcher showed it */
        padDbgMenu: 'L3+R3',
        padIcons: 'auto',            /* pad_icons=: auto xbox ps5 ps4 nintendo */
        monitor: 0,                  /* monitor=: 0 automatic, 1..n */
        p2PadIcons: 'auto',          /* p2pad_icons= */         /* pad_dbg_menu=: the pad buttons that open the debug menu */
        keys,
        keys5,
        padKeys: Object.assign({}, PAD_DEFAULTS),
        padKeys5: Object.assign({}, PAD5_DEFAULTS),
        p2Pad: 'auto',               /* p2pad=: player two's pad */
        p2PadName: '',
        p2Keys: Object.assign({}, P2_KEY_DEFAULTS),
        p2Keys5: Object.assign({}, P2_KEY5_DEFAULTS),
        p2PadKeys: Object.assign({}, PAD_DEFAULTS),
        p2PadKeys5: Object.assign({}, PAD5_DEFAULTS),
    };
}

/* Decode latin-* / mixed files the way a C launcher would have written them.
 * umk3.ini from the old launcher is UTF-8 without BOM; sql defaults. */
function readFileText(p) {
    const buf = fs.readFileSync(p);
    const dec = new StringDecoder('utf8');
    return dec.write(buf) + dec.end();
}

function load(p) {
    const cfg = defaultConfig();
    let text;
    try {
        text = readFileText(p);
    } catch (err) {
        if (err.code === 'ENOENT')
            return cfg;              /* missing file, keep defaults */
        throw err;
    }
    let w = 960, h = 640, rw = 0, rh = 0;
    for (const line of text.split(/\r?\n/)) {
        if (!line.includes('='))
            continue;
        const eq = line.indexOf('=');
        const key = line.slice(0, eq);
        let val = line.slice(eq + 1).trim();
        const num = parseInt(val, 10);
        if (key === 'width')        w = Number.isFinite(num) ? num : w;
        else if (key === 'height')  h = Number.isFinite(num) ? num : h;
        else if (key === 'render_width')  rw = Number.isFinite(num) ? num : 0;
        else if (key === 'render_height') rh = Number.isFinite(num) ? num : 0;
        else if (key === 'fullscreen') cfg.fullscreen = num === 1;
        else if (key === 'borderless') cfg.borderless = num === 1;
        else if (key === 'antialiasing') cfg.antialiasing = [2, 4, 8, 16].includes(num) ? num : 0;
        else if (key === 'widescreen') cfg.widescreen = num === 1;
        else if (key === 'aspect') cfg.aspect = ['3:2', '4:3', '16:9', '21:9'].includes(val) ? val : '3:2';
        else if (key === 'debug_keys') cfg.debug = num === 1;
        else if (key === 'skip_intro') cfg.skipIntro = num === 1;
        else if (key === 'hide_controls') cfg.hideControls = num === 1;
        else if (key === 'smooth_anims') cfg.smoothAnims = num === 1;
        else if (key === 'smooth_models') cfg.smoothModels = num >= 1 && num <= 2 ? num : 0;
        else if (key === 'language') {
            const i = LANGS.findIndex(l => l.code.toUpperCase() === val.toUpperCase());
            if (i >= 0)
                cfg.language = i;
        } else if (key === 'ui') {
            cfg.ui = val.toUpperCase() === 'ES' ? 'ES' : 'EN';
        } else if (key === 'ipa') {
            cfg.ipa = val;
        } else if (key === 'marco') {
            cfg.marco = val;
        } else if (key === 'monitor') {
            cfg.monitor = num >= 0 && num < 16 ? num : 0;
        } else if (key === 'pad_icons' || key === 'p2pad_icons') {
            cfg[key === 'pad_icons' ? 'padIcons' : 'p2PadIcons'] =
                PAD_ICONS.includes(val.toLowerCase()) ? val.toLowerCase() : 'auto';
        } else if (key === 'p2pad') {
            cfg.p2Pad = /^(auto|off|xinput|[0-9a-f]{4}:[0-9a-f]{4})$/i.test(val)
                ? val.toLowerCase() : 'auto';
        } else if (key === 'p2pad_name') {
            cfg.p2PadName = val;
        } else if (key.startsWith('p2pad5_') && PAD5_NAMES.includes(key.slice(7))) {
            if (PAD_VALUE.test(val))
                cfg.p2PadKeys5[key.slice(7)] = val.toUpperCase();
        } else if (key.startsWith('p2pad_') && PAD_NAMES.includes(key.slice(6))) {
            if (PAD_VALUE.test(val))
                cfg.p2PadKeys[key.slice(6)] = val.toUpperCase();
        } else if (key.startsWith('p2key5_') && KEY5_NAMES.includes(key.slice(7))) {
            if (num > 0 && num < 256)
                cfg.p2Keys5[key.slice(7)] = num;
        } else if (key.startsWith('p2key_') && P2_KEY_NAMES.includes(key.slice(6))) {
            if (num > 0 && num < 256)
                cfg.p2Keys[key.slice(6)] = num;
        } else if (key === 'pad') {
            cfg.pad = /^(auto|off|xinput|[0-9a-f]{4}:[0-9a-f]{4})$/i.test(val)
                ? val.toLowerCase() : 'auto';
        } else if (key === 'ui_size') {
            cfg.uiSize = /^(iphone|ipad)$/i.test(val) ? val.toLowerCase() : 'iphone';
        } else if (key === 'arch') {
            cfg.arch = /^x64$/i.test(val) ? 'x64' : 'x86';
        } else if (key === 'texture_quality') {
            cfg.textureQuality = /^(iphone|ipad|max)$/i.test(val) ? val.toLowerCase() : 'iphone';
        } else if (key === 'renderer') {
            cfg.renderer = /^(opengl|vulkan|d3d12)$/i.test(val) ? val.toLowerCase() : 'opengl';
        } else if (key === 'pad_dbg_menu') {
            cfg.padDbgMenu = /^([A-Z0-9]+(\+[A-Z0-9]+)*)?$/i.test(val) ? val.toUpperCase() : 'L3+R3';
        } else if (key === 'pad_name') {
            cfg.padName = val;
        } else if (key.startsWith('pad5_') && PAD5_NAMES.includes(key.slice(5))) {
            if (PAD_VALUE.test(val))
                cfg.padKeys5[key.slice(5)] = val.toUpperCase();
        } else if (key.startsWith('pad_') && PAD_NAMES.includes(key.slice(4))) {
            if (PAD_VALUE.test(val))
                cfg.padKeys[key.slice(4)] = val.toUpperCase();
        } else if (key === 'buttons') {
            cfg.buttons = num === 6 ? 6 : 5;
        } else if (key.startsWith('key5_') && KEY5_NAMES.includes(key.slice(5))) {
            if (num > 0 && num < 256)
                cfg.keys5[key.slice(5)] = num;
        } else if (key.startsWith('key_') && KEY_NAMES.includes(key.slice(4))) {
            const vk = Number.isFinite(num) ? num : 0;
            if (vk > 0 && vk < 256)
                cfg.keys[key.slice(4)] = vk;
        }
    }
    cfg.res = RES.findIndex(r => r.w === w && r.h === h);
    if (cfg.res < 0)
        cfg.res = 1;
    cfg.rres = RES.findIndex(r => r.w === rw && r.h === rh) + 1;
    return cfg;
}

function save(p, cfg) {
    if (!cfg)
        cfg = defaultConfig();
    const res = RES[cfg.res] || RES[1];
    const lang = (LANGS[cfg.language] || LANGS[0]).code;
    const lines = [
        'width=' + res.w,
        'height=' + res.h,
        'fullscreen=' + (cfg.fullscreen ? 1 : 0),
        'borderless=' + (cfg.borderless ? 1 : 0),
        'antialiasing=' + ([2, 4, 8, 16].includes(cfg.antialiasing) ? cfg.antialiasing : 0),
        'aspect=' + (cfg.aspect || '3:2'),
        'widescreen=' + (cfg.widescreen ? 1 : 0),
        'language=' + lang,
        'ui=' + (cfg.ui === 'ES' ? 'ES' : 'EN'),
        'ipa=' + cfg.ipa,
        'debug_keys=' + (cfg.debug ? 1 : 0),
        'skip_intro=' + (cfg.skipIntro ? 1 : 0),
        'hide_controls=' + (cfg.hideControls ? 1 : 0),
        'smooth_anims=' + (cfg.smoothAnims ? 1 : 0),
        'smooth_models=' + (cfg.smoothModels === 1 || cfg.smoothModels === 2 ? cfg.smoothModels : 0),
        'buttons=' + (cfg.buttons === 6 ? 6 : 5),
        'pad=' + (cfg.pad || 'auto'),
        'arch=' + (cfg.arch === 'x64' ? 'x64' : 'x86'),
        'texture_quality=' + (cfg.textureQuality || 'iphone'),
        'renderer=' + (cfg.renderer || 'opengl'),
        'ui_size=' + (cfg.uiSize || 'iphone'),
        'pad_dbg_menu=' + (cfg.padDbgMenu === undefined ? 'L3+R3' : cfg.padDbgMenu),
        'pad_icons=' + (cfg.padIcons || 'auto'),
        'monitor=' + (cfg.monitor | 0),
        'p2pad_icons=' + (cfg.p2PadIcons || 'auto'),
    ];
    if (cfg.padName)
        lines.push('pad_name=' + cfg.padName.replace(/[\r\n]/g, ' '));
    if (cfg.rres > 0 && RES[cfg.rres - 1])
        lines.push('render_width=' + RES[cfg.rres - 1].w,
                   'render_height=' + RES[cfg.rres - 1].h);
    if (cfg.marco)
        lines.push('marco=' + cfg.marco);
    for (const name of KEY_NAMES)
        lines.push('key_' + name + '=' + cfg.keys[name]);
    for (const name of KEY5_NAMES)
        lines.push('key5_' + name + '=' + cfg.keys5[name]);
    const pk = cfg.padKeys || {}, pk5 = cfg.padKeys5 || {};
    for (const name of PAD_NAMES)
        lines.push('pad_' + name + '=' + (pk[name] === undefined ? PAD_DEFAULTS[name] : pk[name]));
    for (const name of PAD5_NAMES)
        lines.push('pad5_' + name + '=' + (pk5[name] === undefined ? PAD5_DEFAULTS[name] : pk5[name]));
    lines.push('p2pad=' + (cfg.p2Pad || 'auto'));
    if (cfg.p2PadName)
        lines.push('p2pad_name=' + cfg.p2PadName.replace(/[\r\n]/g, ' '));
    const k2 = cfg.p2Keys || {}, k25 = cfg.p2Keys5 || {};
    for (const name of P2_KEY_NAMES)
        lines.push('p2key_' + name + '=' + (k2[name] || P2_KEY_DEFAULTS[name]));
    for (const name of KEY5_NAMES)
        lines.push('p2key5_' + name + '=' + (k25[name] || P2_KEY5_DEFAULTS[name]));
    const p2k = cfg.p2PadKeys || {}, p2k5 = cfg.p2PadKeys5 || {};
    for (const name of PAD_NAMES)
        lines.push('p2pad_' + name + '=' + (p2k[name] === undefined ? PAD_DEFAULTS[name] : p2k[name]));
    for (const name of PAD5_NAMES)
        lines.push('p2pad5_' + name + '=' + (p2k5[name] === undefined ? PAD5_DEFAULTS[name] : p2k5[name]));
    fs.writeFileSync(p, lines.join('\n') + '\n', 'utf8');
}

/* The game's executable for arch= (x86 or x64) across platforms. */
function gameExe(arch) {
    if (process.platform !== 'win32') {
        return 'umk3-game';
    }
    return arch === 'x64' ? 'umk3-game64.exe' : 'umk3-game.exe';
}

/* When the game was last compiled: the exe's time, or null. */
function gameBuiltAt(root, arch) {
    for (const name of [gameExe(arch), 'umk3-game.exe', 'umk3-game']) {
        try {
            return fs.statSync(path.join(root, name)).mtimeMs;
        } catch (_) {}
    }
    return null;
}

function gameReady(root, arch) {
    const exe = path.join(root, gameExe(arch));
    const plist = path.join(root, 'res', 'Info.plist');
    const hasExe = fs.existsSync(exe)
        || fs.existsSync(path.join(root, 'umk3-game.exe'))
        || fs.existsSync(path.join(root, 'umk3-game'));
    return hasExe && fs.existsSync(plist);
}

module.exports = { RES, LANGS, KEY_NAMES, KEY_DEFAULTS, KEY5_NAMES, KEY5_DEFAULTS,
                   PAD_NAMES, PAD_DEFAULTS, PAD5_NAMES, PAD5_DEFAULTS,
                   P2_KEY_NAMES, P2_KEY_DEFAULTS, P2_KEY5_DEFAULTS, defaultConfig,
                   load, save, gameExe, gameReady, gameBuiltAt };
```

`launcher/app/lib/mods.js`:

```js
/* The MODS section's file side: the mods in <game>/mods/, their order and
 * which are on (mods/mods.ini, which the game reads at start: runtime/mods.c),
 * the game's own files for the viewer (res/, read only), and the exports
 * (<game>/exports/). Nothing here reaches outside the game folder.
 *
 * A mod is a folder; its mod.ini, optional, describes it:
 *
 *     name=HD Kano
 *     author=...
 *     version=1.0
 *     category=textures          textures, audio, music, models, mixed
 *     description=...
 *
 * cover.png (or .jpg; preview.* from before), optional, is its picture in
 * the list, and data.ini the numbers it changes in the fight engine (the
 * CHARACTER EDITOR; runtime/mods.c). Every other file replaces the game file
 * of the same name. */
'use strict';

const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');

const CATEGORIES = ['textures', 'audio', 'music', 'models', 'mixed'];
const KIND_OF = {
    '.png': 'textures', '.pvr': 'textures',
    '.wav': 'audio', '.mp3': 'music',
    '.meshset': 'models', '.skin': 'models', '.bones': 'models', '.skinanim': 'models',
    '.scene': 'models', '.events': 'models', '.lighting': 'models', '.lights': 'models', '.offsets': 'models',
};

const modsDir = root => path.join(root, 'mods');
const resDir = root => path.join(root, 'res');

/* a mod's folder name: no separators, no "..", nothing hidden */
function safeName(name) {
    if (typeof name !== 'string') return null;
    const n = name.trim();
    if (!n || n.length > 100 || /[\\/:*?"<>|]/.test(n) || n.startsWith('.') || n.includes('..')) return null;
    return n;
}

/* a path inside a mod or the exports: "Characters/Kano/KANO_DIFFUSE.png",
 * every part a safe name, at most four deep */
function safePath(rel) {
    if (typeof rel !== 'string') return null;
    const parts = rel.split(/[\\/]+/).filter(Boolean);
    if (!parts.length || parts.length > 4) return null;
    const ok = parts.map(safeName);
    return ok.every(Boolean) ? ok : null;
}

function readIni(file) {
    const out = {};
    let text;
    try { text = fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf8'); } catch { return out; }
    for (const line of text.split(/\r?\n/)) {
        const m = /^\s*([A-Za-z_]+)\s*=\s*(.*?)\s*$/.exec(line);
        if (m) out[m[1].toLowerCase()] = m[2];
    }
    return out;
}

function walk(dir, depth = 0) {
    let out = [];
    if (depth > 8) return out;
    let list;
    try { list = fs.readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true }); } catch { return out; }
    for (const e of list) {
        if (e.name.startsWith('.')) continue;
        const p = path.join(dir, e.name);
        if (e.isDirectory()) out = out.concat(walk(p, depth + 1));
        else out.push(p);
    }
    return out;
}

/* mods.ini: on=/off= lines, highest priority first */
function readOrder(root) {
    const out = [];
    let text = '';
    try { text = fs.readFileSync(path.join(modsDir(root), 'mods.ini'), 'utf8'); } catch { /* none yet */ }
    for (const line of text.split(/\r?\n/)) {
        const m = /^(on|off)=(.+)$/.exec(line.trim());
        if (m && safeName(m[2])) out.push({ folder: m[2].trim(), on: m[1] === 'on' });
    }
    return out;
}

function writeOrder(root, order) {
    fs.mkdirSync(modsDir(root), { recursive: true });
    const lines = ['; The MOD MANAGER\'s list (UMK3 launcher). Highest priority first: when two',
        '; mods have a file of the same name, the higher one wins. on= is used, off= is not.'];
    for (const m of order) if (safeName(m.folder)) lines.push((m.on ? 'on=' : 'off=') + m.folder);
    fs.writeFileSync(path.join(modsDir(root), 'mods.ini'), lines.join('\n') + '\n');
}

/* every game file, relative to res/ with forward slashes, by lower case */
let g_resCache = null;
function resIndex(root) {
    if (g_resCache && g_resCache.root === root) return g_resCache;
    const base = resDir(root);
    const files = walk(base).map(p => path.relative(base, p).split(path.sep).join('/'));
    const byLower = new Map(files.map(f => [path.posix.basename(f).toLowerCase(), f]));
    g_resCache = { root, files, byLower };
    return g_resCache;
}

/* The list, in priority order: the named mods first as mods.ini has them,
 * then any folder it does not name (on, as the game takes them). */
/* a mod's own files at its top: never laid over the game */
const isOwn = rel => /^(mod\.ini|data\.ini|(cover|preview)\.(png|jpe?g))$/i.test(rel);

function list(root) {
    const dir = modsDir(root);
    fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
    const folders = fs.readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true })
        .filter(e => e.isDirectory() && !e.name.startsWith('.')).map(e => e.name);
    const order = readOrder(root).filter(o => folders.includes(o.folder));
    for (const f of folders) if (!order.some(o => o.folder === f)) order.push({ folder: f, on: true });

    const res = resIndex(root);
    const claimed = new Map();              /* file name -> the mod that wins it */
    const mods = order.map(o => {
        const base = path.join(dir, o.folder);
        const info = readIni(path.join(base, 'mod.ini'));
        const files = walk(base).filter(p => {
            const rel = path.relative(base, p);
            return !isOwn(rel);
        });
        const kinds = {};
        let unknown = 0, lost = 0;
        const names = [];
        for (const p of files) {
            const n = path.basename(p).toLowerCase();
            const ext = path.extname(n);
            const kind = KIND_OF[ext] || 'other';
            kinds[kind] = (kinds[kind] || 0) + 1;
            /* the game file it replaces: by name, or a texture by stem */
            let target = res.byLower.get(n);
            if (!target && kind === 'textures') {
                const stem = n.slice(0, -ext.length);
                target = res.byLower.get(stem + '.pvr') || res.byLower.get(stem + '.png') || res.byLower.get(stem + '_low.pvr');
            }
            if (!target) unknown++;
            if (o.on) {
                if (claimed.has(n)) lost++;
                else claimed.set(n, o.folder);
            }
            names.push({ file: path.relative(base, p).split(path.sep).join('/'), replaces: target || null });
        }
        const kindList = Object.keys(kinds).filter(k => k !== 'other');
        const category = CATEGORIES.includes(info.category) ? info.category
            : kindList.length === 1 ? kindList[0] : kindList.length ? 'mixed' : 'mixed';
        let preview = null;
        for (const p of ['cover.png', 'cover.jpg', 'cover.jpeg', 'preview.png', 'preview.jpg']) {
            const f = path.join(base, p);
            if (fs.existsSync(f) && fs.statSync(f).size < 4 << 20) {
                preview = 'data:image/' + (p.endsWith('png') ? 'png' : 'jpeg') + ';base64,' + fs.readFileSync(f).toString('base64');
                break;
            }
        }
        return {
            folder: o.folder, on: o.on,
            name: info.name || o.folder, author: info.author || '', version: info.version || '',
            description: info.description || '', category, kinds,
            files: names, count: files.length, unknown, lost, preview,
        };
    });
    return { dir, mods };
}

function save(root, order) {
    if (!Array.isArray(order)) return false;
    writeOrder(root, order.map(o => ({ folder: String(o.folder), on: !!o.on })));
    return true;
}

function create(root, fields) {
    const name = safeName(fields && fields.name);
    if (!name) return { ok: false, error: 'name' };
    const base = path.join(modsDir(root), name);
    if (fs.existsSync(base)) return { ok: false, error: 'exists' };
    fs.mkdirSync(base, { recursive: true });
    setInfo(root, name, fields);
    /* a new mod goes to the top, on */
    const order = readOrder(root).filter(o => o.folder !== name);
    order.unshift({ folder: name, on: true });
    writeOrder(root, order);
    return { ok: true, folder: name };
}

function setInfo(root, folder, fields) {
    const name = safeName(folder);
    if (!name) return false;
    const file = path.join(modsDir(root), name, 'mod.ini');
    const cur = readIni(file);
    for (const k of ['name', 'author', 'version', 'category', 'description'])
        if (fields && typeof fields[k] === 'string') cur[k] = fields[k].replace(/[\r\n]+/g, ' ').slice(0, 400);
    if (cur.category && !CATEGORIES.includes(cur.category)) delete cur.category;
    const text = Object.entries(cur).map(([k, v]) => k + '=' + v).join('\n') + '\n';
    fs.writeFileSync(file, text);
    return true;
}

/* files the player picked, copied into a mod */
function addFiles(root, folder, paths) {
    const name = safeName(folder);
    if (!name || !Array.isArray(paths)) return 0;
    const base = path.join(modsDir(root), name);
    fs.mkdirSync(base, { recursive: true });
    let n = 0;
    for (const p of paths) {
        try {
            fs.copyFileSync(p, path.join(base, path.basename(p)));
            n++;
        } catch { /* skip */ }
    }
    return n;
}

/* bytes the window made (a texture exported to edit), into a mod, at
 * `file` -- a name, or a path in the mod's folders ("Stages/The Pit III/
 * PIT_FLOOR.png"). The game finds a mod's files by name in any folder
 * (runtime/mods.c), so a copy of the same name elsewhere in the mod is
 * removed: one file a name. */
function putFile(root, folder, file, bytes) {
    const name = safeName(folder), parts = safePath(file);
    if (!name || !parts || !(bytes instanceof Uint8Array)) return false;
    const base = path.join(modsDir(root), name);
    const dest = path.join(base, ...parts);
    const lower = parts[parts.length - 1].toLowerCase();
    for (const p of walk(base))
        if (p !== dest && path.basename(p).toLowerCase() === lower && !isOwn(path.relative(base, p)))
            fs.rmSync(p, { force: true });
    fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(dest), { recursive: true });
    fs.writeFileSync(dest, bytes);
    return true;
}

function modPath(root, folder) {
    const name = folder ? safeName(folder) : '';
    if (folder && !name) return null;
    return path.join(modsDir(root), name || '');
}

/* the picture the player picked, as the mod's cover: PNG bytes, which the
 * window made of it (any format, no wider than 640) */
function setCover(root, folder, png) {
    const name = safeName(folder);
    if (!name || !(png instanceof Uint8Array) || png[0] !== 0x89 || png[1] !== 0x50) return false;
    const base = path.join(modsDir(root), name);
    if (!fs.existsSync(base)) return false;
    for (const old of ['cover.png', 'cover.jpg', 'cover.jpeg', 'preview.png', 'preview.jpg'])
        fs.rmSync(path.join(base, old), { force: true });
    fs.writeFileSync(path.join(base, 'cover.png'), png);
    return true;
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------ data.ini --
 * `table[word] = value` lines, the CHARACTER EDITOR's changes, as a map. */
function dataRead(root, folder) {
    const name = safeName(folder);
    const out = {};
    if (!name) return out;
    let text = '';
    try { text = fs.readFileSync(path.join(modsDir(root), name, 'data.ini'), 'utf8'); } catch { return out; }
    for (const line of text.split(/\r?\n/)) {
        const m = /^\s*([A-Za-z_]\w*)\[(\d+)\]\s*=\s*(0x[0-9a-f]+|-?\d+)/i.exec(line);
        if (m) out[m[1] + '[' + m[2] + ']'] = Number(m[3]) >>> 0;
    }
    return out;
}

function dataWrite(root, folder, entries) {
    const name = safeName(folder);
    if (!name || !entries || typeof entries !== 'object') return false;
    const base = path.join(modsDir(root), name);
    fs.mkdirSync(base, { recursive: true });
    const lines = ['; The CHARACTER EDITOR\'s numbers (UMK3 launcher): table[word] = value,',
        '; applied by the game at start over its fight tables.'];
    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(entries))
        if (/^[A-Za-z_]\w*\[\d+\]$/.test(k) && Number.isFinite(v))
            lines.push(k + ' = 0x' + (v >>> 0).toString(16));
    fs.writeFileSync(path.join(base, 'data.ini'), lines.join('\n') + '\n');
    return true;
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------- game files -- */

/* The mods over res/ for the viewer, as the game lays them: every mod that
 * is on (layer '*') or one mod (its folder), by file name and pictures by
 * stem. */
function modIndex(root, layer) {
    const folders = layer === '*'
        ? list(root).mods.filter(m => m.on).map(m => m.folder)
        : [safeName(layer)].filter(Boolean);
    const byName = new Map(), byStem = new Map();
    for (const folder of folders) {
        const base = path.join(modsDir(root), folder);
        for (const p of walk(base)) {
            if (isOwn(path.relative(base, p))) continue;
            const n = path.basename(p).toLowerCase();
            if (!byName.has(n)) byName.set(n, p);
            if (/\.(png|pvr)$/.test(n) && !byStem.has(n.slice(0, -4))) byStem.set(n.slice(0, -4), p);
        }
    }
    return { byName, byStem };
}

function resFiles(root) {
    g_resCache = null;
    return resIndex(root).files;
}

/* one file of res/, or null; nothing outside it. With a layer, a mod's file
 * of that name comes first (a picture by stem, so a .png stands for a .pvr:
 * the window tells them apart by their bytes). */
let g_layer = null;
function resRead(root, rel, layer) {
    if (typeof rel !== 'string') return null;
    if (layer) {
        if (!g_layer || g_layer.key !== root + '|' + layer || Date.now() - g_layer.at > 3000)
            g_layer = { key: root + '|' + layer, at: Date.now(), ...modIndex(root, layer) };
        const n = path.posix.basename(rel).toLowerCase();
        let hit = g_layer.byName.get(n);
        if (!hit && /\.(png|pvr)$/.test(n)) {
            const stem = n.slice(0, -4);
            /* the smaller copies, as the game finds them (runtime/mods.c
             * mods_find_texture): X_LOW, X_LITE by X; X_LITE2, X_LOW2 by X2 */
            const full = stem.replace(/_(low|lite)$/, '').replace(/_(low|lite)2$/, '2');
            hit = g_layer.byStem.get(stem) || (full !== stem && g_layer.byStem.get(full));
        }
        if (hit) try { return new Uint8Array(fs.readFileSync(hit)); } catch { /* the game's, then */ }
    }
    const base = path.resolve(resDir(root));
    const p = path.resolve(base, rel);
    if (!p.startsWith(base + path.sep)) return null;
    try { return new Uint8Array(fs.readFileSync(p)); } catch { return null; }
}

/* The fight engine's tables as the build extracted them from the player's
 * binary (build/logic_tables.c): every word table by name, each word a
 * number or the name of what it points at ("stk_kano_hikick", "x+0x10"). */
function gameTables(root) {
    let text;
    try { text = fs.readFileSync(path.join(root, 'build', 'logic_tables.c'), 'utf8'); } catch { return null; }
    const tables = {};
    const re = /^uintptr_t (\w+)\[(\d+)\] UMK3_LOGIC[^{]*= \{\r?\n([\s\S]*?)\r?\n\};/gm;
    let m;
    while ((m = re.exec(text))) {
        const body = m[3].replace(/UMK3_REL\((\w+), (0x[0-9a-f]+)\)/g, (_, t, o) => '@' + t + (o === '0x0' ? '' : '+' + o));
        tables[m[1]] = body.split(',').map(t => t.trim()).filter(Boolean)
            .map(t => t[0] === '@' ? t.slice(1) : Number(t));
    }
    return tables;
}

/* --------------------------------------------------------- exports -- */

/* into exports\<sub>, where sub is a folder path: "Characters/Kano/FBX" */
function exportSave(root, sub, files) {
    const parts = safePath(sub);
    if (!parts || !files || typeof files !== 'object') return null;
    const dir = path.join(root, 'exports', ...parts);
    fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
    for (const [f, bytes] of Object.entries(files)) {
        const fname = safeName(f);
        if (fname && bytes instanceof Uint8Array) fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dir, fname), bytes);
    }
    return dir;
}

module.exports = { list, save, create, setInfo, addFiles, putFile, modPath, setCover, dataRead, dataWrite,
    resFiles, resRead, gameTables, exportSave, CATEGORIES };
```

`launcher/app/lib/profiles.js`:

```js
/* profiles.ini -- the player's profile, shared with the game's settings menu
 * (runtime/profiles.c reads and writes the same file). Port, not in the
 * binary: kept for the leaderboards to come.
 *
 *     profile=7KQ2-9XMD-4TPA|MARY|18|3A8EE6|L
 *
 * One profile per installation: the id, the name (anything but "|" and line
 * breaks, up to 24 characters), the icon (a fighter, 0..23, the bio and
 * endings art: res/Textures/<NAME>_VERSUS.PNG), the colour behind it
 * (RRGGBB), the gradient -- L light: the second colour (white unless
 * chosen) into the colour; D dark: the colour into the second (black); C
 * custom: the colour to the second (blood red) -- and the second colour,
 * RRGGBB (absent: L and its default; an older file's lone RRGGBB is C).
 * UTF-8.
 *
 * The id is given once, when the installation first has no profile: 60
 * random bits from the system's cryptographic generator as twelve Crockford
 * base-32 digits, XXXX-XXXX-XXXX -- about a billion billion possible. It is
 * never changed or deleted; RESET puts the name, icon and colour back and
 * keeps it. */
'use strict';

const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');
const crypto = require('crypto');

const ALPHA = '0123456789ABCDEFGHJKMNPQRSTVWXYZ';
const NAME_MAX = 24;
const ICONS = 24;
const DEFAULTS = { name: 'PLAYER', icon: 18, color: '3A8EE6', shade: 'L' };
const SHADE_COLOR2 = { L: 'FFFFFF', D: '000000', C: '6E0B12' };

/* The bio art, in CharacterNames order (Versus_Names, 0x000ffbf4). */
const ICON_FILES = [
    'KANO', 'SONYA', 'JAXX', 'NIGHTWOLF', 'SUBZERO_HUMAN', 'STRYKER', 'SINDEL',
    'SEKTOR', 'CYRAX', 'KUNGLAO', 'KABAL', 'SHEEVA', 'SHANGTSUNG', 'LUIKANG',
    'SMOKE', 'KITANA', 'JADE', 'MILEENA', 'SCORPION', 'REPTILE', 'ERMAC',
    'SUBZERO', 'SMOKE_SECRET', 'NOOBSAIBOT',
].map(n => n + '_VERSUS.PNG');

function newId() {
    let v = crypto.randomBytes(8).readBigUInt64BE(0) >> 4n;   /* 60 bits */
    let s = '';
    for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
        s = ALPHA[Number(v & 31n)] + s;
        v >>= 5n;
    }
    return s.slice(0, 4) + '-' + s.slice(4, 8) + '-' + s.slice(8);
}

function cleanName(n) {
    return Array.from(String(n || '').replace(/[|\r\n\t]/g, ' '))
        .slice(0, NAME_MAX).join('');
}

function cleanColor(c) {
    c = String(c || '').replace('#', '').toUpperCase();
    return /^[0-9A-F]{6}$/.test(c) ? c : DEFAULTS.color;
}

function read(root) {
    let text = '';
    try {
        text = fs.readFileSync(path.join(root, 'profiles.ini'), 'utf8');
    } catch (err) {
        return null;
    }
    for (const raw of text.split(/\r?\n/)) {
        if (!raw.startsWith('profile=')) continue;
        const f = raw.slice(8).split('|');
        if (f.length < 4 || !/^[0-9A-Z]{4}-[0-9A-Z]{4}-[0-9A-Z]{4}$/.test(f[0]))
            continue;
        const icon = Number(f[2]);
        return { id: f[0], name: cleanName(f[1]),
                 icon: icon >= 0 && icon < ICONS ? icon : DEFAULTS.icon,
                 color: cleanColor(f[3]), ...readShade(f[4], f[5]) };
    }
    return null;
}

function readShade(a, b) {
    a = String(a || '').trim().toUpperCase();
    if (/^[0-9A-F]{6}/.test(a))
        return { shade: 'C', color2: a.slice(0, 6) };
    const shade = a === 'D' ? 'D' : a === 'C' ? 'C' : 'L';
    b = String(b || '').trim().toUpperCase();
    return { shade, color2: /^[0-9A-F]{6}$/.test(b) ? b : SHADE_COLOR2[shade] };
}

function save(root, p) {
    const lines = ['; UMK3 player profile: the launcher and the game both edit this;',
                   '; the id belongs to this installation and never changes',
                   'profile=' + [p.id, cleanName(p.name), p.icon | 0, cleanColor(p.color),
                                 SHADE_COLOR2[p.shade] ? p.shade : 'L',
                                 /^[0-9A-F]{6}$/i.test(p.color2 || '') ? p.color2.toUpperCase()
                                     : SHADE_COLOR2[p.shade] || 'FFFFFF'].join('|')];
    fs.writeFileSync(path.join(root, 'profiles.ini'), lines.join('\n') + '\n', 'utf8');
}

/* The profile, made (and its id given) the first time there is none. */
function load(root, defaultName) {
    let p = read(root);
    if (!p) {
        p = { id: newId(), name: defaultName || DEFAULTS.name,
              icon: DEFAULTS.icon, color: DEFAULTS.color, shade: 'L', color2: SHADE_COLOR2.L };
        save(root, p);
    }
    return p;
}

/* Name, icon and colour back to the defaults; the id stays. */
function reset(root, defaultName) {
    const p = load(root, defaultName);
    p.name = defaultName || DEFAULTS.name;
    p.icon = DEFAULTS.icon;
    p.color = DEFAULTS.color;
    p.shade = 'L';
    p.color2 = SHADE_COLOR2.L;
    save(root, p);
    return p;
}

/* Only the editable fields come from the renderer: never the id. */
function update(root, fields) {
    const p = load(root);
    if (fields.name !== undefined) p.name = cleanName(fields.name);
    if (fields.icon !== undefined && fields.icon >= 0 && fields.icon < ICONS) p.icon = fields.icon | 0;
    if (fields.color !== undefined) p.color = cleanColor(fields.color);
    if (fields.shade && SHADE_COLOR2[fields.shade]) {
        p.shade = fields.shade;
        p.color2 = SHADE_COLOR2[p.shade];
    }
    if (fields.color2 && /^#?[0-9A-F]{6}$/i.test(fields.color2))
        p.color2 = fields.color2.replace('#', '').toUpperCase();
    save(root, p);
    return p;
}

/* The icon's art as a data: URL, or null before the game is compiled. */
function iconData(root, i) {
    const f = ICON_FILES[i];
    if (!f) return null;
    try {
        return 'data:image/png;base64,' +
            fs.readFileSync(path.join(root, 'res', 'Textures', f)).toString('base64');
    } catch (err) {
        return null;
    }
}

module.exports = { load, update, reset, newId, cleanName, cleanColor, iconData, ICONS, NAME_MAX };
```

`launcher/app/lib/root.js`:

```js
/* Finds the game folder (the release/repository root) that holds
 * launcher\build_game.ps1, umk3-game.exe, res\ and umk3.ini.
 *
 * The packaged launcher lives in launcher\bin\ and is started by the stub
 * UMK3-Launcher.exe in the game folder, which sets UMK3_ROOT and the working
 * directory to that folder; process.cwd() and the exe's own directory are the
 * fallbacks.
 */
'use strict';

const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');

function looksLikeRoot(dir) {
    return fs.existsSync(path.join(dir, 'src', 'runtime'))
        || fs.existsSync(path.join(dir, 'tools', 'build'))
        || fs.existsSync(path.join(dir, 'umk3-game'))
        || fs.existsSync(path.join(dir, 'umk3-game.exe'))
        || fs.existsSync(path.join(dir, 'res', 'Info.plist'));
}

function walkUp(start) {
    let dir = path.resolve(start);
    for (;;) {
        if (looksLikeRoot(dir))
            return dir;
        const parent = path.dirname(dir);
        if (parent === dir)
            return null;
        dir = parent;
    }
}

function findRoot(candidates) {
    for (const c of candidates) {
        if (!c)
            continue;
        const hit = walkUp(c);
        if (hit)
            return hit;
    }
    return candidates[0] ? path.resolve(candidates[0]) : null;
}

module.exports = { findRoot, looksLikeRoot };
```
