`launcher/app/lib/toolchain.js`:

```js
'use strict';

const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');
const os = require('os');
const https = require('https');
const crypto = require('crypto');
const { spawn, execSync } = require('child_process');
const { openZip } = require('./extract/zip');

const ZIG_VERSION = '0.13.0';

const TOOLCHAINS = {
    'x86_64-linux': {
        url: 'https://ziglang.org/download/0.13.0/zig-linux-x86_64-0.13.0.tar.xz',
        sha256: 'd45312e61ebcc48032b77bc4cf7fd6915c11fa16e4aad116b66c9468211230ea',
        folderName: 'zig-linux-x86_64-0.13.0',
        exeName: 'zig',
        format: 'tar.xz',
    },
    'x86_64-windows': {
        url: 'https://ziglang.org/download/0.13.0/zig-windows-x86_64-0.13.0.zip',
        sha256: 'd859994725ef9402381e557c60bb57497215682e355204d754ee3df75ee3c158',
        folderName: 'zig-windows-x86_64-0.13.0',
        exeName: 'zig.exe',
        format: 'zip',
    },
};

function getToolchainBaseDir() {
    if (process.env.UMK3_TOOLCHAIN_DIR) {
        return process.env.UMK3_TOOLCHAIN_DIR;
    }

    if (process.platform === 'win32') {
        const localAppData = process.env.LOCALAPPDATA || path.join(os.homedir(), 'AppData', 'Local');
        return path.join(localAppData, 'umk3-launcher', 'toolchain');
    }

    const xdgData = process.env.XDG_DATA_HOME || path.join(os.homedir(), '.local', 'share');
    return path.join(xdgData, 'umk3-launcher', 'toolchain');
}

function getPlatformKey() {
    if (process.platform === 'win32') {
        return 'x86_64-windows';
    }
    return 'x86_64-linux';
}

function findExistingZig() {
    // 1. Explicit env var
    if (process.env.ZIG_EXE && fs.existsSync(process.env.ZIG_EXE)) {
        return process.env.ZIG_EXE;
    }

    // 2. Installed in toolchain directory
    const info = TOOLCHAINS[getPlatformKey()];
    if (info) {
        const cachedExe = path.join(getToolchainBaseDir(), info.folderName, info.exeName);
        if (fs.existsSync(cachedExe)) {
            return cachedExe;
        }
    }

    // 3. Local test / scratch path
    const scratchZig = '/tmp/zig-test/zig';
    if (process.platform !== 'win32' && fs.existsSync(scratchZig)) {
        return scratchZig;
    }

    // 4. System PATH
    try {
        const cmd = process.platform === 'win32' ? 'where zig' : 'which zig';
        const sysPath = execSync(cmd, { encoding: 'utf8', stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'ignore'] }).trim().split(/\r?\n/)[0];
        if (sysPath && fs.existsSync(sysPath)) {
            const ver = execSync(`"${sysPath}" version`, { encoding: 'utf8', stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'ignore'] }).trim();
            if (ver.startsWith('0.12.') || ver.startsWith('0.13.')) {
                return sysPath;
            }
        }
    } catch (_) {
        // Not in PATH
    }

    return null;
}

/* Node tries each of the server's addresses (IPv6, then IPv4) for only
 * 250 ms by default and, when every one runs out, fails with an
 * AggregateError whose message is empty: on Linux the build stopped with a
 * bare "Build failed:". Each address gets 5 s here, and a second try uses
 * IPv4 alone. */
const CONNECT = { autoSelectFamily: true, autoSelectFamilyAttemptTimeout: 5000 };
const CONNECT_V4 = { family: 4 };

/* the error's own text, or its parts' when it is an AggregateError */
function describeError(err) {
    if (err && err.message) return err.message;
    const parts = (err && err.errors || []).map(e => e.message || e.code).filter(Boolean);
    return parts.length ? parts.join('; ') : String((err && err.code) || err);
}

async function downloadFile(url, destPath, expectedSha, onProgress = () => {}) {
    try {
        return await downloadOnce(url, destPath, expectedSha, onProgress, CONNECT);
    } catch (err) {
        if (err.httpStatus || err.checksum) throw err;
        onProgress({ phase: `Download failed (${describeError(err)}), retrying over IPv4`, pct: 2 });
        try {
            return await downloadOnce(url, destPath, expectedSha, onProgress, CONNECT_V4);
        } catch (err2) {
            throw new Error(`Could not download Zig ${ZIG_VERSION} from ${url}: ${describeError(err2)}`);
        }
    }
}

function downloadOnce(url, destPath, expectedSha, onProgress, connect) {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(destPath), { recursive: true });
        const fileStream = fs.createWriteStream(destPath);
        const hash = crypto.createHash('sha256');

        const request = (reqUrl) => {
            https.get(reqUrl, connect, res => {
                // Follow redirects (HTTP 301, 302, 307, 308), relative ones too
                if (res.statusCode >= 300 && res.statusCode < 400 && res.headers.location) {
                    res.resume();
                    return request(new URL(res.headers.location, reqUrl).href);
                }

                if (res.statusCode !== 200) {
                    fileStream.close();
                    fs.unlinkSync(destPath);
                    return reject(Object.assign(new Error(`Error downloading toolchain: HTTP ${res.statusCode}`), { httpStatus: res.statusCode }));
                }

                const totalBytes = parseInt(res.headers['content-length'] || '0', 10);
                let downloadedBytes = 0;

                res.on('data', chunk => {
                    downloadedBytes += chunk.length;
                    hash.update(chunk);
                    fileStream.write(chunk);

                    if (totalBytes > 0) {
                        const pct = Math.round((downloadedBytes / totalBytes) * 100);
                        onProgress({
                            phase: `Downloading Zig ${ZIG_VERSION} (${Math.round(downloadedBytes / 1048576)} MB / ${Math.round(totalBytes / 1048576)} MB)`,
                            pct,
                            downloaded: downloadedBytes,
                            total: totalBytes,
                        });
                    }
                });

                res.on('end', () => {
                    fileStream.end(() => {
                        const actualSha = hash.digest('hex');
                        if (expectedSha && actualSha.toLowerCase() !== expectedSha.toLowerCase()) {
                            fs.unlinkSync(destPath);
                            return reject(Object.assign(new Error(`Zig SHA-256 checksum mismatch: expected ${expectedSha}, got ${actualSha}`), { checksum: true }));
                        }
                        resolve(destPath);
                    });
                });

                res.on('error', err => {
                    fileStream.close();
                    try { fs.unlinkSync(destPath); } catch (_) {}
                    reject(err);
                });
            }).on('error', err => {
                fileStream.close();
                try { fs.unlinkSync(destPath); } catch (_) {}
                reject(err);
            });
        };

        request(url);
    });
}

function extractArchive(archivePath, targetDir, format) {
    fs.mkdirSync(targetDir, { recursive: true });

    if (format === 'zip') {
        const zip = openZip(archivePath);
        try {
            for (const name of zip.namelist()) {
                if (name.endsWith('/')) continue;
                const outPath = path.join(targetDir, ...name.split('/'));
                fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(outPath), { recursive: true });
                fs.writeFileSync(outPath, zip.read(name));
            }
        } finally {
            zip.close();
        }
    } else if (format === 'tar.xz') {
        execSync(`tar -xf "${archivePath}" -C "${targetDir}"`, { stdio: 'inherit' });
    } else {
        throw new Error(`Unsupported archive format: ${format}`);
    }
}

/**
 * Ensures a working Zig compiler is available.
 * Returns the absolute path to the zig executable.
 */
async function ensureToolchain(onProgress = () => {}) {
    const existing = findExistingZig();
    if (existing) {
        onProgress({ phase: 'Compiler ready', pct: 10 });
        return existing;
    }

    const platformKey = getPlatformKey();
    const info = TOOLCHAINS[platformKey];
    if (!info) {
        throw new Error(`Platform ${process.platform} (${process.arch}) is not automatically supported.`);
    }

    const baseDir = getToolchainBaseDir();
    const archiveName = path.basename(info.url);
    const archivePath = path.join(baseDir, archiveName);

    onProgress({ phase: `Starting download of Zig ${ZIG_VERSION} compiler`, pct: 2 });
    await downloadFile(info.url, archivePath, info.sha256, onProgress);

    onProgress({ phase: 'Extracting compiler...', pct: 8 });
    extractArchive(archivePath, baseDir, info.format);

    // Delete archive after extraction to save disk space
    try {
        fs.unlinkSync(archivePath);
    } catch (_) {}

    const zigExe = path.join(baseDir, info.folderName, info.exeName);
    if (!fs.existsSync(zigExe)) {
        throw new Error(`Zig executable not found after extraction: ${zigExe}`);
    }

    if (process.platform !== 'win32') {
        fs.chmodSync(zigExe, 0o755);
    }

    onProgress({ phase: 'Compiler installed successfully', pct: 10 });
    return zigExe;
}

module.exports = {
    ensureToolchain,
    describeError,
    downloadFile,
    findExistingZig,
    getToolchainBaseDir,
    ZIG_VERSION,
};

```

`launcher/app/lib/update.js`:

```js
/* Updates from the repository's GitHub releases. Port tooling, nothing of the
 * game: a release zip holds the port's sources and the launcher, never game
 * data, so after an update the game is compiled again from the player's .ipa.
 *
 *   check(current)        the newest release (pre-releases count: every
 *                         release so far is one), its notes, and whether it
 *                         is newer than `current`
 *   download(rel, dir, onProgress)
 *                         the release's zip into <root>/update/, its SHA-256
 *                         checked against the one GitHub states
 *   install(root, zip, rel)
 *                         unpacks it, writes update/apply.ps1 (Linux:
 *                         apply.sh) and starts it: the script waits for this
 *                         launcher to close, copies the new files over the
 *                         folder and starts UMK3-Launcher again, which then
 *                         recompiles
 *
 * Windows takes the release's .zip, Linux its linux .tar.gz -- the archive
 * of its own launcher. Up to 0.1.7 the Linux launcher took the .zip too and
 * could not unpack it ("could not unpack the update").
 *
 * What an update leaves alone: umk3.ini, res\, the compiled umk3-game.exe
 * (rebuilt right after), toolchain\, build-game\ and anything the player put
 * in the folder. decomp\, runtime\, tools\ and launcher\ are mirrored, so a
 * source the new release dropped does not stay behind to be compiled.
 */
'use strict';

const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');
const crypto = require('crypto');
const { spawn, spawnSync } = require('child_process');

const REPO = 'MaryNCRT/Ultimate-Mortal-Kombat-3-iOS-Recomp';
const API = 'https://api.github.com/repos/' + REPO + '/releases?per_page=10';
const MIRROR = ['src', 'decomp', 'runtime', 'tools', 'launcher'];
const LINUX = process.platform === 'linux';

/* this system's archive among a release's files */
const assetFor = assets => (assets || []).find(a => (LINUX
    ? /linux.*\.tar\.gz$/i.test(a.name)
    : /\.zip$/i.test(a.name) && !/linux/i.test(a.name)));

/* "v0.0.10-alpha", "0.0.7b-alpha" -> [[0,''],[0,''],[10,'']] / [..,[7,'b']] */
function parseVersion(v) {
    const core = String(v || '').trim().replace(/^v/i, '').split('-')[0];
    return core.split('.').map(p => {
        const m = p.match(/^(\d+)([a-z]*)$/i);
        return m ? [parseInt(m[1], 10), m[2].toLowerCase()] : [0, ''];
    });
}

/* >0 when a is newer than b */
function compareVersions(a, b) {
    const x = parseVersion(a), y = parseVersion(b);
    for (let i = 0; i < Math.max(x.length, y.length); i++) {
        const p = x[i] || [0, ''], q = y[i] || [0, ''];
        if (p[0] !== q[0]) return p[0] - q[0];
        if (p[1] !== q[1]) return p[1] < q[1] ? -1 : 1;
    }
    return 0;
}

/* The newest published release with an archive for this system, or null. `fetchFn` is Electron's
 * net.fetch (system proxy, redirects) or anything with the same shape. */
async function check(fetchFn, current) {
    const r = await fetchFn(API, { headers: { 'User-Agent': 'UMK3-Launcher', Accept: 'application/vnd.github+json' } });
    if (!r.ok)
        throw new Error('GitHub ' + r.status);
    const list = await r.json();
    for (const rel of list) {
        if (rel.draft)
            continue;
        const zip = assetFor(rel.assets);
        if (!zip)
            continue;
        return {
            tag: rel.tag_name,
            name: rel.name || rel.tag_name,
            notes: rel.body || '',
            date: rel.published_at,
            page: rel.html_url,
            url: zip.browser_download_url,
            file: zip.name,
            size: zip.size,
            sha256: /^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$/i.test(zip.digest || '') ? zip.digest.slice(7).toLowerCase() : '',
            current,
            newer: compareVersions(rel.tag_name, current) > 0,
        };
    }
    return null;
}

/* Streams the zip to dir/<file>; resolves with its path. */
async function download(fetchFn, rel, dir, onProgress) {
    if (!/^[\w.\-]+\.(zip|tar\.gz)$/i.test(rel.file))
        throw new Error('unexpected file name');
    fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
    const out = path.join(dir, rel.file);
    const part = out + '.part';
    const r = await fetchFn(rel.url, { headers: { 'User-Agent': 'UMK3-Launcher' } });
    if (!r.ok || !r.body)
        throw new Error('download: HTTP ' + r.status);
    const total = Number(r.headers.get('content-length')) || rel.size || 0;
    const hash = crypto.createHash('sha256');
    const fd = fs.openSync(part, 'w');
    let got = 0;
    try {
        const reader = r.body.getReader();
        for (;;) {
            const { done, value } = await reader.read();
            if (done) break;
            fs.writeSync(fd, value);
            hash.update(value);
            got += value.length;
            if (onProgress) onProgress(got, total);
        }
    } finally {
        fs.closeSync(fd);
    }
    const sum = hash.digest('hex');
    if (rel.sha256 && sum !== rel.sha256) {
        fs.rmSync(part, { force: true });
        throw new Error('download SHA-256 does not match GitHub digest');
    }
    fs.renameSync(part, out);
    return out;
}

function psq(s) {
    return "'" + String(s).replace(/'/g, "''") + "'";
}

/* Unpacks zip into <root>/update/new and returns the release folder in it. */
function unpack(root, zip) {
    const dest = path.join(root, 'update', 'new');
    fs.rmSync(dest, { recursive: true, force: true });
    fs.mkdirSync(dest, { recursive: true });
    const tar = LINUX ? 'tar' : path.join(process.env.SystemRoot || 'C:\\Windows', 'System32', 'tar.exe');
    let r = LINUX || fs.existsSync(tar) ? spawnSync(tar, ['-xf', zip, '-C', dest], { windowsHide: true }) : { status: 1 };
    if (r.status !== 0 && !LINUX)
        r = spawnSync('powershell.exe', ['-NoProfile', '-Command',
            'Expand-Archive -LiteralPath ' + psq(zip) + ' -DestinationPath ' + psq(dest) + ' -Force'],
            { windowsHide: true });
    if (r.status !== 0)
        throw new Error('could not unpack the update');
    /* the zip holds one folder, UMK3-PC-<version>; up to 0.0.9 the launcher
     * was one portable UMK3-Launcher.exe, since then a stub over launcher\bin */
    const cands = [dest].concat(fs.readdirSync(dest).map(n => path.join(dest, n)));
    /* (Linux: the launcher's own folder, the sources in resources/src) */
    const src = cands.find(d => (fs.existsSync(path.join(d, 'launcher')) || fs.existsSync(path.join(d, 'src'))
                                 || fs.existsSync(path.join(d, 'resources', 'src')))
                             && (fs.existsSync(path.join(d, 'UMK3-Launcher.exe')) || fs.existsSync(path.join(d, 'UMK3-Launcher'))));
    if (!src)
        throw new Error('the update archive structure is unexpected');
    return src;
}

const shq = s => "'" + String(s).replace(/'/g, "'\\''") + "'";

/* Linux: the archive is the launcher's folder itself. Every folder in it is
 * mirrored (resources/ holds the sources, so a dropped one goes), its files
 * copied; what the player's folder has besides -- res/, umk3.ini, build/,
 * mods/, the compiled game -- is not in the archive and stays. */
function installLinux(root, src, zip, upd) {
    const sh = [
        '#!/bin/sh',
        'root=' + shq(root), 'src=' + shq(src), 'log="$root/update/apply.log"',
        'echo "update $(date)" > "$log"',
        'i=0; while kill -0 ' + process.pid + ' 2>/dev/null && [ $i -lt 120 ]; do sleep 0.5; i=$((i+1)); done',
        'fail=0',
        'for d in "$src"/*/; do',
        '  n=$(basename "$d")',
        '  rm -rf "$root/$n.old"; [ -e "$root/$n" ] && mv "$root/$n" "$root/$n.old"',
        '  if cp -a "$d" "$root/$n" >>"$log" 2>&1; then rm -rf "$root/$n.old"',
        '  else fail=1; echo "copy $n failed" >>"$log"; rm -rf "$root/$n"; [ -e "$root/$n.old" ] && mv "$root/$n.old" "$root/$n"; fi',
        'done',
        'for f in "$src"/*; do [ -f "$f" ] && { cp -af "$f" "$root/" >>"$log" 2>&1 || fail=1; }; done',
        'chmod +x "$root/UMK3-Launcher" "$root/chrome_crashpad_handler" 2>/dev/null',
        'if [ $fail -ne 0 ]; then mv "$root/update/pending.json" "$root/update/failed.json"',
        'else mv "$root/update/pending.json" "$root/update/installed.json"; rm -rf "$root/update/new" ' + shq(zip) + '; fi',
        'cd "$root" && nohup "$root/UMK3-Launcher" >/dev/null 2>&1 &',
    ].join('\n') + '\n';
    const script = path.join(upd, 'apply.sh');
    fs.writeFileSync(script, sh, { mode: 0o755 });
    const child = spawn('/bin/sh', [script], { cwd: upd, detached: true, stdio: 'ignore' });
    child.unref();
}

/* Writes update/apply.ps1 (apply.sh), starts it detached and returns; the
 * caller quits. */
function install(root, zip, rel) {
    const src = unpack(root, zip);
    const upd = path.join(root, 'update');
    fs.writeFileSync(path.join(upd, 'pending.json'), JSON.stringify({
        tag: rel.tag, name: rel.name, notes: rel.notes, from: rel.current,
    }));
    if (LINUX)
        return installLinux(root, src, zip, upd);
    const ps = [
        '$ErrorActionPreference = "Continue"',
        '$root = ' + psq(root),
        '$src = ' + psq(src),
        '$log = Join-Path $root "update\\apply.log"',
        '"update " + (Get-Date) | Out-File $log -Encoding utf8',
        /* this launcher and its helper processes, all from launcher\bin */
        'try { Wait-Process -Id ' + process.pid + ' -Timeout 60 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } catch {}',
        '$bin = Join-Path $root "launcher\\bin"',
        'for ($i = 0; $i -lt 60; $i++) {',
        '  $left = Get-Process -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Path -and $_.Path.StartsWith($bin, "OrdinalIgnoreCase") }',
        '  if (-not $left) { break }',
        '  Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 500',
        '}',
        '$fail = $false',
        'foreach ($d in @(' + MIRROR.map(psq).join(', ') + ')) {',
        '  & robocopy (Join-Path $src $d) (Join-Path $root $d) /MIR /R:5 /W:1 /NFL /NDL /NJH /NJS /NP | Out-File $log -Append -Encoding utf8',
        '  if ($LASTEXITCODE -ge 8) { $fail = $true; "robocopy $d -> $LASTEXITCODE" | Out-File $log -Append -Encoding utf8 }',
        '}',
        '& robocopy $src $root /R:5 /W:1 /NFL /NDL /NJH /NJS /NP | Out-File $log -Append -Encoding utf8',
        'if ($LASTEXITCODE -ge 8) { $fail = $true; "robocopy top -> $LASTEXITCODE" | Out-File $log -Append -Encoding utf8 }',
        'if ($fail) { Rename-Item (Join-Path $root "update\\pending.json") "failed.json" -Force }',
        'else { Rename-Item (Join-Path $root "update\\pending.json") "installed.json" -Force',
        '       Remove-Item (Join-Path $root "update\\new") -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue',
        '       Remove-Item ' + psq(zip) + ' -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }',
        'Start-Process -FilePath (Join-Path $root "UMK3-Launcher.exe") -WorkingDirectory $root',
    ].join('\r\n');
    const script = path.join(upd, 'apply.ps1');
    fs.writeFileSync(script, '\ufeff' + ps, 'utf8');
    /* Started through WMI, so it is nobody's child: a process the launcher
     * spawns itself can share its job and die with it. A detached spawn is
     * the fallback. */
    const line = 'powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -WindowStyle Hidden -File "' + script + '"';
    const wmi = spawnSync('powershell.exe', ['-NoProfile', '-Command',
        '$r = Invoke-CimMethod -ClassName Win32_Process -MethodName Create -Arguments @{ CommandLine = '
        + psq(line) + '; CurrentDirectory = ' + psq(upd) + ' }; exit $r.ReturnValue'],
        { windowsHide: true });
    if (wmi.status !== 0) {
        const child = spawn('powershell.exe',
            ['-NoProfile', '-ExecutionPolicy', 'Bypass', '-WindowStyle', 'Hidden', '-File', script],
            { cwd: upd, detached: true, stdio: 'ignore', windowsHide: true });
        child.unref();
    }
}

/* After a restart: what was installed (or failed), once; null otherwise. */
function takeResult(root) {
    for (const [f, ok] of [['installed.json', true], ['failed.json', false]]) {
        const p = path.join(root, 'update', f);
        if (!fs.existsSync(p))
            continue;
        let info = {};
        try { info = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(p, 'utf8')); } catch (e) { /* keep {} */ }
        fs.rmSync(p, { force: true });
        return Object.assign(info, { ok });
    }
    return null;
}

module.exports = { parseVersion, compareVersions, check, download, install, takeResult, REPO };

```

`launcher/app/main.js`:

```js
/* UMK3-Launcher (Electron) main process.
 *
 * A compact, frameless arcade window that can be resized freely (corner-grip
 * scale, or maximize).  Any existing umk3.ini beside the game is read at
 * start and every change is written to it immediately, exactly like the old
 * launcher.c.  The renderer is a plain HTML/CSS/JS page; it talks to this
 * process over contextBridge (no nodeIntegration).
 *
 * Packaged unpacked (npm run dist -> dist/win-unpacked), shipped in
 * launcher\bin\ behind the stub UMK3-Launcher.exe (launcher/stub/).
 */
'use strict';

const { app, BrowserWindow, ipcMain, dialog, nativeImage, net, Notification, shell } = require('electron');
const path = require('path');
const fs = require('fs');
const ini = require('./lib/ini');
const rootm = require('./lib/root');
const bld = require('./lib/build');
const upd = require('./lib/update');
const prof = require('./lib/profiles');
const mods = require('./lib/mods');

let g_win = null;
let g_root = null;
let g_cfg = null;

/* bring up the packaged build's errors to the surface (UMK3_LAUNCHER_SHOT;
 * not UMK3_SHOT, which the game itself reads and would inherit); the
 * portable wrapper detaches, so nothing would otherwise reach the console. */
function dbg(msg) {
    const where = process.env.UMK3_LAUNCHER_SHOT;
    if (!where)
        return;
    try {
        require('fs').appendFileSync(where.replace(/\.png[^.]*$/i, '.main.log'),
            new Date().toISOString() + ' ' + msg + '\n');
    } catch (err) { /* ignore */ }
}

process.on('uncaughtException', err => {
    dbg('uncaughtException: ' + (err && err.stack || err));
});
process.on('unhandledRejection', err => {
    dbg('unhandledRejection: ' + (err && err.stack || err));
});

function getWritableExeDir() {
    if (process.env.APPIMAGE)
        return path.dirname(process.env.APPIMAGE);
    if (process.env.PORTABLE_EXECUTABLE_DIR)
        return process.env.PORTABLE_EXECUTABLE_DIR;
    return path.dirname(process.execPath);
}

function findRoot() {
    if (process.env.UMK3_ROOT)
        return path.resolve(process.env.UMK3_ROOT);
    if (app.isPackaged)
        return getWritableExeDir();
    const exeDir = getWritableExeDir();
    return rootm.findRoot([
        process.cwd(),
        exeDir,
    ]);
}

/* Started without the stub (the bin exe directly, a shortcut), its location
 * says nothing certain about where the game lives; when the heuristics above
 * still fail -- e.g. launched from a shortcut or the search box -- remember
 * the folder chosen / found once, in the roaming profile. */
function savedRoot() {
    const f = path.join(app.getPath('appData'), 'umk3-launcher', 'root.json');
    try {
        const r = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(f, 'utf8'));
        return r && typeof r.root === 'string' && r.root ? r.root : null;
    } catch (err) {
        return null;
    }
}

function saveRoot(root) {
    const f = path.join(app.getPath('appData'), 'umk3-launcher', 'root.json');
    try {
        fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(f), { recursive: true });
        fs.writeFileSync(f, JSON.stringify({ root }));
    } catch (err) { /* non-fatal */ }
}

async function resolveRoot() {
    let r = findRoot();
    if (!r && savedRoot() && rootm.looksLikeRoot(savedRoot()))
        r = savedRoot();
    if (!r) {
        const picked = await dialog.showOpenDialog({
            title: 'UMK3 LAUNCHER: Select game folder',
            properties: ['openDirectory'],
            message: 'Select the folder containing the game (the folder with src or umk3-game).',
        });
        r = picked.canceled ? null : picked.filePaths[0];
        if (r && !rootm.looksLikeRoot(r)) {
            dialog.showMessageBox({
                type: 'error',
                message: 'That folder does not look like a game installation (missing src folder or game executable).',
            });
            r = null;
        }
    }
    if (r)
        saveRoot(r);
    return r;
}

function send(channel, data) {
    if (g_win && !g_win.isDestroyed())
        g_win.webContents.send(channel, data);
}

function createWindow() {
    g_win = new BrowserWindow({
        /* 4:3 by default; the page scales with the window (styles.css --u),
         * any size or fullscreen (F11). UMK3_LAUNCHER_SIZE=WxH: dev aid. */
        width: Number((process.env.UMK3_LAUNCHER_SIZE || '').split('x')[0]) || 1280,
        height: Number((process.env.UMK3_LAUNCHER_SIZE || '').split('x')[1]) || 768,
        minWidth: 640,
        minHeight: 480,
        useContentSize: true,
        resizable: true,
        maximizable: true,
        fullscreenable: true,
        frame: false,
        backgroundColor: '#050505',
        icon: path.join(__dirname, 'build', 'icon.ico'),
        show: false,
        webPreferences: {
            preload: path.join(__dirname, 'preload.js'),
            contextIsolation: true,
            nodeIntegration: false,
        },
    });
    g_win.setMenu(null);
    /* The window and taskbar icon: icon.png in the game folder if the player
     * put one there, else the launcher's own, build/icon.ico. */
    for (const f of ['icon.png']) {
        const p = g_root ? path.join(g_root, f) : null;
        if (p && fs.existsSync(p)) {
            g_win.setIcon(nativeImage.createFromPath(p));
            break;
        }
    }
    g_win.webContents.on('did-fail-load', (_e, code, desc) =>
        dbg('did-fail-load ' + code + ' ' + desc));
    g_win.webContents.on('render-process-gone', (_e, d) =>
        dbg('render-process-gone ' + d.reason));
    g_win.webContents.on('console-message', (_e, level, message) => {
        if (level >= 2)
            dbg('console<' + level + '>: ' + message);
    });
    /* UMK3_LAUNCHER_SEC=<section>: open on that page (with the shot aid);
     * UMK3_LAUNCHER_PICK=<kind>/<id>[@<clip>]: the MODS viewer opens that */
    g_win.loadFile(path.join(__dirname, 'renderer', 'index.html'),
                   { query: { sec: process.env.UMK3_LAUNCHER_SEC || '', pick: process.env.UMK3_LAUNCHER_PICK || '' } });
    g_win.webContents.once('did-finish-load', () => dbg('did-finish-load'));
    g_win.once('ready-to-show', () => g_win.show());
    g_win.on('closed', () => { g_win = null; });
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------- ipc ---- */

/* The title logo ships inside the launcher (renderer/logo.png), so it is
 * there the moment the window opens; logo.png in the game folder, if the
 * player put one there, replaces it. */
ipcMain.handle('logo:get', () => {
    try {
        const p = path.join(g_root, 'logo.png');
        return 'data:image/png;base64,' + fs.readFileSync(p).toString('base64');
    } catch (err) {
        return null;
    }
});

/* The picture inside the home screen's small ring, as the console's main
 * menu shows the game: "aditional textures/image.png" in the game folder,
 * the player's own (the launcher ships no game art). None: an empty ring. */
ipcMain.handle('hero:get', () => {
    for (const n of ['image.png', 'image.jpg']) {
        try {
            const p = path.join(g_root, 'aditional textures', n);
            return 'data:image/' + (n.endsWith('png') ? 'png' : 'jpeg') + ';base64,'
                   + fs.readFileSync(p).toString('base64');
        } catch (err) { /* the next */ }
    }
    return null;
});

/* arch= in umk3.ini: which exe is built and played (x86 or x64). */
function arch() {
    return (g_cfg || ini.load(path.join(g_root, 'umk3.ini'))).arch;
}

/* The exe asked for its pads and monitors: the chosen one, else the other. */
function anyExe() {
    for (const a of [arch(), arch() === 'x64' ? 'x86' : 'x64']) {
        const exe = path.join(g_root, ini.gameExe(a));
        if (fs.existsSync(exe))
            return exe;
    }
    return null;
}

ipcMain.handle('root:get', () =>
    ({ root: g_root, ready: ini.gameReady(g_root, arch()),
       builtAt: ini.gameBuiltAt(g_root, arch()), version: app.getVersion(),
       /* both compiled: JUGAR offers the choice (Windows only) */
       both: process.platform === 'win32' && ini.gameReady(g_root, 'x86') && ini.gameReady(g_root, 'x64'),
       /* none compiled yet: the menu shows COMPILE alone */
       any: ini.gameReady(g_root, 'x64') || (process.platform === 'win32' && ini.gameReady(g_root, 'x86')) }));

/* The first compile done: the launcher opens again with the whole menu. */
ipcMain.handle('app:relaunch', () => {
    app.relaunch();
    app.exit(0);
});

ipcMain.handle('config:load', () => {
    g_cfg = ini.load(path.join(g_root, 'umk3.ini'));
    return JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(g_cfg));
});

ipcMain.handle('config:save', (_ev, delta) => {
    if (!g_cfg || typeof delta !== 'object')
        return g_cfg;
    g_cfg = ini.load(path.join(g_root, 'umk3.ini'));
    /* a delta names only the keys that changed: merge them, never replace
     * the whole set (that wrote "undefined" for every other key) */
    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(delta)) {
        if (['keys', 'keys5', 'padKeys', 'padKeys5', 'p2Keys', 'p2Keys5',
             'p2PadKeys', 'p2PadKeys5'].includes(k)) {
            if (v && typeof v === 'object')
                Object.assign(g_cfg[k], v);
        } else {
            g_cfg[k] = v;
        }
    }
    ini.save(path.join(g_root, 'umk3.ini'), g_cfg);
    return JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(g_cfg));
});

ipcMain.handle('window:close', () => {
    if (g_win)
        g_win.close();
    return true;
});

ipcMain.handle('window:minimize', () => {
    if (g_win)
        g_win.minimize();
    return true;
});

ipcMain.handle('window:maximize', () => {
    if (!g_win)
        return false;
    if (g_win.isMaximized())
        g_win.unmaximize();
    else
        g_win.maximize();
    return g_win.isMaximized();
});

ipcMain.handle('window:fullscreen', () => {
    if (!g_win)
        return false;
    g_win.setFullScreen(!g_win.isFullScreen());
    return g_win.isFullScreen();
});

/* The file picker. On Windows a dialog owned by a fullscreen window opens
 * BEHIND it, so BUSCAR looked dead in fullscreen: leave fullscreen while the
 * picker is up and come back after, and bring it to the front. */
async function pickFile(opts) {
    const full = g_win.isFullScreen();
    if (full)
        g_win.setFullScreen(false);
    g_win.focus();
    try {
        return await dialog.showOpenDialog(g_win, opts);
    } finally {
        if (full)
            g_win.setFullScreen(true);
    }
}

ipcMain.handle('ipa:browse', async () => {
    if (!g_win)
        return null;
    const r = await pickFile({
        title: 'Choose your UMK3 .ipa',
        properties: ['openFile'],
        filters: [
            { name: 'UMK3 .ipa', extensions: ['ipa'] },
            { name: 'All files', extensions: ['*'] },
        ],
        defaultPath: g_cfg && g_cfg.ipa && fs.existsSync(path.dirname(g_cfg.ipa))
            ? g_cfg.ipa : undefined,
    });
    if (r.canceled || r.filePaths.length === 0)
        return null;
    return r.filePaths[0];
});

/* The picture behind the bars in fullscreen: any PNG the player owns. */
ipcMain.handle('frame:browse', async () => {
    if (!g_win)
        return null;
    const r = await pickFile({
        title: 'Frame picture',
        properties: ['openFile'],
        filters: [{ name: 'PNG', extensions: ['png'] }],
    });
    if (r.canceled || r.filePaths.length === 0)
        return null;
    return r.filePaths[0];
});

ipcMain.handle('build:start', async (_ev, ipa) => {
    if (!ipa || typeof ipa !== 'string')
        return { ok: false, code: -2 };
    if (!fs.existsSync(ipa))
        return { ok: false, code: -3 };
    const code = await bld.build(g_root, ipa, arch(), msg => send('build:data', msg));
    const ok = code === 0 && ini.gameReady(g_root, arch());
    return { ok, code };
});

ipcMain.handle('build:cancel', () => bld.cancelBuild());

/* ---------------------------------------------------------- updates ---- */

/* The newest release on GitHub and its notes (lib/update.js). The page asks
 * once when it opens and again on CHECK FOR UPDATES; a newer one also
 * gets a Windows notification, once per launch. */
let g_rel = null, g_notified = false;

ipcMain.handle('update:check', async () => {
    try {
        g_rel = await upd.check(net.fetch, app.getVersion());
    } catch (err) {
        return { ok: false, error: err.message, current: app.getVersion() };
    }
    if (g_rel && g_rel.newer && !g_notified && Notification.isSupported()) {
        g_notified = true;
        new Notification({
            title: 'UMK3 — Update available',
            body: g_rel.name + ' (' + g_rel.tag + '). Open it in COMPILE YOUR .IPA.',
        }).show();
    }
    return { ok: true, rel: g_rel, current: app.getVersion() };
});

/* Download, unpack, hand over to update/apply.ps1 and quit: the script copies
 * the files once this launcher is closed and starts it again. */
ipcMain.handle('update:install', async () => {
    if (!g_rel || !g_rel.newer)
        return { ok: false, error: 'no newer version available' };
    try {
        const zip = await upd.download(net.fetch, g_rel, path.join(g_root, 'update'),
            (got, total) => send('update:progress', { got, total }));
        send('update:progress', { got: 1, total: 1, phase: 'install' });
        upd.install(g_root, zip, g_rel);
    } catch (err) {
        return { ok: false, error: err.message };
    }
    setTimeout(() => app.quit(), 400);
    return { ok: true };
});

/* After apply.ps1 restarted us: what it installed, once. */
let g_updResult;
ipcMain.handle('update:result', () => {
    if (g_updResult === undefined)
        g_updResult = upd.takeResult(g_root);
    const r = g_updResult;
    g_updResult = null;
    return r;
});

/* The pads Windows has attached, by name: `umk3-game --list-pads` prints one
 * "pad=value<TAB>name" a line (the game's own search, WinMM and XInput).
 * Empty before the game is compiled. */
ipcMain.handle('pads:list', () => new Promise(resolve => {
    const exe = anyExe();
    if (!exe)
        return resolve([]);
    require('child_process').execFile(exe, ['--list-pads'],
        { cwd: g_root, timeout: 10000, windowsHide: true }, (err, out) => {
            const pads = [];
            for (const line of String(out || '').split(/\r?\n/)) {
                const tab = line.indexOf('\t');
                const value = line.slice(0, tab).trim().toLowerCase();
                if (tab > 0 && /^(xinput|[0-9a-f]{4}:[0-9a-f]{4})$/.test(value))
                    pads.push({ value, name: line.slice(tab + 1).trim() });
            }
            resolve(pads);
        });
}));

/* The monitors, as the game counts them: `umk3-game --list-monitors`
 * prints "index<TAB>name" a line (monitor= in umk3.ini). */
ipcMain.handle('monitors:list', () => new Promise(resolve => {
    const exe = anyExe();
    if (!exe)
        return resolve([]);
    require('child_process').execFile(exe, ['--list-monitors'],
        { cwd: g_root, timeout: 10000, windowsHide: true }, (err, out) => {
            const mons = [];
            for (const line of String(out || '').split(/\r?\n/)) {
                const m = line.match(/^(\d+)\t(.+)$/);
                if (m)
                    mons.push({ value: Number(m[1]), name: m[2].trim() });
            }
            resolve(mons);
        });
}));

/* The player's profile (lib/profiles.js): profiles.ini beside the game,
 * which the game's settings menu edits too. One per installation; its id is
 * given the first time and never changes. */
ipcMain.handle('profile:load', (_ev, name) => prof.load(g_root, name));
ipcMain.handle('profile:update', (_ev, fields) => prof.update(g_root, fields || {}));
ipcMain.handle('profile:reset', (_ev, name) => prof.reset(g_root, name));
ipcMain.handle('profile:icon', (_ev, i) => prof.iconData(g_root, Number(i)));

/* The key and button pictures (Julio Cacko's Free Input Prompts, CC0), the
 * same the game's menus draw: "aditional textures/glyphs/<set>/<file>.png"
 * beside the game, or the launcher's own copy before the first compile.
 * Every one at once, as data: URLs by "<set>/<file>". */
ipcMain.handle('glyphs:all', () => {
    const dirs = [path.join(g_root || '', 'aditional textures', 'glyphs'),
                  path.join(g_root || '', 'launcher', 'aditional textures', 'glyphs'),
                  process.resourcesPath ? path.join(process.resourcesPath, 'launcher', 'aditional textures', 'glyphs') : '',
                  path.join(__dirname, '..', 'aditional textures', 'glyphs')].filter(Boolean);
    const out = {};
    for (const d of dirs) {
        let sets;
        try { sets = fs.readdirSync(d); } catch (err) { continue; }
        for (const set of sets) {
            let files;
            try { files = fs.readdirSync(path.join(d, set)); } catch (err) { continue; }
            for (const f of files)
                if (f.toLowerCase().endsWith('.png') && !out[set + '/' + f.slice(0, -4)])
                    out[set + '/' + f.slice(0, -4)] = 'data:image/png;base64,' +
                        fs.readFileSync(path.join(d, set, f)).toString('base64');
        }
        if (Object.keys(out).length) break;
    }
    return out;
});

ipcMain.handle('play', () => {
    if (!ini.gameReady(g_root, arch()))
        return { ok: false };
    bld.play(g_root, ini.gameExe(arch()));
    /* the game runs on its own (detached): the launcher steps aside, once
     * the answer has reached the page */
    setTimeout(() => app.quit(), 800);
    return { ok: true };
});

/* --------------------------------------------------------------- mods --
 * The MODS section (lib/mods.js): the mod list and its order, the game's
 * files for the viewer, the exports. */

ipcMain.handle('mods:list', () => mods.list(g_root));
ipcMain.handle('mods:save', (_ev, order) => mods.save(g_root, order));
ipcMain.handle('mods:create', (_ev, fields) => mods.create(g_root, fields));
ipcMain.handle('mods:info', (_ev, folder, fields) => mods.setInfo(g_root, folder, fields));
ipcMain.handle('mods:put', (_ev, folder, file, bytes) => mods.putFile(g_root, folder, file, bytes));
ipcMain.handle('mods:add', async (_ev, folder) => {
    if (!g_win)
        return 0;
    const r = await pickFile({
        title: 'Files for the mod',
        properties: ['openFile', 'multiSelections'],
        filters: [
            { name: 'Game files', extensions: ['png', 'pvr', 'wav', 'mp3', 'meshset', 'skin', 'bones', 'skinanim', 'scene', 'events'] },
            { name: 'All files', extensions: ['*'] },
        ],
    });
    if (r.canceled)
        return 0;
    return mods.addFiles(g_root, folder, r.filePaths);
});
ipcMain.handle('mods:open', (_ev, folder) => {
    const p = mods.modPath(g_root, folder);
    if (!p)
        return false;
    fs.mkdirSync(p, { recursive: true });
    shell.openPath(p);
    return true;
});
/* to the recycle bin, not deleted: the player can get it back */
ipcMain.handle('mods:trash', async (_ev, folder) => {
    const p = folder && mods.modPath(g_root, folder);
    if (!p || !fs.existsSync(p))
        return false;
    await shell.trashItem(p);
    return true;
});
/* the cover, as the PNG the window made of the picture picked */
ipcMain.handle('mods:cover', (_ev, folder, png) => mods.setCover(g_root, folder, png));
ipcMain.handle('mods:dataRead', (_ev, folder) => mods.dataRead(g_root, folder));
ipcMain.handle('mods:dataWrite', (_ev, folder, entries) => mods.dataWrite(g_root, folder, entries));
ipcMain.handle('res:files', () => mods.resFiles(g_root));
ipcMain.handle('res:read', (_ev, rel, layer) => mods.resRead(g_root, rel, layer));
ipcMain.handle('game:tables', () => mods.gameTables(g_root));
/* a model or an animation from Blender, for the viewer to bring in */
ipcMain.handle('file:pick', async (_ev, kind) => {
    const r = g_win && await pickFile({
        title: kind === 'picture' ? 'Picture' : 'FBX from Blender',
        properties: ['openFile'],
        /* pictures: whatever the window decodes, and TGA (ui/src/lib/mods/image.js) */
        filters: kind === 'picture'
            ? [{ name: 'Pictures', extensions: ['png', 'jpg', 'jpeg', 'jfif', 'webp', 'gif', 'bmp', 'ico', 'avif', 'svg', 'tga'] },
               { name: 'All files', extensions: ['*'] }]
            : [{ name: 'FBX', extensions: ['fbx'] }],
    });
    if (!r || r.canceled)
        return null;
    return { name: path.basename(r.filePaths[0]), bytes: new Uint8Array(fs.readFileSync(r.filePaths[0])) };
});
ipcMain.handle('export:save', (_ev, sub, files) => mods.exportSave(g_root, sub, files));
ipcMain.handle('export:open', (_ev, sub) => {
    const p = path.join(g_root, 'exports', sub && /^[\w .()'-]+(\/[\w .()'-]+)*$/.test(sub) && !sub.includes('..') ? sub : '');
    fs.mkdirSync(p, { recursive: true });
    shell.openPath(p);
    return true;
});

/* ------------------------------------------------------------- splash -- */

/* A development aid: UMK3_LAUNCHER_SHOT=<png> starts, waits for the renderer's
 * "shot:ready" handshake, captures a PNG and exits.  Used to eyeball the
 * design without a real .ipa. */
ipcMain.handle('shot:capture', async () => {
    const where = process.env.UMK3_LAUNCHER_SHOT;
    if (!where || !g_win)
        return false;
    try {
        await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 1200));
        const img = await g_win.webContents.capturePage();
        require('fs').writeFileSync(where, img.toPNG());
        dbg('captured ok');
        app.quit();
        return true;
    } catch (err) {
        dbg('capture failed: ' + err.message);
        app.quit();
        return false;
    }
});

/* Development aid together with UMK3_SHOT: dumps the renderer's geometry so
 * the layout can be validated without looking at the PNG. */
ipcMain.handle('debug:layout', (_ev, payload) => {
    const where = process.env.UMK3_LAUNCHER_SHOT;
    if (!where || !payload)
        return false;
    const json = where.replace(/\.png[^.]*$/i, '.json');
    require('fs').writeFileSync(json, JSON.stringify(payload, null, 2));
    return true;
});

/* -------------------------------------------------------------- app ---- */

/* the capture aid (UMK3_LAUNCHER_SHOT) runs beside a launcher already open */
const gotLock = process.env.UMK3_LAUNCHER_SHOT ? true : app.requestSingleInstanceLock();
if (!gotLock) {
    app.quit();
} else {
    app.on('second-instance', () => {
        if (g_win) {
            if (g_win.isMinimized())
                g_win.restore();
            g_win.focus();
        }
    });
    app.whenReady().then(async () => {
        g_root = await resolveRoot();
        if (!g_root) {
            app.quit();
            return;                     /* nothing below may run without a root */
        }
        g_cfg = ini.load(path.join(g_root, 'umk3.ini'));
        dbg('ready root=' + g_root);
        createWindow();
        app.on('activate', () => {
            if (BrowserWindow.getAllWindows().length === 0)
                createWindow();
        });
    });
    app.on('window-all-closed', () => {
        if (process.platform !== 'darwin')
            app.quit();
    });
}
```

`launcher/app/preload.js`:

```js
'use strict';

const { contextBridge, ipcRenderer } = require('electron');

contextBridge.exposeInMainWorld('umk3', {
    platform: process.platform,
    root: () => ipcRenderer.invoke('root:get'),
    logo: () => ipcRenderer.invoke('logo:get'),
    hero: () => ipcRenderer.invoke('hero:get'),
    loadConfig: () => ipcRenderer.invoke('config:load'),
    saveConfig: delta => ipcRenderer.invoke('config:save', delta),
    browseIpa: () => ipcRenderer.invoke('ipa:browse'),
    browseFrame: () => ipcRenderer.invoke('frame:browse'),
    startBuild: ipa => ipcRenderer.invoke('build:start', ipa),
    cancelBuild: () => ipcRenderer.invoke('build:cancel'),
    play: () => ipcRenderer.invoke('play'),
    loadProfile: name => ipcRenderer.invoke('profile:load', name),
    updateProfile: fields => ipcRenderer.invoke('profile:update', fields),
    resetProfile: name => ipcRenderer.invoke('profile:reset', name),
    profileIcon: i => ipcRenderer.invoke('profile:icon', i),
    glyphs: () => ipcRenderer.invoke('glyphs:all'),
    listPads: () => ipcRenderer.invoke('pads:list'),
    listMonitors: () => ipcRenderer.invoke('monitors:list'),
    close: () => ipcRenderer.invoke('window:close'),
    relaunch: () => ipcRenderer.invoke('app:relaunch'),
    minimize: () => ipcRenderer.invoke('window:minimize'),
    maximize: () => ipcRenderer.invoke('window:maximize'),
    fullscreen: () => ipcRenderer.invoke('window:fullscreen'),
    onBuildData: cb => ipcRenderer.on('build:data', (_e, d) => cb(d)),
    checkUpdate: () => ipcRenderer.invoke('update:check'),
    installUpdate: () => ipcRenderer.invoke('update:install'),
    updateResult: () => ipcRenderer.invoke('update:result'),
    onUpdateProgress: cb => ipcRenderer.on('update:progress', (_e, d) => cb(d)),
    modsList: () => ipcRenderer.invoke('mods:list'),
    modsSave: order => ipcRenderer.invoke('mods:save', order),
    modsCreate: fields => ipcRenderer.invoke('mods:create', fields),
    modsInfo: (folder, fields) => ipcRenderer.invoke('mods:info', folder, fields),
    modsPut: (folder, file, bytes) => ipcRenderer.invoke('mods:put', folder, file, bytes),
    modsAdd: folder => ipcRenderer.invoke('mods:add', folder),
    modsOpen: folder => ipcRenderer.invoke('mods:open', folder),
    modsTrash: folder => ipcRenderer.invoke('mods:trash', folder),
    resFiles: () => ipcRenderer.invoke('res:files'),
    resRead: (rel, layer) => ipcRenderer.invoke('res:read', rel, layer),
    modsCover: (folder, png) => ipcRenderer.invoke('mods:cover', folder, png),
    modsDataRead: folder => ipcRenderer.invoke('mods:dataRead', folder),
    modsDataWrite: (folder, entries) => ipcRenderer.invoke('mods:dataWrite', folder, entries),
    gameTables: () => ipcRenderer.invoke('game:tables'),
    pickFile: kind => ipcRenderer.invoke('file:pick', kind),
    exportSave: (sub, files) => ipcRenderer.invoke('export:save', sub, files),
    exportOpen: sub => ipcRenderer.invoke('export:open', sub),
    shot: () => ipcRenderer.invoke('shot:capture'),
    debugLayout: payload => ipcRenderer.invoke('debug:layout', payload),
});
```

`launcher/app/scripts/build-subsurf.js`:

```js
/* SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-2.0-or-later
 *
 * Builds the model viewer's SMOOTH MODEL: src/thirdparty/blender (Blender's
 * Weld and Subdivision Surface, the same C the game links) compiled to
 * WebAssembly with zig, written into ui/src/lib/mods/subsurf_wasm.js as
 * base64 so the window loads it with no file of its own.
 *
 *     node scripts/build-subsurf.js [path to zig]
 *
 * zig: the argument, UMK3_ZIG, or the toolchain the launcher downloads. The
 * generated file is committed, so a build without zig still has it. */
'use strict';
const { execFileSync } = require('child_process');
const fs = require('fs');
const os = require('os');
const path = require('path');

const ROOT = path.join(__dirname, '..', '..', '..');
const SRC = path.join(ROOT, 'src', 'thirdparty', 'blender');
const OUT = path.join(__dirname, '..', 'ui', 'src', 'lib', 'mods', 'subsurf_wasm.js');
const EXPORTS = ['umk_subsurf_new', 'umk_subsurf_eval', 'umk_subsurf_num_verts', 'umk_subsurf_pos',
    'umk_subsurf_uv', 'umk_subsurf_attr', 'umk_subsurf_num_tris', 'umk_subsurf_tris',
    'umk_subsurf_welded', 'umk_subsurf_free', 'malloc', 'free'];

function findZig() {
    if (process.argv[2]) return process.argv[2];
    if (process.env.UMK3_ZIG) return process.env.UMK3_ZIG;
    const base = process.platform === 'win32'
        ? path.join(process.env.LOCALAPPDATA || '', 'umk3-launcher', 'toolchain')
        : path.join(os.homedir(), '.local', 'share', 'umk3-launcher', 'toolchain');
    if (fs.existsSync(base))
        for (const d of fs.readdirSync(base)) {
            const z = path.join(base, d, process.platform === 'win32' ? 'zig.exe' : 'zig');
            if (fs.existsSync(z)) return z;
        }
    return null;
}

const zig = findZig();
if (!zig) {
    console.error('build-subsurf: no zig (pass its path or set UMK3_ZIG); keeping', path.relative(ROOT, OUT));
    process.exit(1);
}
const tmp = path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'umk3-subsurf.wasm');
execFileSync(zig, ['cc', '-target', 'wasm32-wasi', '-mexec-model=reactor', '-O2', '-std=gnu99', '-s',
    ...['umk3_subsurf.c', 'CCGSubSurf.c', 'CCGSubSurf_legacy.c', 'CCGSubSurf_util.c'].map(f => path.join(SRC, f)),
    '-I', SRC, '-I', path.join(SRC, 'shim'),
    ...EXPORTS.map(e => '-Wl,--export=' + e), '-o', tmp], { stdio: 'inherit' });
const b64 = fs.readFileSync(tmp).toString('base64');
fs.unlinkSync(tmp);
fs.writeFileSync(OUT,
    '/* SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-2.0-or-later\n' +
    ' * Generated by launcher/app/scripts/build-subsurf.js from src/thirdparty/blender\n' +
    ' * (Blender\'s Weld and Subdivision Surface). Do not edit. */\n' +
    'export const SUBSURF_WASM = \'' + b64 + '\';\n');
console.log('build-subsurf:', path.relative(ROOT, OUT), Math.round(b64.length * 3 / 4 / 1024), 'KB of wasm');

```

`launcher/app/scripts/build-ui.js`:

```js
/* Builds the window (ui/, SvelteKit) into renderer/: run by `npm run ui`,
 * and by electron-builder before it packs (package.json, beforePack), so a
 * package never ships an old or missing renderer.
 *
 * SvelteKit writes the page with root paths (/_app/...), which from disk
 * would point at the drive's root: they are made relative here, and the
 * hash of the start-up script, which the Content-Security-Policy allows by
 * that hash, is worked out again for the changed script. */
'use strict';
const { execFileSync } = require('child_process');
const crypto = require('crypto');
const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');

const APP = path.join(__dirname, '..');

function buildUi() {
    const vite = path.join(APP, 'node_modules', 'vite', 'bin', 'vite.js');
    execFileSync(process.execPath, [vite, 'build'], { cwd: path.join(APP, 'ui'), stdio: 'inherit' });

    const page = path.join(APP, 'renderer', 'index.html');
    let html = fs.readFileSync(page, 'utf8')
        .replace(/(href|src)="\/_app\//g, '$1="./_app/')
        .replace(/import\("\/_app\//g, 'import("./_app/');
    const scripts = [...html.matchAll(/<script>([\s\S]*?)<\/script>/g)]
        .map(m => "'sha256-" + crypto.createHash('sha256').update(m[1]).digest('base64') + "'");
    /* 'wasm-unsafe-eval': the viewer's SMOOTH MODEL (ui/src/lib/mods/subsurf.js) */
    html = html.replace(/script-src 'self'[^;"]*/, "script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval' " + scripts.join(' '));
    /* SvelteKit's route announcer hides itself with a style attribute: that
     * one style, by its hash, and no other */
    const styles = new Set();
    const imm = path.join(APP, 'renderer', '_app', 'immutable');
    for (const dir of fs.readdirSync(imm))
        for (const f of fs.readdirSync(path.join(imm, dir)).filter(n => n.endsWith('.js')))
            for (const m of fs.readFileSync(path.join(imm, dir, f), 'utf8').matchAll(/svelte-announcer"[^>]*?style="([^"]*)"/g))
                styles.add("'sha256-" + crypto.createHash('sha256').update(m[1]).digest('base64') + "'");
    if (styles.size)
        html = html.replace(/style-src 'self'/, "style-src 'self' 'unsafe-hashes' " + [...styles].join(' '));
    if (/"\/_app\//.test(html))
        throw new Error('renderer/index.html still has a root path');
    fs.writeFileSync(page, html);
}

module.exports = async () => buildUi();
if (require.main === module) buildUi();

```

```js
'use strict';

const test = require('node:test');
const assert = require('node:assert/strict');
const path = require('path');
const fs = require('fs');

const { openZip } = require('../lib/extract/zip');
const { loadMachO } = require('../lib/extract/macho');
const { extractLevelInfo } = require('../lib/extract/level_info');
const { extractSeqData } = require('../lib/extract/seq_data');
const { transformLow32Static } = require('../lib/extract/low32_static');

const ROOT = path.resolve(__dirname, '../../..');
const IPA_PATH = path.join(ROOT, 'Ultimate_Mortal_Kombat__3_1.2.59_ios_3.0.ipa');

test('zip: opens IPA and reads Info.plist', { skip: !fs.existsSync(IPA_PATH) }, () => {
    const zip = openZip(IPA_PATH);
    const names = zip.namelist();
    assert.ok(names.length > 5000);
    assert.ok(zip.has('Payload/UMK3.app/Info.plist'));

    const plistData = zip.read('Payload/UMK3.app/Info.plist').toString('utf8');
    assert.ok(plistData.includes('1.2.59'));
    zip.close();
});

test('macho: loads armv7 slice and validates UUID', { skip: !fs.existsSync(IPA_PATH) }, () => {
    const zip = openZip(IPA_PATH);
    const bin = zip.read('Payload/UMK3.app/UMK3');
    const { m } = loadMachO(bin);
    assert.equal(m.arch(), 'armv7');
    assert.equal(m.uuid, '90d6f56a18e2303f8f2053b02a42742e');
    assert.equal(m.encryption ? m.encryption[2] : 0, 0);
    zip.close();
});

test('low32_static: transforms globals header and source', () => {
    const headerPath = path.join(ROOT, 'src/runtime/gamecode_globals.h');
    const srcPath = path.join(ROOT, 'src/runtime/gamecode_globals.c');
    if (!fs.existsSync(headerPath) || !fs.existsSync(srcPath)) return;

    const res = transformLow32Static([headerPath], srcPath, null, 'umk3_globals_fixup');
    assert.ok(res.fixupsCount > 900);
    assert.ok(res.content.includes('void umk3_globals_fixup(void)'));
});
```

`launcher/app/test/ini.test.js`:

```js
'use strict';

const { test } = require('node:test');
const assert = require('node:assert');
const fs = require('fs');
const os = require('os');
const path = require('path');
const ini = require('../lib/ini');

function tmpIni() {
    const dir = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'umk3-ini-'));
    return path.join(dir, 'umk3.ini');
}

test('defaults match launcher.c', () => {
    const c = ini.defaultConfig();
    assert.equal(c.res, 1);                       /* 960x640 */
    assert.equal(c.fullscreen, false);
    assert.equal(c.widescreen, false);
    assert.equal(c.debug, false);
    assert.equal(c.language, 0);
    assert.equal(c.ui, 'EN');
    assert.equal(c.ipa, '');
    assert.equal(c.keys.up, 0x57);
    assert.equal(c.keys.down, 0x53);
    assert.equal(c.keys.left, 0x41);
    assert.equal(c.keys.right, 0x44);
    assert.equal(c.keys.hp, 0x55);
    assert.equal(c.keys.lp, 0x49);
    assert.equal(c.keys.block, 0x4f);
    assert.equal(c.keys.hk, 0x4a);
    assert.equal(c.keys.lk, 0x4b);
    assert.equal(c.keys.run, 0x4c);
    assert.equal(c.keys.pause, 0x50);
    assert.equal(c.keys.moves, 0x4d);
});

test('missing file keeps defaults', () => {
    const p = tmpIni();
    const c = ini.load(p);
    assert.equal(c.res, 1);
    assert.equal(c.ui, 'EN');
    assert.equal(c.keys.moves, 0x4d);
    assert.ok(!fs.existsSync(p));
});

test('round-trip through save/load is lossless', () => {
    const c = ini.defaultConfig();
    c.res = 4;                 /* 2400x1600 */
    c.fullscreen = true;
    c.borderless = true;
    c.rres = 10;               /* 3D at 1920x1080 */
    c.antialiasing = 8;
    c.hideControls = true;
    c.smoothAnims = true;
    c.smoothModels = 2;
    c.widescreen = true;
    c.debug = true;
    c.skipIntro = true;
    c.language = 2;            /* ES */
    c.ui = 'EN';
    c.ipa = 'C:\\Juegos\\UMK3 v1.2.59.ipa';
    c.keys.up = 0x26;          /* Up arrow */
    c.keys.block = 0x20;       /* Space */
    const p = tmpIni();
    ini.save(p, c);
    const r = ini.load(p);
    assert.deepEqual(r, c);
    assert.equal(r.res, 4);
    assert.equal(r.fullscreen, true);
    assert.equal(r.language, 2);
    assert.equal(r.ui, 'EN');
    assert.equal(r.keys.up, 0x26);
    assert.equal(r.keys.block, 0x20);
});

test('reads a file written by the old C launcher', () => {
    const p = tmpIni();
    fs.writeFileSync(p, [
        'width=960', 'height=640', 'fullscreen=1', 'widescreen=1', 'language=',
        'ui=ES', 'ipa=C:/games/UMK3.ipa', 'debug_keys=0',
        'key_up=87', 'key_down=83', 'key_left=65', 'key_right=68',
        'key_hp=85', 'key_lp=73', 'key_block=79', 'key_hk=74', 'key_lk=75',
        'key_run=76', 'key_pause=80', 'key_moves=77',
    ].join('\n') + '\n', 'utf8');
    const c = ini.load(p);
    assert.equal(c.res, 1);
    assert.equal(c.fullscreen, true);
    assert.equal(c.language, 0);        /* "" = automatic */
    assert.equal(c.ipa, 'C:/games/UMK3.ipa');
    assert.equal(c.keys.up, 0x57);
});

test('unlisted resolution falls back to 960x640', () => {
    const p = tmpIni();
    fs.writeFileSync(p, 'width=1234\nheight=5678\n', 'utf8');
    const c = ini.load(p);
    assert.equal(c.res, 1);
});

test('gameReady only when exe and Info.plist exist', () => {
    const dir = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'umk3-root-'));
    assert.equal(ini.gameReady(dir), false);
    fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dir, 'umk3-game.exe'), 'x');
    assert.equal(ini.gameReady(dir), false);
    fs.mkdirSync(path.join(dir, 'res'));
    fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dir, 'res', 'Info.plist'), 'x');
    assert.equal(ini.gameReady(dir), true);
});
test('pad= round-trips and rejects junk', () => {
    const p = tmpIni();
    const c = ini.defaultConfig();
    assert.equal(c.pad, 'auto');
    c.pad = '054c:0ce6';
    c.padName = 'DualSense Wireless Controller';
    ini.save(p, c);
    const back = ini.load(p);
    assert.equal(back.pad, '054c:0ce6');
    assert.equal(back.padName, 'DualSense Wireless Controller');
    fs.writeFileSync(p, 'pad=evil;rm\n');
    assert.equal(ini.load(p).pad, 'auto');
});
test('aspect= round-trips and rejects junk', () => {
    const p = tmpIni();
    fs.writeFileSync(p, 'aspect=21:9\n');
    assert.equal(ini.load(p).aspect, '21:9');
    fs.writeFileSync(p, 'aspect=5:1\n');
    assert.equal(ini.load(p).aspect, '3:2');
});

test('ui_size= round-trips and rejects junk', () => {
    const p = tmpIni();
    fs.writeFileSync(p, 'ui_size=IPAD\n');
    assert.equal(ini.load(p).uiSize, 'ipad');
    fs.writeFileSync(p, 'ui_size=huge\n');
    assert.equal(ini.load(p).uiSize, 'iphone');
});

test('texture_quality= round-trips and rejects junk', () => {
    const p = tmpIni();
    const c = ini.defaultConfig();
    assert.equal(c.textureQuality, 'iphone');
    c.textureQuality = 'max';
    ini.save(p, c);
    assert.equal(ini.load(p).textureQuality, 'max');
    fs.writeFileSync(p, 'texture_quality=IPAD\n');
    assert.equal(ini.load(p).textureQuality, 'ipad');
    fs.writeFileSync(p, 'texture_quality=ultra\n');
    assert.equal(ini.load(p).textureQuality, 'iphone');
});
```

`launcher/app/test/update.test.js`:

```js
'use strict';
const test = require('node:test');
const assert = require('node:assert');
const upd = require('../lib/update');

test('versions compare by number, then letter', () => {
    const c = upd.compareVersions;
    assert.ok(c('v0.0.10-alpha', '0.0.9-alpha') > 0);
    assert.ok(c('v0.0.7b-alpha', '0.0.7-alpha') > 0);
    assert.ok(c('v0.0.7c-alpha', '0.0.7b-alpha') > 0);
    assert.ok(c('v0.0.9-alpha', '0.0.9-alpha') === 0);
    assert.ok(c('v0.0.8-alpha', '0.0.9-alpha') < 0);
    assert.ok(c('v0.1.0', '0.0.99') > 0);
});

test('check picks the newest non-draft release with a zip', async () => {
    const list = [
        { draft: true, tag_name: 'v9.9.9', assets: [{ name: 'x.zip' }] },
        { tag_name: 'v0.0.10-alpha', name: 'n', body: 'b', assets: [{ name: 'notes.txt' }] },
        { tag_name: 'v0.0.9-alpha', name: 'UMK3 0.0.9', body: '## hi', html_url: 'u',
          /* Windows takes the .zip, Linux the linux .tar.gz (lib/update.js) */
          assets: [{ name: 'UMK3-PC-0.0.9-alpha.zip', size: 5, browser_download_url: 'd', digest: 'sha256:' + 'a'.repeat(64) },
                   { name: 'UMK3-PC-0.0.9-alpha-linux-x64.tar.gz', size: 5, browser_download_url: 'd', digest: 'sha256:' + 'a'.repeat(64) }] },
    ];
    const f = async () => ({ ok: true, json: async () => list });
    const r = await upd.check(f, '0.0.8-alpha');
    assert.equal(r.tag, 'v0.0.9-alpha');
    assert.equal(r.newer, true);
    assert.equal(r.sha256, 'a'.repeat(64));
    assert.equal((await upd.check(f, '0.0.9-alpha')).newer, false);
});
```
