```c
/* ------------------------------------------------------------- sprites
 *
 * limeDrawSprite is a real symbol in the binary but it lives in the iOS layer,
 * not in lime/common, so it belongs here rather than in decomp/.
 *
 * It records its last call instead of discarding it. A font test has no
 * renderer to inspect, but it can assert on the UV rectangle and the page a
 * glyph was drawn from -- which is exactly the part of limeDrawFONT worth
 * checking, and the part that would otherwise need eyes on a screen.
 */
static struct {
    const TEXTURE *page;
    float x, y, w, h;
    float u, v, du, dv;
    long  count;
} g_last_sprite;

/* Ten arguments; the tenth is the colour every caller in gamecode passes and
 * this signature used to drop. Nothing draws here, so it is not read -- but the
 * shape has to match or every argument after the fourth is misplaced. */
#ifndef UMK3_REAL_GL   /* headless; see runtime/draw_gl.c for the windowed half */
/* draw_gl.c's edge clamp; the headless build draws nothing */
int  lime_port_edge_clamp(const float *uv, int stride,
                          const unsigned short *idx, int n)
{ (void)uv; (void)stride; (void)idx; (void)n; return 0; }
void lime_port_edge_restore(int clamped) { (void)clamped; }
/* draw_gl.c's loading budget: headless, one step a frame as on the device */
int  lime_port_load_more(int first) { (void)first; return 0; }
void lime_port_load_done(const char *what) { (void)what; }

void limeDrawSprite(TEXTURE *page, float x, float y, float w, float h,
                    float u, float v, float du, float dv,
                    const float *colour)
{
    (void)colour;
    g_last_sprite.page = page;
    g_last_sprite.x = x;   g_last_sprite.y = y;
    g_last_sprite.w = w;   g_last_sprite.h = h;
    g_last_sprite.u = u;   g_last_sprite.v = v;
    g_last_sprite.du = du; g_last_sprite.dv = dv;
    g_last_sprite.count++;
}

long lime_platform_sprite_count(void) { return g_last_sprite.count; }

void lime_platform_last_sprite(float *out8)
{
    out8[0] = g_last_sprite.x;  out8[1] = g_last_sprite.y;
    out8[2] = g_last_sprite.w;  out8[3] = g_last_sprite.h;
    out8[4] = g_last_sprite.u;  out8[5] = g_last_sprite.v;
    out8[6] = g_last_sprite.du; out8[7] = g_last_sprite.dv;
}

/* The rotated, top-left-anchored sprite limeDrawFONTAtAngle draws through.
 * Shares the recorder above so a test can inspect either path. */

                                  float w, float h, float u, float v,
                                  float du, float dv, float angle,
                                  const float *colour)

    limeDrawSprite(page, x, y, w, h, u, v, du, dv, colour);

#endif  /* !UMK3_REAL_GL */


/* ------------------------------------------------ the rest of the GL surface
 *
 * The draw calls the mesh renderers use. All no-ops except glDrawElements,
 * which counts: a test with no renderer can still assert that a mesh was drawn
 * once rather than never or twice, and that is most of what the render path
 * gets wrong.
 */

    (void)mode; (void)type; (void)idx;

    g_draw_indices += count;
}
```

`src/runtime/mods.c`:

```c
/*
 * mods.c -- the player's mods, laid over res/. Port, not in the binary.
 *
 * A mod is a folder in <game>/mods/. Whatever it holds replaces the game file
 * of the same NAME, wherever the game keeps it and wherever the mod puts it:
 * mods/HD Kano/KANO_DIFFUSE.png stands in for res/Textures/KANO_DIFFUSE.pvr,
 * mods/Music/MainMenu.mp3 for res/audio/MainMenu.mp3. Sub-folders inside a
 * mod are only for its author's order.
 *
 * Which mods are on, and which wins when two have the same file, is the
 * launcher's MOD MANAGER, written to mods/mods.ini:
 *
 *     ; highest priority first
 *     on=HD Kano
 *     off=Old blood
 *     on=Music
 *
 * A folder the file does not name is on, below the named ones (a mod copied
 * in by hand works without the launcher). Everything is indexed once, at
 * start: the engine asks for thousands of files and a folder walk per ask
 * would show.
 *
 * Two kinds of file are answered:
 *
 *   - by full name (mods_find), from lime_platform.c's resolve(): every
 *     file the engine loads -- models (.meshset .skin .bones .skinanim),
 *     scenes, events, sounds (.wav), music (.mp3);
 *   - textures by stem (mods_find_texture), from draw_gl.c: the data names a
 *     sheet ".PNG" that is ".pvr" on disk, and a modder paints a .png, so a
 *     texture matches on its name without the extension.
 */
#include "mods.h"

#include <ctype.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#ifdef _WIN32
#include <windows.h>
#else
#include <dirent.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#endif

#define MOD_MAX      256
#define NAME_MAX_    128
#define PATH_MAX_    1100

typedef struct Entry {
    char *key;                  /* the file's name, lower case */
    char *path;
} Entry;

typedef struct Map {
    Entry *slot;
    size_t cap, used;
} Map;

static Map g_files;             /* "kano.skin" -> path */
static Map g_tex;               /* "kano_diffuse" -> path, pictures only */
static int g_mods_on;
static char g_on[MOD_MAX][PATH_MAX_];   /* the mods that are on, highest first */

static void lower(char *s)
{
    for (; *s; s++)
        *s = (char)tolower((unsigned char)*s);
}

static size_t hash(const char *s)
{
    size_t h = 2166136261u;
    for (; *s; s++)
        h = (h ^ (unsigned char)*s) * 16777619u;
    return h;
}

static void map_free(Map *m)
{
    size_t i;
    for (i = 0; i < m->cap; i++)
        if (m->slot[i].key) {
            free(m->slot[i].key);
            free(m->slot[i].path);
        }
    free(m->slot);
    memset(m, 0, sizeof(*m));
}

static const char *map_get(const Map *m, const char *key)
{
    size_t i;
    if (!m->cap)
        return NULL;
    for (i = hash(key) & (m->cap - 1); m->slot[i].key; i = (i + 1) & (m->cap - 1))
        if (strcmp(m->slot[i].key, key) == 0)
            return m->slot[i].path;
    return NULL;
}

/* the first mod to put a name in keeps it: they are walked highest first */
static void map_put(Map *m, const char *key, const char *path)
{
    size_t i;
    if (map_get(m, key))
        return;
    if ((m->used + 1) * 2 > m->cap) {
        Map big;
        big.cap = m->cap ? m->cap * 2 : 256;
        big.used = 0;
        big.slot = (Entry *)calloc(big.cap, sizeof(Entry));
        if (!big.slot)
            return;
        for (i = 0; i < m->cap; i++)
            if (m->slot[i].key) {
                size_t j = hash(m->slot[i].key) & (big.cap - 1);
                while (big.slot[j].key)
                    j = (j + 1) & (big.cap - 1);
                big.slot[j] = m->slot[i];
                big.used++;
            }
        free(m->slot);
        *m = big;
    }
    for (i = hash(key) & (m->cap - 1); m->slot[i].key; i = (i + 1) & (m->cap - 1))
        ;
    m->slot[i].key = (char *)malloc(strlen(key) + 1);
    m->slot[i].path = (char *)malloc(strlen(path) + 1);
    if (!m->slot[i].key || !m->slot[i].path) {
        free(m->slot[i].key);
        free(m->slot[i].path);
        m->slot[i].key = NULL;
        return;
    }
    strcpy(m->slot[i].key, key);
    strcpy(m->slot[i].path, path);
    m->used++;
}

static int is_picture(const char *lname)
{
    const char *dot = strrchr(lname, '.');
    return dot && (strcmp(dot, ".png") == 0 || strcmp(dot, ".pvr") == 0);
}

static void add_file(const char *dir, const char *name, int top)
{
    char key[NAME_MAX_], path[PATH_MAX_];
    if (strlen(name) >= sizeof(key))
        return;
    strcpy(key, name);
    lower(key);
    /* the mod's own card: its description and its picture in the launcher */
    if (top && (strcmp(key, "mod.ini") == 0 || strcmp(key, "data.ini") == 0
                || strncmp(key, "preview.", 8) == 0 || strncmp(key, "cover.", 6) == 0))
        return;
    snprintf(path, sizeof(path), "%s/%s", dir, name);
    map_put(&g_files, key, path);
    if (is_picture(key)) {
        *strrchr(key, '.') = 0;
        map_put(&g_tex, key, path);
    }
}

static void walk(const char *dir, int top, int depth)
{
    char sub[PATH_MAX_];
    if (depth > 8)
        return;
#ifdef _WIN32
    {
        WIN32_FIND_DATAA fd;
        HANDLE h;
        snprintf(sub, sizeof(sub), "%s/*", dir);
        h = FindFirstFileA(sub, &fd);
        if (h == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE)
            return;
        do {
            if (fd.cFileName[0] == '.')
                continue;
            if (fd.dwFileAttributes & FILE_ATTRIBUTE_DIRECTORY) {
                snprintf(sub, sizeof(sub), "%s/%s", dir, fd.cFileName);
                walk(sub, 0, depth + 1);
            } else
                add_file(dir, fd.cFileName, top);
        } while (FindNextFileA(h, &fd));
        FindClose(h);
    }
#else
    {
        DIR *d = opendir(dir);
        struct dirent *e;
        struct stat st;
        if (!d)
            return;
        while ((e = readdir(d)) != NULL) {
            if (e->d_name[0] == '.')
                continue;
            snprintf(sub, sizeof(sub), "%s/%s", dir, e->d_name);
            if (stat(sub, &st) != 0)
                continue;
            if (S_ISDIR(st.st_mode))
                walk(sub, 0, depth + 1);
            else
                add_file(dir, e->d_name, top);
        }
        closedir(d);
    }
#endif
}

/* the mod folders, for the ones mods.ini does not name */
static int list_dirs(const char *root, char names[][NAME_MAX_], int max)
{
    int n = 0;
#ifdef _WIN32
    WIN32_FIND_DATAA fd;
    HANDLE h;
    char pat[PATH_MAX_];
    snprintf(pat, sizeof(pat), "%s/*", root);
    h = FindFirstFileA(pat, &fd);
    if (h == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE)
        return 0;
    do {
        if (fd.cFileName[0] != '.' && (fd.dwFileAttributes & FILE_ATTRIBUTE_DIRECTORY)
                && strlen(fd.cFileName) < NAME_MAX_ && n < max)
            strcpy(names[n++], fd.cFileName);
    } while (FindNextFileA(h, &fd));
    FindClose(h);
#else
    DIR *d = opendir(root);
    struct dirent *e;
    struct stat st;
    char sub[PATH_MAX_];
    if (!d)
        return 0;
    while ((e = readdir(d)) != NULL && n < max) {
        if (e->d_name[0] == '.' || strlen(e->d_name) >= NAME_MAX_)
            continue;
        snprintf(sub, sizeof(sub), "%s/%s", root, e->d_name);
        if (stat(sub, &st) == 0 && S_ISDIR(st.st_mode))
            strcpy(names[n++], e->d_name);
    }
    closedir(d);
#endif
    return n;
}

void mods_init(const char *res_root)
{
    static char named[MOD_MAX][NAME_MAX_];
    static char dirs[MOD_MAX][NAME_MAX_];
    char root[PATH_MAX_], path[PATH_MAX_], line[512];
    int nnamed = 0, ndirs, i, j;
    FILE *f;

    map_free(&g_files);
    map_free(&g_tex);
    g_mods_on = 0;
    if (!res_root || !*res_root)
        return;
    snprintf(root, sizeof(root), "%s/../mods", res_root);

    snprintf(path, sizeof(path), "%s/mods.ini", root);
    f = fopen(path, "r");
    if (f) {
        while (fgets(line, sizeof(line), f) && nnamed < MOD_MAX) {
            char *v, *end;
            int on;
            line[strcspn(line, "\r\n")] = 0;
            if (strncmp(line, "on=", 3) == 0)
                on = 1, v = line + 3;
            else if (strncmp(line, "off=", 4) == 0)
                on = 0, v = line + 4;
            else
                continue;
            end = v + strlen(v);
            while (end > v && end[-1] == ' ')
                *--end = 0;
            if (!*v || strlen(v) >= NAME_MAX_ - 1 || strstr(v, "..") || strchr(v, '/') || strchr(v, '\\'))
                continue;
            /* the first character says on or off; the name follows */
            named[nnamed][0] = on ? '+' : '-';
            strcpy(named[nnamed] + 1, v);
            nnamed++;
        }
        fclose(f);
    }

    for (i = 0; i < nnamed; i++) {
        if (named[i][0] != '+')
            continue;
        snprintf(path, sizeof(path), "%s/%s", root, named[i] + 1);
        walk(path, 1, 0);
        snprintf(g_on[g_mods_on++], PATH_MAX_, "%s", path);
    }
    /* folders the file does not name: on, after the named ones */
    ndirs = list_dirs(root, dirs, MOD_MAX);
    for (i = 0; i < ndirs; i++) {
        int known = 0;
        for (j = 0; j < nnamed && !known; j++)
            known = strcmp(named[j] + 1, dirs[i]) == 0;
        if (known)
            continue;
        snprintf(path, sizeof(path), "%s/%s", root, dirs[i]);
        walk(path, 1, 0);
        if (g_mods_on < MOD_MAX)
            snprintf(g_on[g_mods_on++], PATH_MAX_, "%s", path);
    }
    if (g_mods_on)
        printf("mods: %d on, %d files\n", g_mods_on, (int)g_files.used);
}

int mods_find(const char *rel, char *out, size_t n)
{
    char key[NAME_MAX_];
    const char *base, *hit;
    if (!g_files.used || !rel)
        return 0;
    base = rel + strlen(rel);
    while (base > rel && base[-1] != '/' && base[-1] != '\\')
        base--;
    if (strlen(base) >= sizeof(key))
        return 0;
    strcpy(key, base);
    lower(key);
    hit = map_get(&g_files, key);
    if (!hit)
        return 0;
    snprintf(out, n, "%s", hit);
    return 1;
}

int mods_find_texture(const char *stem, char *out, size_t n)
{
    char key[NAME_MAX_];
    const char *base, *hit;
    size_t k;
    if (!g_tex.used || !stem)
        return 0;
    base = stem + strlen(stem);
    while (base > stem && base[-1] != '/' && base[-1] != '\\')
        base--;
    if (strlen(base) >= sizeof(key))
        return 0;
    strcpy(key, base);
    lower(key);
    hit = map_get(&g_tex, key);
    /* The smaller copies the game takes by quality: X_LOW (the iPhone's
     * sheets), X_LITE (a fighter's 256 skin, same layout) and X2_LITE,
     * X_LITE2, X_LOW2 (the second outfit's): a mod's X or X2 serves them */
    k = strlen(key);
    if (!hit && k > 4 && (strcmp(key + k - 4, "_low") == 0)) {
        key[k - 4] = 0;
        hit = map_get(&g_tex, key);
    } else if (!hit && k > 5 && strcmp(key + k - 5, "_lite") == 0) {
        key[k - 5] = 0;
        hit = map_get(&g_tex, key);
    } else if (!hit && k > 6 && (strcmp(key + k - 6, "_lite2") == 0
                                 || strcmp(key + k - 5, "_low2") == 0)) {
        strcpy(key + k - (key[k - 5] == '_' ? 5 : 6), "2");
        hit = map_get(&g_tex, key);
    }
    if (!hit)
        return 0;
    snprintf(out, n, "%s", hit);
    return 1;
}

int mods_count(int *files)
{
    if (files)
        *files = (int)g_files.used;
    return g_mods_on;
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------ data.ini
 *
 * A mod's numbers: the launcher's CHARACTER EDITOR writes them, one per line,
 *
 *     ; Kano's high kick: full damage 24 -> 30, chip 5
 *     stk_kano_hikick[5] = 0x1e05
 *
 * a table of the fight engine by its name in the binary (the registry
 * logic_tables.c ends with) and a word in it. Applied once at start, lowest
 * priority first so the highest wins. A word that holds an address is never
 * written: the editor offers only the number fields. Words are 32 bits in
 * both builds (the 64-bit one keeps the tables' words 32-bit, UMK3_LOW32). */
struct umk3_logic_name { const char *name; void *at; unsigned n; };
extern const struct umk3_logic_name umk3_logic_names[];
extern const unsigned umk3_logic_nnames;

static const struct umk3_logic_name *logic_name(const char *name)
{
    unsigned i;

    for (i = 0; i < umk3_logic_nnames; i++)
        if (strcmp(umk3_logic_names[i].name, name) == 0)
            return &umk3_logic_names[i];
    return NULL;
}

int mods_apply_data(void)
{
    char path[PATH_MAX_ + 16], line[512];
    int m, done = 0;

    for (m = g_mods_on - 1; m >= 0; m--) {
        FILE *f;

        snprintf(path, sizeof(path), "%s/data.ini", g_on[m]);
        f = fopen(path, "r");
        if (!f)
            continue;
        while (fgets(line, sizeof(line), f)) {
            char name[96], *p = line;
            const struct umk3_logic_name *t;
            unsigned long idx;
            long long v;
            int k = 0;

            while (*p == ' ' || *p == '\t')
                p++;
            if (*p == ';' || *p == '#' || !*p)
                continue;
            while (*p && *p != '[' && k < (int)sizeof(name) - 1)
                name[k++] = *p++;
            name[k] = 0;
            while (k && name[k - 1] == ' ')
                name[--k] = 0;
            if (*p != '[')
                continue;
            idx = strtoul(p + 1, &p, 0);
            if (*p != ']' || !(p = strchr(p, '=')))
                continue;
            v = strtoll(p + 1, NULL, 0);
            t = logic_name(name);
            if (!t || idx >= t->n) {
                printf("mods: %s: no %s[%lu]\n", path, name, idx);
                continue;
            }
            ((uint32_t *)t->at)[idx] = (uint32_t)v;
            done++;
        }
        fclose(f);
    }
    if (done)
        printf("mods: %d numbers changed\n", done);
    return done;
}
```

```h
/* mods.h -- the player's mods, laid over res/ (mods.c). Port, not in the
 * binary. */
#ifndef UMK3_MODS_H
#define UMK3_MODS_H

#include <stddef.h>

/* Reads <game>/mods/mods.ini and indexes every file of the mods it turns
 * on; `res_root` is the game's res/ folder. Called again, it starts over. */
void mods_init(const char *res_root);

/* The mod file that replaces `rel` (a path the engine asks for: "KANO.skin",
 * "res/audio/x.wav"), matched by its file name alone, any case. 1 and the
 * full path in `out`; 0 when no mod has it. */
int  mods_find(const char *rel, char *out, size_t n);

/* The mod picture for a texture named `stem` (no extension: "KANO_DIFFUSE"),
 * whatever its extension in the mod (.png or .pvr). The smaller copies the
 * game takes by quality are served by a mod's full one when it has no copy
 * of its own: X_LOW and X_LITE by X, X_LITE2 and X_LOW2 by X2. */
int  mods_find_texture(const char *stem, char *out, size_t n);

/* How many mods are on and how many files they replace, for the log. */
int  mods_count(int *files);

/* each mod's data.ini over the fight engine's tables, lowest first; returns
 * how many words it wrote */
int  mods_apply_data(void);

#endif
```

`src/runtime/mp_eos.c`:

```c
/*
 * mp_eos.c -- ONLINE over the internet, through Epic Online Services (EOS).
 * Port, not in the binary: the iPhone game only knew Bluetooth.
 *
 * The same design as Saints Reborn's (github.com/whompay/SaintsReborn,
 * core/WhompaysCoop/eos_link.h): the SDK's DLL is loaded when the game runs,
 * so the game starts without it; the login is anonymous, with the device id
 * EOS keeps for this computer (no Epic account); the product's ids are read
 * from eos.ini beside the exe, which the product's owner writes:
 *
 *   [eos]
 *   product=...      sandbox=...      deployment=...
 *   client_id=...    client_secret=...
 *
 * Finding a player by their code: while their ONLINE screen is open, their
 * game owns a lobby in the bucket "umk3:" + the code (letters and digits,
 * upper case). FIND MATCH searches that bucket and the lobby's owner is the
 * player to talk to. Nobody joins the lobby: it is only the directory. Then
 * mp_net.c's own packets go over EOS P2P, which crosses NATs (Epic's relays
 * when it has to), so there are no ports to open.
 *
 * Built with the SDK's headers only when they are on the computer
 * (UMK3_EOS, launcher/build_game.ps1); without them every call here says
 * MPEOS_OFF and the game plays on the local network alone.
 */
#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "mp_eos.h"

#ifndef UMK3_EOS

int  mpeos_state(void) { return MPEOS_OFF; }
void mpeos_start(void) {}
void mpeos_tick(void) {}
void mpeos_advertise(const char *code) { (void)code; }
void mpeos_unadvertise(void) {}
void mpeos_lookup(const char *code) { (void)code; }
int  mpeos_lookup_result(char *who, int n) { (void)who; (void)n; return -1; }
void mpeos_send(const char *who, const void *p, int n) { (void)who; (void)p; (void)n; }
int  mpeos_recv(char *who, int wn, void *buf, int max)
{ (void)who; (void)wn; (void)buf; (void)max; return 0; }

#else

#include <stdlib.h>
#ifdef _WIN32
#include <windows.h>
#define EOS_LIB   "EOSSDK-Win64-Shipping.dll"
#define SEP       "\\"
#define lib_open(p)     ((void *)LoadLibraryA(p))
#define lib_sym(h, n)   ((void *)GetProcAddress((HMODULE)(h), n))
#define make_dir(p)     CreateDirectoryA(p, NULL)
static unsigned ticks(void) { return (unsigned)GetTickCount(); }
#else
#include <dlfcn.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <time.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#define EOS_LIB   "libEOSSDK-Linux-Shipping.so"
#define SEP       "/"
#define MAX_PATH  4096
#define lib_open(p)     dlopen(p, RTLD_NOW | RTLD_LOCAL)
#define lib_sym(h, n)   dlsym(h, n)
#define make_dir(p)     mkdir(p, 0755)
static unsigned ticks(void)
{
    struct timespec t;
    clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &t);
    return (unsigned)(t.tv_sec * 1000u + t.tv_nsec / 1000000u);
}
#endif

#include "eos_sdk.h"
#include "eos_logging.h"
#include "eos_connect.h"
#include "eos_lobby.h"
#include "eos_p2p.h"

#define SOCKET_NAME "UMK3"

/* The DLL's functions, looked up by name. */
#define EOS_FUNCS(X) \
    X(EOS_Initialize) X(EOS_Platform_Create) X(EOS_Platform_Tick) \
    X(EOS_Platform_GetConnectInterface) X(EOS_Platform_GetLobbyInterface) \
    X(EOS_Platform_GetP2PInterface) X(EOS_Logging_SetCallback) \
    X(EOS_Logging_SetLogLevel) X(EOS_EResult_ToString) \
    X(EOS_ProductUserId_ToString) X(EOS_ProductUserId_FromString) \
    X(EOS_Connect_CreateDeviceId) X(EOS_Connect_DeleteDeviceId) X(EOS_Connect_Login) X(EOS_Connect_CreateUser) \
    X(EOS_Lobby_CreateLobby) X(EOS_Lobby_DestroyLobby) \
    X(EOS_Lobby_CreateLobbySearch) X(EOS_LobbySearch_SetParameter) \
    X(EOS_LobbySearch_Find) X(EOS_LobbySearch_GetSearchResultCount) \
    X(EOS_LobbySearch_CopySearchResultByIndex) X(EOS_LobbySearch_Release) \
    X(EOS_LobbyDetails_GetLobbyOwner) X(EOS_LobbyDetails_Release) \
    X(EOS_P2P_SendPacket) X(EOS_P2P_ReceivePacket) \
    X(EOS_P2P_GetNextReceivedPacketSize) X(EOS_P2P_AcceptConnection) \
    X(EOS_P2P_AddNotifyPeerConnectionRequest)

#define DECL(f) static __typeof__(f) *p_##f;
EOS_FUNCS(DECL)
#undef DECL

static int g_state = MPEOS_OFF;
static int g_tried;
static EOS_HPlatform  g_plat;
static EOS_HConnect   g_conn;
static EOS_HLobby     g_lobby;
static EOS_HP2P       g_p2p;
static EOS_ProductUserId g_me;
static EOS_P2P_SocketId  g_socket;

/* eos.ini */
static char k_product[64], k_sandbox[64], k_deploy[64], k_id[96], k_secret[96];

/* the lobby that says "this code is here" */
static char g_adv_want[24];             /* the bucket wanted, "" for none */
static char g_adv_have[24];             /* the bucket of g_lobby_id */
static char g_lobby_id[128];
static int  g_lobby_busy;               /* a create or destroy in flight */

/* FIND MATCH */
static int  g_look_pending;             /* asked before the login finished */
static char g_look_bucket[24];
static int  g_look_result;              /* 0 asking, 1 found, -1 none */
static char g_look_who[40];

static void bucket_of(const char *code, char *out, int n)
{
    int k = snprintf(out, (size_t)n, "umk3:");
    for (; *code && k < n - 1; code++) {
        int c = (unsigned char)*code;
        if (c >= 'a' && c <= 'z')
            c -= 32;
        if ((c >= '0' && c <= '9') || (c >= 'A' && c <= 'Z'))
            out[k++] = (char)c;
    }
    out[k] = 0;
}

static const char *res(EOS_EResult r)
{
    return p_EOS_EResult_ToString ? p_EOS_EResult_ToString(r) : "?";
}

static void id_string(EOS_ProductUserId u, char *out, int n)
{
    int32_t len = n;
    out[0] = 0;
    if (!u || p_EOS_ProductUserId_ToString(u, out, &len) != EOS_Success)
        out[0] = 0;
}

static void EOS_CALL on_log(const EOS_LogMessage *m)
{
    printf("eos: %s: %s\n", m->Category, m->Message);
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------- eos.ini */

static void exe_dir(char *out, int n)
{
    char *s;
#ifdef _WIN32
    DWORD k = GetModuleFileNameA(NULL, out, (DWORD)n);
    if (k == 0 || k >= (DWORD)n) {
        out[0] = 0;
        return;
    }
    s = strrchr(out, '\\');
#else
    ssize_t k = readlink("/proc/self/exe", out, (size_t)n - 1);
    if (k <= 0) {
        out[0] = 0;
        return;
    }
    out[k] = 0;
    s = strrchr(out, '/');
#endif
    if (s)
        s[1] = 0;
}

static void trim(char *s)
{
    char *e = s + strlen(s);
    while (e > s && (e[-1] == ' ' || e[-1] == '\t' || e[-1] == '\r' || e[-1] == '\n'))
        *--e = 0;
}

static int read_ini(const char *dir)
{
    char path[MAX_PATH + 16], line[256];
    FILE *f;

    snprintf(path, sizeof path, "%seos.ini", dir);
    f = fopen(path, "r");
    if (!f) {
        printf("online: no eos.ini beside the exe: internet play is off\n");
        return 0;
    }
    while (fgets(line, sizeof line, f)) {
        char *v = strchr(line, '='), *k = line;
        if (!v || line[0] == '[' || line[0] == ';' || line[0] == '#')
            continue;
        *v++ = 0;
        while (*k == ' ' || *k == '\t') k++;
        while (*v == ' ' || *v == '\t') v++;
        trim(k);
        trim(v);
#define KEY(name, dst) if (!strcmp(k, name)) snprintf(dst, sizeof dst, "%s", v);
        KEY("product", k_product) KEY("sandbox", k_sandbox)
        KEY("deployment", k_deploy) KEY("client_id", k_id)
        KEY("client_secret", k_secret)
#undef KEY
    }
    fclose(f);
    if (!k_product[0] || !k_sandbox[0] || !k_deploy[0] || !k_id[0] || !k_secret[0]) {
        printf("online: eos.ini is missing product, sandbox, deployment, "
               "client_id or client_secret: internet play is off\n");
        return 0;
    }
    return 1;
}

/* --------------------------------------------------------------- lobby */

static void lobby_step(void);

static void EOS_CALL on_destroyed(const EOS_Lobby_DestroyLobbyCallbackInfo *d)
{
    (void)d;
    g_lobby_busy = 0;
    lobby_step();
}

static void EOS_CALL on_created(const EOS_Lobby_CreateLobbyCallbackInfo *d)
{
    g_lobby_busy = 0;
    if (d->ResultCode != EOS_Success) {
        printf("online: EOS lobby not created: %s\n", res(d->ResultCode));
        g_adv_have[0] = 0;
        g_adv_want[0] = 0;              /* not again every frame */
        return;
    }
    snprintf(g_lobby_id, sizeof g_lobby_id, "%s", d->LobbyId);
    printf("online: findable over the internet (%s)\n", g_adv_have);
    lobby_step();
}

/* Brings the lobby in line with g_adv_want, one call at a time. */
static void lobby_step(void)
{
    if (g_state != MPEOS_READY || g_lobby_busy)
        return;
    if (g_lobby_id[0] && strcmp(g_adv_have, g_adv_want) != 0) {
        EOS_Lobby_DestroyLobbyOptions o;
        memset(&o, 0, sizeof o);
        o.ApiVersion = EOS_LOBBY_DESTROYLOBBY_API_LATEST;
        o.LocalUserId = g_me;
        o.LobbyId = g_lobby_id;
        g_lobby_busy = 1;
        p_EOS_Lobby_DestroyLobby(g_lobby, &o, NULL, on_destroyed);
        g_lobby_id[0] = 0;
        g_adv_have[0] = 0;
        return;
    }
    if (!g_lobby_id[0] && g_adv_want[0]) {
        EOS_Lobby_CreateLobbyOptions o;
        memset(&o, 0, sizeof o);
        o.ApiVersion = EOS_LOBBY_CREATELOBBY_API_LATEST;
        o.LocalUserId = g_me;
        o.MaxLobbyMembers = 2;
        o.PermissionLevel = EOS_LPL_PUBLICADVERTISED;
        o.bPresenceEnabled = EOS_FALSE;
        o.bAllowInvites = EOS_FALSE;
        o.BucketId = g_adv_want;
        o.bDisableHostMigration = EOS_TRUE;
        snprintf(g_adv_have, sizeof g_adv_have, "%s", g_adv_want);
        g_lobby_busy = 1;
        p_EOS_Lobby_CreateLobby(g_lobby, &o, NULL, on_created);
    }
}

void mpeos_advertise(const char *code)
{
    bucket_of(code, g_adv_want, sizeof g_adv_want);
    lobby_step();
}

void mpeos_unadvertise(void)
{
    g_adv_want[0] = 0;
    lobby_step();
}

/* -------------------------------------------------------------- lookup */

static void EOS_CALL on_found(const EOS_LobbySearch_FindCallbackInfo *d)
{
    EOS_HLobbySearch s = (EOS_HLobbySearch)d->ClientData;
    EOS_LobbySearch_GetSearchResultCountOptions c;
    EOS_LobbySearch_CopySearchResultByIndexOptions ci;
    EOS_LobbyDetails_GetLobbyOwnerOptions oo;
    EOS_HLobbyDetails det = NULL;
    uint32_t i, n;

    if (g_look_result != 0)             /* a newer search took its place */
        goto done;
    if (d->ResultCode != EOS_Success) {
        printf("online: EOS search: %s\n", res(d->ResultCode));
        g_look_result = -1;
        goto done;
    }
    memset(&c, 0, sizeof c);
    c.ApiVersion = EOS_LOBBYSEARCH_GETSEARCHRESULTCOUNT_API_LATEST;
    n = p_EOS_LobbySearch_GetSearchResultCount(s, &c);
    g_look_result = -1;
    for (i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        char who[40];
        memset(&ci, 0, sizeof ci);
        ci.ApiVersion = EOS_LOBBYSEARCH_COPYSEARCHRESULTBYINDEX_API_LATEST;
        ci.LobbyIndex = i;
        if (p_EOS_LobbySearch_CopySearchResultByIndex(s, &ci, &det) != EOS_Success)
            continue;
        memset(&oo, 0, sizeof oo);
        oo.ApiVersion = EOS_LOBBYDETAILS_GETLOBBYOWNER_API_LATEST;
        id_string(p_EOS_LobbyDetails_GetLobbyOwner(det, &oo), who, sizeof who);
        p_EOS_LobbyDetails_Release(det);
        if (who[0]) {
            char mine[40];
            id_string(g_me, mine, sizeof mine);
            if (!strcmp(who, mine))     /* a lobby of ours left over */
                continue;
            snprintf(g_look_who, sizeof g_look_who, "%s", who);
            g_look_result = 1;
            printf("online: found over the internet (%s)\n", who);
            break;
        }
    }
done:
    p_EOS_LobbySearch_Release(s);
}

static void look_now(void)
{
    EOS_Lobby_CreateLobbySearchOptions o;
    EOS_LobbySearch_SetParameterOptions sp;
    EOS_LobbySearch_FindOptions fo;
    EOS_Lobby_AttributeData a;
    EOS_HLobbySearch s = NULL;

    g_look_pending = 0;
    memset(&o, 0, sizeof o);
    o.ApiVersion = EOS_LOBBY_CREATELOBBYSEARCH_API_LATEST;
    o.MaxResults = 4;
    if (p_EOS_Lobby_CreateLobbySearch(g_lobby, &o, &s) != EOS_Success) {
        g_look_result = -1;
        return;
    }
    memset(&a, 0, sizeof a);
    a.ApiVersion = EOS_LOBBY_ATTRIBUTEDATA_API_LATEST;
    a.Key = EOS_LOBBY_SEARCH_BUCKET_ID;
    a.Value.AsUtf8 = g_look_bucket;
    a.ValueType = EOS_AT_STRING;
    memset(&sp, 0, sizeof sp);
    sp.ApiVersion = EOS_LOBBYSEARCH_SETPARAMETER_API_LATEST;
    sp.Parameter = &a;
    sp.ComparisonOp = EOS_CO_EQUAL;
    p_EOS_LobbySearch_SetParameter(s, &sp);
    memset(&fo, 0, sizeof fo);
    fo.ApiVersion = EOS_LOBBYSEARCH_FIND_API_LATEST;
    fo.LocalUserId = g_me;
    p_EOS_LobbySearch_Find(s, &fo, s, on_found);
}

void mpeos_lookup(const char *code)
{
    bucket_of(code, g_look_bucket, sizeof g_look_bucket);
    g_look_result = 0;
    g_look_who[0] = 0;
    if (g_state == MPEOS_READY)
        look_now();
    else if (g_state == MPEOS_STARTING)
        g_look_pending = 1;
    else
        g_look_result = -1;
}

int mpeos_lookup_result(char *who, int n)
{
    if (g_look_result == 1)
        snprintf(who, (size_t)n, "%s", g_look_who);
    return g_look_result;
}

/* ----------------------------------------------------------------- P2P */

static void EOS_CALL on_request(const EOS_P2P_OnIncomingConnectionRequestInfo *d)
{
    EOS_P2P_AcceptConnectionOptions o;

    if (!d->SocketId || strcmp(d->SocketId->SocketName, SOCKET_NAME) != 0)
        return;
    memset(&o, 0, sizeof o);
    o.ApiVersion = EOS_P2P_ACCEPTCONNECTION_API_LATEST;
    o.LocalUserId = g_me;
    o.RemoteUserId = d->RemoteUserId;
    o.SocketId = &g_socket;
    p_EOS_P2P_AcceptConnection(g_p2p, &o);
}

void mpeos_send(const char *who, const void *p, int n)
{
    EOS_P2P_SendPacketOptions o;
    EOS_ProductUserId to;
    EOS_EResult r;

    if (g_state != MPEOS_READY || !who[0] || n <= 0 || n > EOS_P2P_MAX_PACKET_SIZE)
        return;
    to = p_EOS_ProductUserId_FromString(who);
    if (!to)
        return;
    memset(&o, 0, sizeof o);
    o.ApiVersion = EOS_P2P_SENDPACKET_API_LATEST;
    o.LocalUserId = g_me;
    o.RemoteUserId = to;
    o.SocketId = &g_socket;
    o.Channel = 0;
    o.DataLengthBytes = (uint32_t)n;
    o.Data = p;
    o.bAllowDelayedDelivery = EOS_TRUE; /* held until the connection is up */
    o.Reliability = EOS_PR_UnreliableUnordered;
    r = p_EOS_P2P_SendPacket(g_p2p, &o);
    if (r != EOS_Success) {
        static unsigned last;
        if (ticks() - last > 2000) {
            last = ticks();
            printf("online: EOS send: %s\n", res(r));
        }
    }
}

int mpeos_recv(char *who, int wn, void *buf, int max)
{
    EOS_P2P_GetNextReceivedPacketSizeOptions so;
    EOS_P2P_ReceivePacketOptions ro;
    EOS_ProductUserId from = NULL;
    EOS_P2P_SocketId sock;
    uint8_t ch = 0;
    uint32_t size = 0, got = 0;

    if (g_state != MPEOS_READY)
        return 0;
    memset(&so, 0, sizeof so);
    so.ApiVersion = EOS_P2P_GETNEXTRECEIVEDPACKETSIZE_API_LATEST;
    so.LocalUserId = g_me;
    if (p_EOS_P2P_GetNextReceivedPacketSize(g_p2p, &so, &size) != EOS_Success)
        return 0;
    memset(&ro, 0, sizeof ro);
    ro.ApiVersion = EOS_P2P_RECEIVEPACKET_API_LATEST;
    ro.LocalUserId = g_me;
    ro.MaxDataSizeBytes = (uint32_t)max;
    memset(&sock, 0, sizeof sock);
    if (p_EOS_P2P_ReceivePacket(g_p2p, &ro, &from, &sock, &ch, buf, &got) != EOS_Success)
        return 0;
    if (strcmp(sock.SocketName, SOCKET_NAME) != 0 || size > (uint32_t)max)
        return -1;                      /* not ours, or cut: skip it */
    id_string(from, who, wn);
    return (int)got;
}

/* --------------------------------------------------------------- login */

static void logged_in(EOS_ProductUserId u)
{
    EOS_P2P_AddNotifyPeerConnectionRequestOptions n;
    char s[40];

    g_me = u;
    g_state = MPEOS_READY;
    id_string(u, s, sizeof s);
    printf("online: EOS ready (%s)\n", s);
    memset(&n, 0, sizeof n);
    n.ApiVersion = EOS_P2P_ADDNOTIFYPEERCONNECTIONREQUEST_API_LATEST;
    n.LocalUserId = g_me;
    n.SocketId = &g_socket;
    p_EOS_P2P_AddNotifyPeerConnectionRequest(g_p2p, &n, NULL, on_request);
    lobby_step();
    if (g_look_pending)
        look_now();
}

static void fail(const char *what, EOS_EResult r)
{
    printf("online: EOS %s: %s; internet play is off\n", what, res(r));
    g_state = MPEOS_FAILED;
    if (g_look_pending) {
        g_look_pending = 0;
        g_look_result = -1;
    }
}

static void EOS_CALL on_user(const EOS_Connect_CreateUserCallbackInfo *d)
{
    if (d->ResultCode == EOS_Success)
        logged_in(d->LocalUserId);
    else
        fail("create user", d->ResultCode);
}

static void EOS_CALL on_login(const EOS_Connect_LoginCallbackInfo *d)
{
    if (d->ResultCode == EOS_Success) {
        logged_in(d->LocalUserId);
    } else if (d->ResultCode == EOS_InvalidUser && d->ContinuanceToken) {
        /* first time on this computer: make the user */
        EOS_Connect_CreateUserOptions o;
        memset(&o, 0, sizeof o);
        o.ApiVersion = EOS_CONNECT_CREATEUSER_API_LATEST;
        o.ContinuanceToken = d->ContinuanceToken;
        p_EOS_Connect_CreateUser(g_conn, &o, NULL, on_user);
    } else {
        fail("login", d->ResultCode);
    }
}

static void login(void)
{
    static EOS_Connect_Credentials c;
    static EOS_Connect_UserLoginInfo u;
    EOS_Connect_LoginOptions o;

    memset(&c, 0, sizeof c);
    c.ApiVersion = EOS_CONNECT_CREDENTIALS_API_LATEST;
    c.Token = NULL;
    c.Type = EOS_ECT_DEVICEID_ACCESS_TOKEN;
    memset(&u, 0, sizeof u);
    u.ApiVersion = EOS_CONNECT_USERLOGININFO_API_LATEST;
    u.DisplayName = "UMK3 Player";
    memset(&o, 0, sizeof o);
    o.ApiVersion = EOS_CONNECT_LOGIN_API_LATEST;
    o.Credentials = &c;
    o.UserLoginInfo = &u;
    p_EOS_Connect_Login(g_conn, &o, NULL, on_login);
}

static void EOS_CALL on_device(const EOS_Connect_CreateDeviceIdCallbackInfo *d)
{
    /* DuplicateNotAllowed: this computer has its device id already */
    if (d->ResultCode == EOS_Success || d->ResultCode == EOS_DuplicateNotAllowed)
        login();
    else
        fail("device id", d->ResultCode);
}

/* UMK3_EOS_NEW_DEVICE: the old id is gone, make the new one */
static void EOS_CALL on_deleted(const EOS_Connect_DeleteDeviceIdCallbackInfo *d)
{
    EOS_Connect_CreateDeviceIdOptions dv;

    (void)d;
    memset(&dv, 0, sizeof dv);
    dv.ApiVersion = EOS_CONNECT_CREATEDEVICEID_API_LATEST;
    dv.DeviceModel = "PC";
    p_EOS_Connect_CreateDeviceId(g_conn, &dv, NULL, on_device);
}

/* The SDK's memory comes from a heap of its own, above the game's: the 64-bit
 * game keeps its memory below 2 GB in arenas of its own (savestate.c,
 * lime_platform.c), and nothing of the SDK's should land in or near them. */
#ifdef _WIN32
static HANDLE g_eos_heap;
static void *EOS_MEMORY_CALL eos_alloc(size_t n, size_t align)
{
    unsigned char *raw, *p;
    if (!g_eos_heap)
        g_eos_heap = HeapCreate(0, 0, 0);
    if (align < 16)
        align = 16;
    raw = (unsigned char *)HeapAlloc(g_eos_heap, 0, n + align + sizeof(void *));
    if (!raw)
        return NULL;
    p = (unsigned char *)(((uintptr_t)raw + sizeof(void *) + align - 1) & ~(uintptr_t)(align - 1));
    ((void **)p)[-1] = raw;
    return p;
}
static void EOS_MEMORY_CALL eos_release(void *p)
{
    if (p)
        HeapFree(g_eos_heap, 0, ((void **)p)[-1]);
}
static void *EOS_MEMORY_CALL eos_realloc(void *p, size_t n, size_t align)
{
    void *q;
    size_t old;
    if (!p)
        return eos_alloc(n, align);
    q = eos_alloc(n, align);
    if (!q)
        return NULL;
    old = HeapSize(g_eos_heap, 0, ((void **)p)[-1])
          - (size_t)((unsigned char *)p - (unsigned char *)((void **)p)[-1]);
    memcpy(q, p, old < n ? old : n);
    eos_release(p);
    return q;
}
#else
static void *EOS_MEMORY_CALL eos_alloc(size_t n, size_t align)
{
    void *p = NULL;
    if (align < sizeof(void *))
        align = sizeof(void *);
    return posix_memalign(&p, align, n) == 0 ? p : NULL;
}
static void EOS_MEMORY_CALL eos_release(void *p) { free(p); }
static void *EOS_MEMORY_CALL eos_realloc(void *p, size_t n, size_t align)
{
    (void)align;
    return realloc(p, n);
}
#endif

void mpeos_start(void)
{
    char dir[MAX_PATH], dll[MAX_PATH + 32], cache[MAX_PATH + 32];
    const char *sd;
    void *h;
    EOS_InitializeOptions io;
    EOS_Platform_Options po;
    EOS_Connect_CreateDeviceIdOptions dv;
    EOS_EResult r;

    if (g_tried)
        return;
    g_tried = 1;
    exe_dir(dir, sizeof dir);
    snprintf(dll, sizeof dll, "%s" EOS_LIB, dir);
    h = lib_open(dll);
    if (!h) {
        printf("online: no " EOS_LIB " beside the exe: internet play is off\n");
        return;
    }
#define LOOK(f) p_##f = (__typeof__(f) *)lib_sym(h, #f); \
    if (!p_##f) { printf("online: the EOS DLL has no " #f "\n"); return; }
    EOS_FUNCS(LOOK)
#undef LOOK
    if (!read_ini(dir))
        return;

    memset(&io, 0, sizeof io);
    io.ApiVersion = EOS_INITIALIZE_API_LATEST;
    io.AllocateMemoryFunction = eos_alloc;
    io.ReallocateMemoryFunction = eos_realloc;
    io.ReleaseMemoryFunction = eos_release;
    io.ProductName = "UMK3 PC port";
    io.ProductVersion = "1.2.59";
    r = p_EOS_Initialize(&io);
    if (r != EOS_Success && r != EOS_AlreadyConfigured) {
        fail("initialize", r);
        return;
    }
    p_EOS_Logging_SetCallback(on_log);
    p_EOS_Logging_SetLogLevel(EOS_LC_ALL_CATEGORIES, EOS_LOG_Warning);

    /* the cache beside the save folder, one per game (two on one PC) */
    sd = getenv("UMK3_SAVE_DIR");
    if (sd && sd[0])
        snprintf(cache, sizeof cache, "%s" SEP "eos", sd);
    else
        snprintf(cache, sizeof cache, "%ssave" SEP "eos", dir);
    make_dir(cache);

    memset(&po, 0, sizeof po);
    po.ApiVersion = EOS_PLATFORM_OPTIONS_API_LATEST;
    po.ProductId = k_product;
    po.SandboxId = k_sandbox;
    po.DeploymentId = k_deploy;
    po.ClientCredentials.ClientId = k_id;
    po.ClientCredentials.ClientSecret = k_secret;
    po.bIsServer = EOS_FALSE;
    po.Flags = EOS_PF_DISABLE_OVERLAY;
    po.CacheDirectory = cache;
    g_plat = p_EOS_Platform_Create(&po);
    if (!g_plat) {
        fail("platform", EOS_UnexpectedError);
        return;
    }
    g_conn = p_EOS_Platform_GetConnectInterface(g_plat);
    g_lobby = p_EOS_Platform_GetLobbyInterface(g_plat);
    g_p2p = p_EOS_Platform_GetP2PInterface(g_plat);
    memset(&g_socket, 0, sizeof g_socket);
    g_socket.ApiVersion = EOS_P2P_SOCKETID_API_LATEST;
    snprintf(g_socket.SocketName, sizeof g_socket.SocketName, "%s", SOCKET_NAME);

    g_state = MPEOS_STARTING;
    /* Test aid: two games on one PC share the device id, so they would be
     * one EOS user and could not reach each other. UMK3_EOS_NEW_DEVICE=1
     * drops the stored id first and makes another (a game already running
     * keeps the one it logged in with). */
    sd = getenv("UMK3_EOS_NEW_DEVICE");
    if (sd && sd[0] == '1') {
        EOS_Connect_DeleteDeviceIdOptions del;
        memset(&del, 0, sizeof del);
        del.ApiVersion = EOS_CONNECT_DELETEDEVICEID_API_LATEST;
        p_EOS_Connect_DeleteDeviceId(g_conn, &del, NULL, on_deleted);
        return;
    }
    memset(&dv, 0, sizeof dv);
    dv.ApiVersion = EOS_CONNECT_CREATEDEVICEID_API_LATEST;
    dv.DeviceModel = "PC";
    p_EOS_Connect_CreateDeviceId(g_conn, &dv, NULL, on_device);
}

void mpeos_tick(void)
{
    if (g_plat)
        p_EOS_Platform_Tick(g_plat);
}

int mpeos_state(void) { return g_state; }

#endif
```

```h
/* mp_eos.h -- ONLINE over the internet, through Epic Online Services. Port,
 * not in the binary: what mp_net.c uses to reach a player outside the local
 * network. See mp_eos.c. */
#ifndef UMK3_MP_EOS_H
#define UMK3_MP_EOS_H

enum { MPEOS_OFF,                       /* no SDK in the build, no DLL or no eos.ini */
       MPEOS_STARTING,                  /* logging in */
       MPEOS_READY,
       MPEOS_FAILED };

int  mpeos_state(void);
/* Loads the DLL and logs in, once; later calls do nothing. */
void mpeos_start(void);
/* Once a frame: EOS_Platform_Tick, which runs the callbacks. */
void mpeos_tick(void);

/* While the ONLINE screen is open, this game can be found by its code. */
void mpeos_advertise(const char *code);
void mpeos_unadvertise(void);

/* Who has this code? mpeos_lookup_result: 0 still asking, 1 found (`who`
 * is their EOS user, a string for mpeos_send), -1 nobody. */
void mpeos_lookup(const char *code);
int  mpeos_lookup_result(char *who, int n);

/* Datagrams to and from an EOS user, unreliable: mp_net.c's own channel
 * does the acknowledging, as over UDP. mpeos_recv returns the bytes, 0 when
 * nothing is waiting. */
void mpeos_send(const char *who, const void *p, int n);
int  mpeos_recv(char *who, int wn, void *buf, int max);

#endif
```

`src/runtime/mp_net.c`:

```c
/*
 * mp_net.c -- the network session under the game's multiplayer code. Port,
 * not in the binary.
 *
 * The iPhone game kept its multiplayer in two files. limeMPGameSpecific.m is
 * plain C -- the packets, the heartbeat, the sync, the sprite-list queue --
 * and is transcribed in decomp/gamecode/limeMPGameSpecific.c. limeMPSession.m
 * is an Objective-C class around GKSession, Apple's Bluetooth peer-to-peer
 * session, and that is what this file replaces: the C file asks "is there a
 * session", "am I the server", "send this packet", and the answers come from
 * here instead of from GameKit.
 *
 * What the original put on the wire is kept: every game packet is a 4-byte
 * big-endian type followed by its payload, sent reliably except the sprite
 * lists (5) and the joystick (6), which went unreliable. GKSession gave
 * reliable delivery itself; UDP does not, so reliable packets carry a
 * sequence number here, are acknowledged, sent again until they are, and
 * handed over in order.
 *
 * ## Finding the other player
 *
 * The ONLINE screen (FrontEnd.c, FE_Task_Online) opens a session. FIND MATCH
 * asks for a player by their code -- the id in their profiles.ini -- and the
 * game with that code, if its ONLINE screen is open, answers and hosts. The
 * question goes two ways at once: to the games on this computer and on the
 * local network (UDP ports 27560-27575, broadcast), and over the internet
 * through Epic Online Services (mp_eos.c), where the game with the ONLINE
 * screen open owns a lobby named after its code. Whichever answers is the
 * link, and the same messages go over either: over EOS they are P2P
 * datagrams, acknowledged here exactly as over UDP.
 */

#ifdef _WIN32
#include <winsock2.h>
#include <ws2tcpip.h>
#else
#ifndef _POSIX_C_SOURCE
#define _POSIX_C_SOURCE 200112L
#endif
#include <arpa/inet.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <netinet/in.h>
#include <sys/socket.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#define closesocket close
typedef int SOCKET;
#define INVALID_SOCKET (-1)
#endif
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <time.h>

#include "mp_eos.h"
#include "mp_net.h"
#include "profiles.h"

/* limeMPGameSpecific.c */
void processPacket(const void *payload, long len, long type);
void disconnected(void);
void endMP(void);

#define PORT_FIRST    27560
#define PORT_COUNT    16
#define MAX_PACKET    1400
#define RESEND_MS     120
#define JOIN_MS       400
#define FIND_MS       10000             /* "not found" after ten seconds */
#define FIND_EOS_MS   30000             /* found over the internet: thirty */
#define KEEP_MS       1000
#define LINK_LOST_MS  15000
#define WINDOW        256               /* reliable packets in flight */

enum { K_JOIN = 1, K_ACCEPT, K_BUSY, K_DATA_U, K_DATA_R, K_ACK, K_BYE, K_KEEP };

static SOCKET   g_sock = INVALID_SOCKET;
static int      g_port;
static int      g_session;              /* gSession exists */
static int      g_connected;
static int      g_server;
static int      g_status = MPNET_IDLE;
/* Where a message came from or goes: a UDP address, or an EOS user. */
struct paddr { int eos; struct sockaddr_in in; char who[40]; };
static struct paddr g_peer_addr;
static char     g_eos_target[40];       /* the code's owner, from the lobby search */
static struct mpnet_peer g_peer;
static char     g_want[16];             /* the code FIND MATCH asked for */
static unsigned g_find_start, g_join_last, g_keep_last, g_heard;

/* reliable channel */
struct pend { int used; uint32_t seq; unsigned sent; int len;
              unsigned char buf[MAX_PACKET]; };
static struct pend g_out[WINDOW];
static uint32_t g_out_seq;              /* next to send */
static uint32_t g_in_next;              /* next to hand over */
struct held { int used; uint32_t seq; int len; unsigned char buf[MAX_PACKET]; };
static struct held g_in[WINDOW];

static unsigned now_ms(void)
{
#ifdef _WIN32
    return (unsigned)GetTickCount();
#else
    struct timespec t;
    clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &t);
    return (unsigned)(t.tv_sec * 1000u + t.tv_nsec / 1000000u);
#endif
}

static void put32(unsigned char *p, uint32_t v)
{ p[0] = v; p[1] = v >> 8; p[2] = v >> 16; p[3] = v >> 24; }
static uint32_t get32(const unsigned char *p)
{ return p[0] | p[1] << 8 | p[2] << 16 | (uint32_t)p[3] << 24; }

static void hdr(unsigned char *p, int kind)
{ p[0] = 'U'; p[1] = '3'; p[2] = (unsigned char)kind; p[3] = 1; }

/* ------------------------------------------------------------- socket */

static int sock_open(void)
{
    struct sockaddr_in a;
    int i, on = 1;

    if (g_sock != INVALID_SOCKET)
        return 1;
#ifdef _WIN32
    {
        static int up;
        WSADATA w;
        if (!up && WSAStartup(MAKEWORD(2, 2), &w) != 0)
            return 0;
        up = 1;
    }
#endif
    g_sock = socket(AF_INET, SOCK_DGRAM, IPPROTO_UDP);
    if (g_sock == INVALID_SOCKET)
        return 0;
    setsockopt(g_sock, SOL_SOCKET, SO_BROADCAST, (const char *)&on, sizeof on);
#ifdef _WIN32
    {
        u_long nb = 1;
        ioctlsocket(g_sock, FIONBIO, &nb);
    }
#else
    fcntl(g_sock, F_SETFL, fcntl(g_sock, F_GETFL) | O_NONBLOCK);
#endif
    for (i = 0; i < PORT_COUNT; i++) {
        memset(&a, 0, sizeof a);
        a.sin_family = AF_INET;
        a.sin_addr.s_addr = htonl(INADDR_ANY);
        a.sin_port = htons((unsigned short)(PORT_FIRST + i));
        if (bind(g_sock, (struct sockaddr *)&a, sizeof a) == 0) {
            g_port = PORT_FIRST + i;
            printf("online: listening on UDP %d\n", g_port);
            return 1;
        }
    }
    printf("online: no free UDP port in %d-%d\n", PORT_FIRST,
           PORT_FIRST + PORT_COUNT - 1);
    closesocket(g_sock);
    g_sock = INVALID_SOCKET;
    return 0;
}

static void sock_close(void)
{
    if (g_sock != INVALID_SOCKET)
        closesocket(g_sock);
    g_sock = INVALID_SOCKET;
    g_port = 0;
}

static void send_in(const struct sockaddr_in *a, const void *p, int n)
{
    if (g_sock != INVALID_SOCKET)
        sendto(g_sock, (const char *)p, n, 0, (const struct sockaddr *)a,
               sizeof *a);
}

static void send_to(const struct paddr *a, const void *p, int n)
{
    if (a->eos)
        mpeos_send(a->who, p, n);
    else
        send_in(&a->in, p, n);
}

static void send_peer(const void *p, int n) { send_to(&g_peer_addr, p, n); }

/* ---------------------------------------------------------- profile */

#define INFO_BYTES (16 + 100 + 16)

static void info_put(unsigned char *p)
{
    const struct profile *pr = prof_get();

    memset(p, 0, INFO_BYTES);
    if (!pr)
        return;
    memcpy(p, pr->id, 15);
    snprintf((char *)p + 16, 100, "%s", pr->name);
    put32(p + 116, (uint32_t)pr->icon);
    put32(p + 120, pr->color);
    put32(p + 124, pr->color2);
    put32(p + 128, (uint32_t)pr->dark);
}

static void info_get(const unsigned char *p, struct mpnet_peer *o)
{
    memset(o, 0, sizeof *o);
    memcpy(o->code, p, 15);
    memcpy(o->name, p + 16, 99);
    o->icon = (int)get32(p + 116);
    if (o->icon < 0 || o->icon >= PROF_ICONS)
        o->icon = 0;
    o->color = get32(p + 120);
    o->color2 = get32(p + 124);
    o->dark = (int)get32(p + 128);
}

static const char *my_code(void)
{
    const struct profile *pr = prof_get();
    return pr ? pr->id : "";
}

/* Codes compare without the dashes and the case, so "abcd efgh ijkl" finds
 * ABCD-EFGH-IJKL. */
static int same_code(const char *a, const char *b)
{
    for (;;) {
        while (*a && !((*a >= '0' && *a <= '9') || (*a >= 'A' && *a <= 'Z')
                       || (*a >= 'a' && *a <= 'z')))
            a++;
        while (*b && !((*b >= '0' && *b <= '9') || (*b >= 'A' && *b <= 'Z')
                       || (*b >= 'a' && *b <= 'z')))
            b++;
        if (!*a || !*b)
            return !*a && !*b;
        if ((*a | 0x20) != (*b | 0x20))
            return 0;
        a++;
        b++;
    }
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------- connection */

static void reliable_reset(void)
{
    memset(g_out, 0, sizeof g_out);
    memset(g_in, 0, sizeof g_in);
    g_out_seq = 0;
    g_in_next = 0;
}

static void connect_to(const struct paddr *a, const unsigned char *info,
                       int server)
{
    g_peer_addr = *a;
    info_get(info, &g_peer);
    g_server = server;
    g_connected = 1;
    g_status = MPNET_CONNECTED;
    g_heard = g_keep_last = now_ms();
    g_want[0] = 0;
    reliable_reset();
    if (a->eos)
        printf("online: connected to %s (%s) over the internet, %s\n",
               g_peer.name, g_peer.code, server ? "hosting" : "joining");
    else
        printf("online: connected to %s (%s) at %s:%d, %s\n", g_peer.name,
               g_peer.code, inet_ntoa(a->in.sin_addr), ntohs(a->in.sin_port),
               server ? "hosting" : "joining");
}

/* The link went: as when GKSession reported the peer gone. */
static void link_lost(void)
{
    if (!g_connected)
        return;
    printf("online: the other player is gone\n");
    g_connected = 0;
    g_status = MPNET_LOST;
    disconnected();
    endMP();
}

/* ------------------------------------------------- session interface */

int mpnet_session_exists(void) { return g_session; }

void mpnet_session_create(void)
{
    /* UMK3_ONLINE_NOLAN=1: the internet alone (testing EOS on one PC) */
    const char *nolan = getenv("UMK3_ONLINE_NOLAN");
    int lan = !(nolan && nolan[0] == '1') && sock_open();

    mpeos_start();
    if (!lan && (mpeos_state() == MPEOS_OFF || mpeos_state() == MPEOS_FAILED))
        return;
    mpeos_advertise(my_code());
    g_session = 1;
    g_connected = 0;
    g_server = 0;
    g_want[0] = 0;
    if (g_status != MPNET_LOST)
        g_status = MPNET_IDLE;
}

void mpnet_session_destroy(void)
{
    if (g_connected) {
        unsigned char b[4];
        hdr(b, K_BYE);
        send_peer(b, 4);
        send_peer(b, 4);
    }
    g_connected = 0;
    g_session = 0;
    g_want[0] = 0;
    mpeos_unadvertise();
    sock_close();
}

int mpnet_connection_state(void) { return g_connected ? 2 : 0; }
int mpnet_session_state(void)    { return g_connected ? 2 : 0; }
int mpnet_am_server(void)        { return g_connected && g_server; }
int mpnet_is_working(void)       { return g_session && g_want[0] != 0; }
int mpnet_peer_count(void)       { return 0; }
int mpnet_internet(void)         { return mpeos_state(); }

void mpnet_send(long type, const void *data, int len, int reliable)
{
    unsigned char b[MAX_PACKET];
    int n;

    if (!g_connected || len < 0 || len > MAX_PACKET - 12)
        return;
    if (!reliable) {
        hdr(b, K_DATA_U);
        b[4] = (unsigned char)(type >> 24); b[5] = (unsigned char)(type >> 16);
        b[6] = (unsigned char)(type >> 8);  b[7] = (unsigned char)type;
        memcpy(b + 8, data, (size_t)len);
        send_peer(b, len + 8);
        return;
    }
    {
        struct pend *p = &g_out[g_out_seq % WINDOW];
        if (p->used) {
            /* a whole window unacknowledged: the link is as good as gone */
            printf("online: send window full\n");
            return;
        }
        hdr(p->buf, K_DATA_R);
        put32(p->buf + 4, g_out_seq);
        p->buf[8] = (unsigned char)(type >> 24); p->buf[9] = (unsigned char)(type >> 16);
        p->buf[10] = (unsigned char)(type >> 8); p->buf[11] = (unsigned char)type;
        memcpy(p->buf + 12, data, (size_t)len);
        n = len + 12;
        p->len = n;
        p->seq = g_out_seq++;
        p->used = 1;
        p->sent = now_ms();
        send_peer(p->buf, n);
    }
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------- ONLINE screen */

void mpnet_find(const char *code)
{
    if (!g_session)
        mpnet_session_create();
    if (!g_session || g_connected)
        return;
    snprintf(g_want, sizeof g_want, "%s", code);
    g_eos_target[0] = 0;
    mpeos_lookup(code);
    g_find_start = now_ms();
    g_join_last = 0;
    g_status = MPNET_SEARCHING;
}

void mpnet_cancel_find(void)
{
    g_want[0] = 0;
    if (!g_connected)
        g_status = MPNET_IDLE;
}

int mpnet_status(void) { return g_status; }

const struct mpnet_peer *mpnet_peer(void)
{
    return g_peer.code[0] ? &g_peer : NULL;
}

static void send_join(void)
{
    unsigned char b[4 + 16 + INFO_BYTES];
    struct sockaddr_in a;
    struct paddr e;
    int i;

    hdr(b, K_JOIN);
    memset(b + 4, 0, 16);
    memcpy(b + 4, g_want, strlen(g_want) < 15 ? strlen(g_want) : 15);
    info_put(b + 20);
    memset(&a, 0, sizeof a);
    a.sin_family = AF_INET;
    for (i = 0; i < PORT_COUNT; i++) {
        if (PORT_FIRST + i == g_port)
            continue;
        a.sin_port = htons((unsigned short)(PORT_FIRST + i));
        a.sin_addr.s_addr = htonl(INADDR_LOOPBACK);
        send_in(&a, b, sizeof b);
        a.sin_addr.s_addr = htonl(INADDR_BROADCAST);
        send_in(&a, b, sizeof b);
    }
    if (g_eos_target[0]) {
        memset(&e, 0, sizeof e);
        e.eos = 1;
        snprintf(e.who, sizeof e.who, "%s", g_eos_target);
        send_to(&e, b, sizeof b);
    }
}

/* -------------------------------------------------------------- poll */

static int from_peer(const struct paddr *a)
{
    if (!g_connected || a->eos != g_peer_addr.eos)
        return 0;
    if (a->eos)
        return !strcmp(a->who, g_peer_addr.who);
    return a->in.sin_addr.s_addr == g_peer_addr.in.sin_addr.s_addr
           && a->in.sin_port == g_peer_addr.in.sin_port;
}

static void deliver(const unsigned char *p, int n)
{
    long type = (long)((uint32_t)p[0] << 24 | p[1] << 16 | p[2] << 8 | p[3]);
    processPacket(p + 4, n - 4, type);
}

static void on_packet(const unsigned char *b, int n, const struct paddr *a)
{
    if (n < 4 || b[0] != 'U' || b[1] != '3')
        return;
    switch (b[2]) {
    case K_JOIN: {
        unsigned char r[4 + INFO_BYTES];
        char want[16];

        if (n < 4 + 16 + INFO_BYTES || !g_session)
            return;
        memcpy(want, b + 4, 15);
        want[15] = 0;
        if (!same_code(want, my_code()))
            return;
        {
            char theirs[16];
            memcpy(theirs, b + 20, 15);
            theirs[15] = 0;
            if (g_connected && !from_peer(a)) {
                /* the same player again by another route (the join goes
                 * to localhost and to the broadcast address) is not busy */
                if (!same_code(theirs, g_peer.code)) {
                    hdr(r, K_BUSY);
                    send_to(a, r, 4);
                }
                return;
            }
        }
        if (!g_connected) {
            char theirs[16];
            memcpy(theirs, b + 20, 15);
            theirs[15] = 0;
            /* both asked for each other at once: the lower code hosts,
             * the other waits for its ACCEPT */
            if (g_want[0] && same_code(g_want, theirs)
                && strcmp(my_code(), theirs) > 0)
                return;
            connect_to(a, b + 20, 1);
        }
        hdr(r, K_ACCEPT);
        info_put(r + 4);
        send_to(a, r, sizeof r);
        break;
    }
    case K_ACCEPT:
        if (n < 4 + INFO_BYTES || g_connected || !g_want[0])
            return;
        {
            struct mpnet_peer t;
            info_get(b + 4, &t);
            if (!same_code(t.code, g_want))
                return;
        }
        connect_to(a, b + 4, 0);
        break;
    case K_BUSY:
        if (!g_connected && g_want[0]) {
            g_want[0] = 0;
            g_status = MPNET_BUSY;
        }
        break;
    case K_DATA_U:
        if (from_peer(a) && n >= 8) {
            g_heard = now_ms();
            deliver(b + 4, n - 4);
        }
        break;
    case K_DATA_R: {
        uint32_t seq;
        unsigned char ack[8];

        if (!from_peer(a) || n < 12)
            return;
        g_heard = now_ms();
        seq = get32(b + 4);
        hdr(ack, K_ACK);
        put32(ack + 4, seq);
        send_peer(ack, 8);
        if ((int32_t)(seq - g_in_next) < 0 || seq - g_in_next >= WINDOW)
            return;                     /* a copy, or too far ahead */
        if (seq != g_in_next) {
            struct held *h = &g_in[seq % WINDOW];
            h->used = 1;
            h->seq = seq;
            h->len = n - 8;
            memcpy(h->buf, b + 8, (size_t)(n - 8));
            return;
        }
        g_in_next++;
        deliver(b + 8, n - 8);
        /* and whatever was waiting behind it */
        while (g_connected) {
            struct held *h = &g_in[g_in_next % WINDOW];
            if (!h->used || h->seq != g_in_next)
                break;
            h->used = 0;
            g_in_next++;
            deliver(h->buf, h->len);
        }
        break;
    }
    case K_ACK:
        if (from_peer(a) && n >= 8) {
            uint32_t seq = get32(b + 4);
            struct pend *p = &g_out[seq % WINDOW];
            g_heard = now_ms();
            if (p->used && p->seq == seq)
                p->used = 0;
        }
        break;
    case K_BYE:
        if (from_peer(a))
            link_lost();
        break;
    case K_KEEP:
        if (from_peer(a))
            g_heard = now_ms();
        break;
    }
}

void mpnet_poll(void)
{
    unsigned char b[MAX_PACKET + 16];
    struct paddr a;
    unsigned t;
    int n, i;

    mpeos_tick();
    if (!g_session)
        return;
    memset(&a, 0, sizeof a);
    while (g_sock != INVALID_SOCKET) {
        socklen_t al = sizeof a.in;
        n = (int)recvfrom(g_sock, (char *)b, sizeof b, 0, (struct sockaddr *)&a.in, &al);
        if (n <= 0)
            break;
        on_packet(b, n, &a);
        if (!g_session)                 /* the packet ended the session */
            return;
    }
    for (;;) {
        struct paddr e;
        memset(&e, 0, sizeof e);
        e.eos = 1;
        n = mpeos_recv(e.who, sizeof e.who, b, sizeof b);
        if (n == 0)
            break;
        if (n > 0)
            on_packet(b, n, &e);
        if (!g_session)
            return;
    }
    t = now_ms();
    if (!g_connected && g_want[0] && !g_eos_target[0]
        && mpeos_lookup_result(g_eos_target, sizeof g_eos_target) == 1)
        g_join_last = 0;                /* found over the internet: ask now */
    if (!g_connected && g_want[0]) {
        if (t - g_find_start > (g_eos_target[0] ? FIND_EOS_MS : FIND_MS)) {
            g_want[0] = 0;
            g_status = MPNET_NOT_FOUND;
        } else if (!g_join_last || t - g_join_last > JOIN_MS) {
            g_join_last = t;
            send_join();
        }
    }
    if (!g_connected)
        return;
    for (i = 0; i < WINDOW; i++) {
        struct pend *p = &g_out[i];
        if (p->used && t - p->sent > RESEND_MS) {
            p->sent = t;
            send_peer(p->buf, p->len);
        }
    }
    if (t - g_keep_last > KEEP_MS) {
        unsigned char k[4];
        g_keep_last = t;
        hdr(k, K_KEEP);
        send_peer(k, 4);
    }
    if (t - g_heard > LINK_LOST_MS)
        link_lost();
}
```

```h
/* mp_net.h -- the network session under limeMPGameSpecific.c. Port, not in
 * the binary: the iPhone game ran its multiplayer over GKSession (Bluetooth,
 * the limeMPSession class); this is what takes that class's place, so the
 * game's own packet code (decomp/gamecode/limeMPGameSpecific.c) runs over a
 * PC network. See mp_net.c. */
#ifndef UMK3_MP_NET_H
#define UMK3_MP_NET_H

/* ---- what limeMPGameSpecific.m asked of limeMPSession ---- */

int  mpnet_session_exists(void);        /* gSession != nil */
void mpnet_session_create(void);        /* alloc, init, mpSetupSession */
void mpnet_session_destroy(void);       /* mpDestroySession, release */
int  mpnet_connection_state(void);      /* mpGetConnectionState: 2 = connected */
int  mpnet_session_state(void);         /* mpSessionState: 2 = connected */
int  mpnet_am_server(void);             /* mpAmIServer */
int  mpnet_is_working(void);            /* mpIsWorking */
/* mpSendPacket / mpSendPacketUnreliable: the 4-byte type goes first, big
 * endian, as the original put it on the wire. */
void mpnet_send(long type, const void *data, int len, int reliable);
/* the Bluetooth lobby's list (FE_Task_Multiplayer): always empty here */
int  mpnet_peer_count(void);

/* ---- the port's own: the ONLINE screen ---- */

/* The other player, from the handshake. */
struct mpnet_peer {
    char     code[16];                  /* XXXX-XXXX-XXXX, profiles.ini id */
    char     name[100];                 /* UTF-8 */
    int      icon;
    unsigned color, color2;
    int      dark;
};

enum { MPNET_IDLE, MPNET_SEARCHING, MPNET_NOT_FOUND, MPNET_CONNECTED,
       MPNET_LOST, MPNET_BUSY };

 * the ONLINE screen open). Whoever is found hosts the fight. */
```

`src/runtime/online_ui.c`:

```c
/*
 * online_ui.c -- the players' badges in an online match. Port, not in the
 * binary.
 *
 * game_main.c calls online_after_frame() over every finished frame, as it
 * does for the main menu's badge (settings_menu.c, set_menu_badge). A badge
 * is a profile's icon and name (debug_menu.c, ui_badge_at):
 *
 *   ONLINE screen (FE task 51)     this player's, on the left
 *   multiplayer select (FE 0x2a)   this player's top left, the other's top
 *                                  right (names only: the code stays private)
 *   versus screen (FE 0x2b) and    player 1's on the left, player 2's on the
 *   the fight (CurrentTask 6)      right; the host is player 1
 */

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "platform/platform.h"
#include "debug_menu.h"
#include "mp_net.h"
#include "online_ui.h"
#include "profiles.h"

extern int  CurrentTask;
extern int  FE_CurrentTask;
extern long GameMode;

#define ICON_PX 96

struct look { int icon; unsigned color, color2; int dark; };

/* The icon for a slot, made again only when the look changes. */
static const unsigned char *slot_icon(int slot, const struct look *l)
{
    static unsigned char *px[4];
    static struct look have[4];
    static int made[4];

    if (!made[slot] || memcmp(&have[slot], l, sizeof *l) != 0) {
        free(px[slot]);
        px[slot] = prof_icon_rgba(l->icon, l->color, l->dark, l->color2, ICON_PX);
        have[slot] = *l;
        made[slot] = 1;
    }
    return px[slot];
}

static unsigned key_of(const char *name, const struct look *l)
{
    unsigned k = 2166136261u;
    const unsigned char *p = (const unsigned char *)name;
    const unsigned char *b = (const unsigned char *)l;
    size_t i;

    for (; *p; p++)
        k = (k ^ *p) * 16777619u;
    for (i = 0; i < sizeof *l; i++)
        k = (k ^ b[i]) * 16777619u;
    return k;
}

static void badge(int slot, const char *name, const struct look *l,
                  float x, float y, int align, float size)
{
    const unsigned char *icon = slot_icon(slot, l);

    ui_badge_at(slot, name, icon, ICON_PX, key_of(name, l), x, y, align, size);
}

static void my_look(struct look *l)
{
    const struct profile *p = prof_get();

    memset(l, 0, sizeof *l);
    if (p) {
        l->icon = p->icon;
        l->color = p->color;
        l->color2 = p->color2;
        l->dark = p->dark;
    }
}

static void peer_look(const struct mpnet_peer *o, struct look *l)
{
    memset(l, 0, sizeof *l);
    l->icon = o->icon;
    l->color = o->color;
    l->color2 = o->color2;
    l->dark = o->dark;
}

void online_after_frame(void)
{
    const struct profile *me = prof_get();
    const struct mpnet_peer *o = mpnet_peer();
    struct look ml, ol;
    float w;

    if (!me)
        return;
    my_look(&ml);
    w = ui_space_width();

    if (CurrentTask == 3 && FE_CurrentTask == 51) {
        /* FrontEnd.c's box, in its 480-wide space centred on this one */
        extern const float PortOnlineBox[4];
        extern int PortOnlineBoxActive;
        float x0 = (w - 480.0f) * 0.5f;

        badge(0, me->name, &ml, w * 0.5f - 120.0f, 64.0f, 1, 1.5f);
        if (PortOnlineBoxActive)
            ui_rect_outline(x0 + PortOnlineBox[0], PortOnlineBox[1],
                            PortOnlineBox[2], PortOnlineBox[3], 2.0f,
                            1.0f, 0.85f, 0.2f, 1.0f);
        else
            ui_rect_outline(x0 + PortOnlineBox[0], PortOnlineBox[1],
                            PortOnlineBox[2], PortOnlineBox[3], 1.5f,
                            1.0f, 1.0f, 1.0f, 0.6f);
        return;
    }
    if (GameMode != 1 || !o || mpnet_connection_state() != 2)
        return;
    peer_look(o, &ol);

    if (CurrentTask == 3 && FE_CurrentTask == 0x2a) {
        badge(0, me->name, &ml, 4.0f, 6.0f, 0, 0.8f);
        badge(1, o->name, &ol, w - 4.0f, 6.0f, 2, 0.8f);
    } else if ((CurrentTask == 3 && FE_CurrentTask == 0x2b)
               || CurrentTask == 6) {
        /* the versus screen and the fight: player 1 (the host) left. In
         * the fight, above the life bars, beside the moves (i) and pause
         * buttons in the top corners, so they cover nothing. */
        int host = mpnet_am_server();
        int fight = CurrentTask == 6;
        float y = fight ? 2.0f : 6.0f;
        float k = fight ? 0.55f : 0.8f;
        float x = fight ? 26.0f : 4.0f;

        badge(2, host ? me->name : o->name, host ? &ml : &ol, x, y, 0, k);
        badge(3, host ? o->name : me->name, host ? &ol : &ml, w - x, y, 2, k);
    }
}
```

`src/runtime/pad_nav.c`:

```c
/* pad_nav.c -- the game's own menus with a pad. Port, not in the binary.
 *
 * The front end is made for a finger: every screen draws its buttons and
 * tests the touch against them in the same pass. Here those tests also say
 * where their buttons are (PortNavTarget, called from TouchAreaWH,
 * DrawButtonNew, BasicMenuMod, DrawOptionAsButton, the select screen's
 * portraits and the colour boxes in FrontEnd.c), and with that list:
 *
 *   - the d-pad or the left stick moves a highlight to the nearest button
 *     that way (held, it repeats);
 *   - the button under the highlight lights as it does under a resting
 *     finger (the touch is held there, never pressed nor lifted); what
 *     does not light so (the select screen's portraits) gets a frame;
 *   - the south button (A / cross) puts the finger down in its middle and
 *     lifts it when let go, so the button answers on the release, as it
 *     does to a finger;
 *   - the east button (B / circle) taps the screen's BACK, if it has one,
 *     or a page's own main menu entry, which closes it.
 *
 * A page that opens beside the main menu keeps the highlight on its own
 * buttons: the main menu's entries are its tabs, reached with BACK.
 *
 * The keyboard does the same: the arrows (or the movement keys) move,
 * Enter taps, Backspace is BACK.
 *
 * On the two-player select screen each player has a highlight: player one
 * the first pad and the keyboard, player two the second pad and player
 * two's keys (a punch accepts, block is BACK), and both choose at once.
 *
 * Nothing is moved like a mouse and the screens are not touched otherwise.
 * The highlight shows only while the pad is the last thing used; a click
 * hides it. On the front end and in the pause menu only -- in a fight the
 * pad is the fighter's. */
#include <math.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <stdlib.h>

#include "platform/platform.h"
#include "pad_nav.h"

#define MAX_T 128

typedef struct { float x, y, w, h; int kind; } NavT;

/* One player's highlight. */
typedef struct {
    float fx, fy;                       /* its middle, -1 for none yet */
    float hx, hy, hw, hh;               /* its box, last frame */
    int   kind;
    int   show;                         /* the pad or keys were used last */
    int   dev;                          /* 1 a pad, 2 the keyboard */
    unsigned was;
    int   kok_was, kback_was;
    int   dir_was, hold;
    int   held;                         /* south / east / Enter / Backspace down */
} NavC;

static NavT  g_t[MAX_T];                /* this frame's buttons */
static int   g_n;
static int   g_on;                      /* a screen the pad drives */
static int   g_dual;                    /* both players choose at once */
static NavC  g_c[2] = { { -1.0f, -1.0f }, { -1.0f, -1.0f } };
static NavT  g_tb;                     /* the page's own tab: its BACK */
static int   g_has_tb;

void PortNavTarget(float x, float y, float w, float h, int kind)
{
    int i;

    if (!g_on || w < 2.0f || h < 2.0f || g_n >= MAX_T)
        return;
    if (kind == NAV_TABBACK) {          /* not a stop, only east's */
        g_tb.x = x;
        g_tb.y = y;
        g_tb.w = w;
        g_tb.h = h;
        g_has_tb = 1;
        return;
    }
    for (i = 0; i < g_n; i++)           /* drawn twice in a frame: once */
        if (fabsf(g_t[i].x - x) < 1.0f && fabsf(g_t[i].y - y) < 1.0f
            && fabsf(g_t[i].w - w) < 1.0f && fabsf(g_t[i].h - h) < 1.0f)
            return;
    g_t[g_n].x = x;
    g_t[g_n].y = y;
    g_t[g_n].w = w;
    g_t[g_n].h = h;
    g_t[g_n].kind = kind;
    g_n++;
}

void PortNavDual(void)
{
    g_dual = 1;
}

void pad_nav_begin(int on)
{
    g_on = on;
    g_n = 0;
    g_has_tb = 0;
    g_dual = 0;
}

void pad_nav_hide(void)
{
    g_c[0].show = g_c[1].show = 0;
}

/* A page's tabs go when it has buttons of its own. */
static void drop_tabs(void)
{
    int i, j, own = 0;

    for (i = 0; i < g_n; i++)
        if (g_t[i].kind != NAV_TAB)
            own = 1;
    if (!own)
        return;
    for (i = j = 0; i < g_n; i++)
        if (g_t[i].kind != NAV_TAB)
            g_t[j++] = g_t[i];
    g_n = j;
}

/* The button the highlight was on: the one of its size nearest where it
 * was (a sliding panel moves it a little); -1 when the screen has changed
 * under it. */
static int same(const NavC *c)
{
    int i, best = -1;
    float bd = 1e30f;

    if (c->fx < 0.0f)
        return -1;
    for (i = 0; i < g_n; i++) {
        float cx = g_t[i].x + g_t[i].w * 0.5f, cy = g_t[i].y + g_t[i].h * 0.5f;
        float d = fabsf(cx - c->fx) + fabsf(cy - c->fy);

        if (fabsf(g_t[i].w - c->hw) > c->hw * 0.25f + 2.0f
            || fabsf(g_t[i].h - c->hh) > c->hh * 0.25f + 2.0f)
            continue;
        if (d < bd) {
            bd = d;
            best = i;
        }
    }
    return bd < 24.0f ? best : -1;
}

/* The nearest button from `from` in direction (dx, dy): along that way
 * counts once, sideways three times. -1 when there is none. */
static int step(int from, int dx, int dy)
{
    float fx = g_t[from].x + g_t[from].w * 0.5f, fy = g_t[from].y + g_t[from].h * 0.5f;
    float bd = 1e30f;
    int i, best = -1;

    for (i = 0; i < g_n; i++) {
        float cx = g_t[i].x + g_t[i].w * 0.5f, cy = g_t[i].y + g_t[i].h * 0.5f;
        float along = (cx - fx) * dx + (cy - fy) * dy;
        float side = fabsf((cx - fx) * dy) + fabsf((cy - fy) * dx);
        float d;

        if (i == from || along <= 1.0f)
            continue;
        d = along + side * 3.0f;
        if (d < bd) {
            bd = d;
            best = i;
        }
    }
    return best;
}

/* The first button a screen offers: the top-left one that is not BACK --
 * the top-right one for player two. */
static int first(int who)
{
    int i, best = -1;
    float bd = 1e30f;

    for (i = 0; i < g_n; i++) {
        float d = g_t[i].y * 4.0f + (who ? -g_t[i].x : g_t[i].x);

        if (g_t[i].kind == NAV_BACK)
            continue;
        if (d < bd) {
            bd = d;
            best = i;
        }
    }
    return best >= 0 ? best : (g_n ? 0 : -1);
}

/* One player's frame: moves the highlight, 1 with a tap's place when one is
 * due. */
static int run(NavC *c, int who, const PLAT_PAD *pa, const PLAT_PAD *pb,
               const struct nav_keys *k, float *tx, float *ty)
{
    unsigned now = (pa && pa->connected ? pa->buttons : 0)
                 | (pb && pb->connected ? pb->buttons : 0);
    unsigned hit = now & ~c->was;
    int up = (pa && pa->up) || (pb && pb->up);
    int down = (pa && pa->down) || (pb && pb->down);
    int left = (pa && pa->left) || (pb && pb->left);
    int right = (pa && pa->right) || (pb && pb->right);
    int dir = up ? 1 : down ? 2 : left ? 3 : right ? 4 : 0;
    int cur, i;
    int kok = k && k->ok && !c->kok_was, kback = k && k->back && !c->kback_was;

    if (dir || hit)
        c->dev = 1;
    c->kok_was = k && k->ok;
    c->kback_was = k && k->back;
    c->held = (now & ((1u << PB_SOUTH) | (1u << PB_EAST))) || (k && (k->ok || k->back));
    if (!dir && k && k->dir) {
        dir = k->dir;
        c->dev = 2;
    }
    if (kok || kback)
        c->dev = 2;
    if (kok)
        hit |= 1u << PB_SOUTH;          /* Enter is the south button */
    if (kback)
        hit |= 1u << PB_EAST;           /* Backspace the east */
    c->was = now;
    if (!g_on || g_n == 0) {
        c->dir_was = dir;
        return 0;
    }
    if (hit || dir)
        c->show = 1;

    cur = same(c);
    if (cur < 0)
        cur = first(who);

    /* a direction moves once, then again every 8 frames while held, after
     * 24 */
    if (dir && (dir != c->dir_was || (++c->hold >= 24 && c->hold % 8 == 0))) {
        int n;

        if (dir != c->dir_was)
            c->hold = 0;
        n = step(cur, dir == 3 ? -1 : dir == 4 ? 1 : 0, dir == 1 ? -1 : dir == 2 ? 1 : 0);
        if (n >= 0)
            cur = n;
    }
    if (!dir)
        c->hold = 0;
    c->dir_was = dir;

    c->fx = g_t[cur].x + g_t[cur].w * 0.5f;
    c->fy = g_t[cur].y + g_t[cur].h * 0.5f;
    c->hx = g_t[cur].x;
    c->hy = g_t[cur].y;
    c->hw = g_t[cur].w;
    c->hh = g_t[cur].h;
    c->kind = g_t[cur].kind;

    if (getenv("UMK3_LOG_NAV") && (hit || dir))
        printf("nav %d: %d targets, focus %.0f,%.0f %.0fx%.0f show %d\n", who,
               g_n, c->hx, c->hy, c->hw, c->hh, c->show);
    if (hit & (1u << PB_SOUTH)) {       /* the highlighted one */
        *tx = c->fx;
        *ty = c->fy;
        return 1;
    }
    if (hit & (1u << PB_EAST)) {        /* the screen's BACK */
        for (i = 0; i < g_n; i++)
            if (g_t[i].kind == NAV_BACK) {
                *tx = g_t[i].x + g_t[i].w * 0.5f;
                *ty = g_t[i].y + g_t[i].h * 0.5f;
                return 1;
            }
        if (g_has_tb) {                 /* or the page's own tab again */
            *tx = g_tb.x + g_tb.w * 0.5f;
            *ty = g_tb.y + g_tb.h * 0.5f;
            c->fx = *tx;                /* and the highlight lands on it */
            c->fy = *ty;
            c->hw = g_tb.w;
            c->hh = g_tb.h;
            return 1;
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

int pad_nav_end(const PLAT_PAD *p1, const PLAT_PAD *p2,
                const struct nav_keys *k1, const struct nav_keys *k2,
                float *tx, float *ty, int *who)
{
    float x2, y2;
    int t1, t2;

    drop_tabs();
    if (!g_dual) {                      /* one highlight, every input */
        struct nav_keys k = *k1;

        if (!k.dir)
            k.dir = k2->dir;
        k.ok |= k2->ok;
        k.back |= k2->back;
        g_c[1].show = 0;
        *who = 1;
        return run(&g_c[0], 0, p1, p2, &k, tx, ty);
    }
    t1 = run(&g_c[0], 0, p1, NULL, k1, tx, ty);
    t2 = run(&g_c[1], 1, p2, NULL, k2, &x2, &y2);
    *who = 1;
    if (!t1 && t2) {
        *tx = x2;
        *ty = y2;
        *who = 2;
    }
    return t1 || t2;
}

int pad_nav_held(int who)
{
    return g_c[who == 2 ? 1 : 0].held;
}

int pad_nav_hover(float *x, float *y)
{
    if (!g_on || !g_c[0].show || g_c[0].fx < 0.0f)
        return 0;
    *x = g_c[0].fx;
    *y = g_c[0].fy;
    return 1;
}

int pad_nav_focus(int who, float *x, float *y, float *w, float *h)
{
    const NavC *c = &g_c[who == 2 ? 1 : 0];

    if (!g_on || !c->show || g_n == 0 || c->fx < 0.0f || (who == 2 && !g_dual))
        return 0;
    if (c->kind != NAV_FRAME)
        return 0;
    *x = c->hx;
    *y = c->hy;
    *w = c->hw;
    *h = c->hh;
    return 1;
}

int pad_nav_back(float *x, float *y, float *w, float *h)
{
    int i;

    if (!g_on)
        return 0;
    for (i = 0; i < g_n; i++)
        if (g_t[i].kind == NAV_BACK) {
            *x = g_t[i].x;
            *y = g_t[i].y;
            *w = g_t[i].w;
            *h = g_t[i].h;
            return 1;
        }
    return 0;
}

int pad_nav_ok(float *x, float *y, float *w, float *h)
{
    int i;

    if (!g_on)
        return 0;
    for (i = 0; i < g_n; i++)
        if (g_t[i].kind == NAV_OK) {
            *x = g_t[i].x;
            *y = g_t[i].y;
            *w = g_t[i].w;
            *h = g_t[i].h;
            return 1;
        }
    return 0;
}

int pad_nav_on(void)
{
    return g_on && g_n > 0;
}

int pad_nav_device(void)
{
    return g_c[0].dev ? g_c[0].dev : 2;
}
```
