`src/runtime/rollback.c`:

```c
/*
 * rollback.c -- rollback netcode for ONLINE fights. A port feature, not in
 * the binary.
 *
 * The binary's network fight is host-authoritative: the host steps the
 * engine with both sticks and streams sprite lists, the guest only draws
 * them and feels the whole round trip on every press. Here both machines
 * run the fight -- the same frames from the same inputs -- and only the
 * inputs travel:
 *
 *   - Each frame, the local player's input (the stick and the seven buttons
 *     ReadControls produces, 11 bits) is taken for the frame RB_DELAY ahead
 *     and sent with every input the other side has not acknowledged.
 *   - A frame whose remote input has not arrived uses the last one that did.
 *     When the real one arrives and differs, the state goes back to the
 *     snapshot taken before that frame and the frames since run again,
 *     silent and undrawn, with what is now known.
 *   - A side more than RB_WINDOW frames past the last input it has, or ahead
 *     of the other on average, holds: it draws the next frame and puts the
 *     state back.
 *   - The fight ends (CurrentTask leaves 6) only on a frame both inputs of
 *     which are real.
 *   - Once a second each side sends a hash of a frame both have confirmed
 *     (rb_game_hash: sprites, health, positions); a mismatch is a desync and
 *     goes to the log.
 *
 * The snapshots are savestate.c's st_rb_*: the game's sections minus what
 * belongs to the machine (UMK3_NO_ROLLBACK files) and the 60 MB of loaded
 * characters, plus the arena pages written during the fight. GameCode.c does
 * the game's side: the frame wrapper, the inputs, the hash. Windows only, as
 * the save states are.
 *
 * Not a state file: what it keeps must survive the loads it does.
 */
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#ifdef _WIN32
#include <windows.h>
#endif

#include "savestate.h"
#include "mp_net.h"
#include "rollback.h"

/* the game's side */
long isParent(void);                    /* limeMPGameSpecific.c */
extern int CurrentTask;                 /* GameCode.c: 6 is the fight */
extern int Settings[10];                /* [4] the buttons, 4, 5 or 6 */
extern int32_t  rand_seed;              /* fight_runtime.c: limeRand's */
extern uint32_t umk3_rand_seed;         /* fight_runtime.c: the engine's */
uint16_t rb_game_local_input(void);     /* GameCode.c */
uint32_t rb_game_hash(void);            /* GameCode.c */
void     rb_game_buttons(int p1, int p2);   /* GameCode.c */

#define RB_VERSION      1
#define RB_DELAY        2               /* frames, UMK3_RB_DELAY 0..6 */
#define RB_WINDOW       8               /* frames ahead of the last input */
#define RB_SLOTS        (RB_WINDOW + 3) /* snapshots, the last for holds */
#define RB_RING         64              /* inputs and hashes, by frame */
#define RB_SEND_MAX     32              /* inputs in one packet */
#define RB_HASH_EVERY   60
#define RB_REPORT       600
#define RB_LINGER       180             /* frames of sending after a fight */
#define RB_FIGHT_TASK   6

#define NONE            0xffffffffu

static int g_on, g_started, g_me, g_delay = RB_DELAY;
static int g_quiet, g_nodraw;
static uint32_t g_frame;                /* the next frame to run */
static uint16_t g_in[2][RB_RING];       /* inputs by player and frame */
static uint16_t g_used[RB_RING];        /* the remote input a frame ran with */
static uint32_t g_local_upto;           /* local inputs known below this */
static uint32_t g_remote_upto;          /* remote inputs received below this */
static uint32_t g_acked;                /* the other side has ours below this */
static uint32_t g_rollback = NONE;      /* the first frame that ran on a wrong guess */
static int32_t  g_remote_frame, g_remote_adv;
static uint32_t g_last_hold;
static int      g_waiting;              /* the fight ended on a guess: hold */
static uint16_t g_cur[2];               /* the frame being run */
static int      g_linger;

/* hello: the other machine's buttons and its view of the fight's setup */
static int      g_hello, g_their_buttons;
static int32_t  g_setup[3], g_their_setup[3];

/* desync check */
static uint32_t g_hash[RB_RING], g_hash_frame[RB_RING];
static uint32_t g_next_hash = RB_HASH_EVERY;
static uint32_t g_their_hash_frame = NONE, g_their_hash;
static uint32_t g_my_hash_frame = NONE, g_my_hash;
static uint32_t g_desyncs;

/* numbers for the log */
static uint32_t g_rollbacks, g_resims, g_deepest, g_holds;
static double   g_save_ms, g_save_max;
static uint32_t g_saves;

/* --------------------------------------------------------------- helpers */

static double now_ms(void)
{
#ifdef _WIN32
    static LARGE_INTEGER f;
    LARGE_INTEGER c;

    if (!f.QuadPart)
        QueryPerformanceFrequency(&f);
    QueryPerformanceCounter(&c);
    return (double)c.QuadPart * 1000.0 / (double)f.QuadPart;
#else
    return 0.0;
#endif
}

static void put32(unsigned char *p, uint32_t v)
{
    p[0] = (unsigned char)v;
    p[1] = (unsigned char)(v >> 8);
    p[2] = (unsigned char)(v >> 16);
    p[3] = (unsigned char)(v >> 24);
}

static uint32_t get32(const unsigned char *p)
{
    return p[0] | (uint32_t)p[1] << 8 | (uint32_t)p[2] << 16
         | (uint32_t)p[3] << 24;
}

static int slot_of(uint32_t frame)
{
    return (int)(frame % (RB_SLOTS - 1));
}

static int save_slot(int slot)
{
    double t0 = now_ms(), t;
    int r = st_rb_save(slot);

    t = now_ms() - t0;
    g_saves++;
    g_save_ms += t;
    if (t > g_save_max)
        g_save_max = t;
    return r;
}

/* The remote input frame `f` runs with: the real one, or the last real one. */
static uint16_t remote_input(uint32_t f)
{
    int them = g_me ^ 1;

    if (f < g_remote_upto)
        return g_in[them][f % RB_RING];
    return g_remote_upto ? g_in[them][(g_remote_upto - 1) % RB_RING] : 0;
}

static void send_inputs(void)
{
    unsigned char b[20 + 2 * RB_SEND_MAX];
    uint32_t first = g_acked, n, i;

    if (g_local_upto > RB_SEND_MAX && first < g_local_upto - RB_SEND_MAX)
        first = g_local_upto - RB_SEND_MAX;
    if (first > g_local_upto)
        first = g_local_upto;
    n = g_local_upto - first;
    put32(b, first);
    put32(b + 4, n);
    put32(b + 8, g_frame);
    put32(b + 12, (uint32_t)((int32_t)g_frame - g_remote_frame));
    put32(b + 16, g_remote_upto);
    for (i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        uint16_t v = g_in[g_me][(first + i) % RB_RING];
        b[20 + 2 * i] = (unsigned char)v;
        b[21 + 2 * i] = (unsigned char)(v >> 8);
    }
    mpnet_send(RB_PKT_INPUT, b, (int)(20 + 2 * n), 0);
}

static void send_hello(void)
{
    unsigned char b[24];

    put32(b, RB_VERSION);
    put32(b + 4, (uint32_t)Settings[4]);
    put32(b + 8, (uint32_t)g_setup[0]);
    put32(b + 12, (uint32_t)g_setup[1]);
    put32(b + 16, (uint32_t)g_setup[2]);
    put32(b + 20, (uint32_t)g_me);
    mpnet_send(RB_PKT_HELLO, b, 24, 1);
}

static void report(void)
{
    printf("rollback: frame %u -- %u rollbacks, %u frames run again, deepest %u; "
           "%u holds; snapshot %.2f ms avg, %.2f max (%.1f MB); remote %d frames "
           "behind; desyncs %u\n",
           g_frame, g_rollbacks, g_resims, g_deepest, g_holds,
           g_saves ? g_save_ms / g_saves : 0.0, g_save_max,
           st_rb_size() / 1048576.0, (int)g_frame - g_remote_frame, g_desyncs);
    fflush(stdout);
    g_save_ms = g_save_max = 0;
    g_saves = 0;
}

/* -------------------------------------------------------------- desyncs */

static void compare_hashes(void)
{
    if (g_my_hash_frame == NONE || g_my_hash_frame != g_their_hash_frame)
        return;
    if (g_my_hash != g_their_hash) {
        g_desyncs++;
        printf("rollback: DESYNC at frame %u -- this side %08x, the other %08x\n",
               g_my_hash_frame, g_my_hash, g_their_hash);
        fflush(stdout);
    }
    g_my_hash_frame = NONE;
}

/* The hash of frame g_next_hash once both inputs of every frame up to it
 * are real and no rollback before it is pending: it will not change. */
static void send_hash(void)
{
    unsigned char b[8];
    uint32_t f = g_next_hash;

    if (f >= g_remote_upto || f >= g_frame || g_rollback <= f
        || g_hash_frame[f % RB_RING] != f)
        return;
    put32(b, f);
    put32(b + 4, g_hash[f % RB_RING]);
    mpnet_send(RB_PKT_HASH, b, 8, 1);
    g_my_hash_frame = f;
    g_my_hash = g_hash[f % RB_RING];
    g_next_hash += RB_HASH_EVERY;
    compare_hashes();
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------ the frames */

/* One run of the game's frame `f`. Returns 1 if the fight carried on. */
static int run(void (*frame)(void), uint32_t f)
{
    g_cur[g_me] = g_in[g_me][f % RB_RING];
    g_cur[g_me ^ 1] = remote_input(f);
    g_used[f % RB_RING] = g_cur[g_me ^ 1];
    frame();
    g_hash[f % RB_RING] = rb_game_hash();
    g_hash_frame[f % RB_RING] = f;
    return CurrentTask == RB_FIGHT_TASK;
}

/* Back to the frame that ran on a wrong guess, and forward again. */
static void roll_back(void (*frame)(void))
{
    uint32_t f = g_rollback, depth = g_frame - g_rollback;

    g_rollback = NONE;
    if (depth >= RB_SLOTS - 1 || st_rb_load(slot_of(f)) != 0) {
        printf("rollback: cannot go back %u frames, from %u\n", depth, g_frame);
        return;
    }
    g_rollbacks++;
    g_resims += depth;
    if (depth > g_deepest)
        g_deepest = depth;

    g_quiet = g_nodraw = 1;
    for (; f < g_frame; f++) {
        if (f != g_frame - depth)
            save_slot(slot_of(f));
        if (!run(frame, f)) {
            if (f < g_remote_upto) {
                g_frame = f + 1;        /* it really ended there */
            } else {
                st_rb_load(slot_of(f));
                g_frame = f;
                g_waiting = 1;
            }
            break;
        }
    }
    g_quiet = g_nodraw = 0;
}

/* Draw the next frame without keeping it. */
static void hold(void (*frame)(void))
{
    g_holds++;
    save_slot(RB_SLOTS - 1);
    g_quiet = 1;
    run(frame, g_frame);
    g_quiet = 0;
    st_rb_load(RB_SLOTS - 1);
}

/* The loaded fighters: 60 MB a fight only reads, so no snapshot holds them
 * (gamecode_globals.c, 0x5f4 = PRELOAD_STRIDE). */
extern char PreloadedCharacters[41148][0x5f4];

static void start(void)
{
    int mine = Settings[4], theirs = g_their_buttons;

    g_started = 1;
    st_rb_skip(PreloadedCharacters, sizeof PreloadedCharacters);
    if (st_rb_begin(RB_SLOTS) != 0)
        printf("rollback: NO SNAPSHOTS -- save states are off in this build\n");
    rb_game_buttons(g_me ? theirs : mine, g_me ? mine : theirs);
    printf("rollback: the fight starts, this side is player %d, delay %d, "
           "buttons %d / %d\n", g_me + 1, g_delay,
           g_me ? theirs : mine, g_me ? mine : theirs);
    if (memcmp(g_setup, g_their_setup, sizeof g_setup))
        printf("rollback: THE SETUPS DIFFER -- here %d %d %d, there %d %d %d\n",
               (int)g_setup[0], (int)g_setup[1], (int)g_setup[2],
               (int)g_their_setup[0], (int)g_their_setup[1],
               (int)g_their_setup[2]);
    fflush(stdout);
}

void rb_frame(void (*frame)(void))
{
    int32_t adv;

    if (!g_on) {
        frame();
        return;
    }
    if (!g_started)
        start();

    if (g_rollback != NONE && g_rollback < g_frame)
        roll_back(frame);
    if (CurrentTask != RB_FIGHT_TASK)
        return;

    /* the fight ended on a guess: hold until the input comes */
    if (g_waiting) {
        if (g_frame >= g_remote_upto) {
            send_inputs();
            hold(frame);
            return;
        }
        g_waiting = 0;
    }

    /* too far past the other side's inputs, or ahead of it on average */
    adv = (int32_t)g_frame - g_remote_frame;
    if ((int32_t)(g_frame - g_remote_upto) + 1 >= RB_WINDOW
        || (adv - g_remote_adv >= 3 && g_frame - g_last_hold > 10)) {
        g_last_hold = g_frame;
        send_inputs();
        hold(frame);
        return;
    }

    /* this frame's input, for RB_DELAY frames on */
    g_in[g_me][(g_frame + g_delay) % RB_RING] = rb_game_local_input();
    g_local_upto = g_frame + g_delay + 1;
    send_inputs();

    save_slot(slot_of(g_frame));
    if (!run(frame, g_frame) && g_frame >= g_remote_upto) {
        /* the fight ended on a guess: not yet */
        st_rb_load(slot_of(g_frame));
        g_waiting = 1;
        return;
    }
    g_frame++;
    send_hash();
    if (g_frame % RB_REPORT == 0)
        report();
}

void rb_inputs(uint16_t *p1, uint16_t *p2)
{
    *p1 = g_cur[0];
    *p2 = g_cur[1];
}

/* -------------------------------------------------------------- packets */

static void got_inputs(const unsigned char *b, long len)
{
    uint32_t first, n, i, f;
    int them = g_me ^ 1;

    if (len < 20)
        return;
    first = get32(b);
    n = get32(b + 4);
    if (n > RB_SEND_MAX || len < (long)(20 + 2 * n))
        return;
    if ((int32_t)get32(b + 8) > g_remote_frame) {
        g_remote_frame = (int32_t)get32(b + 8);
        g_remote_adv = (int32_t)get32(b + 12);
    }
    if (get32(b + 16) > g_acked)
        g_acked = get32(b + 16);

    for (i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        uint16_t v = (uint16_t)(b[20 + 2 * i] | b[21 + 2 * i] << 8);

        f = first + i;
        if (f != g_remote_upto)
            continue;                   /* had it, or a gap: wait for a resend */
        g_in[them][f % RB_RING] = v;
        if (f < g_frame && g_used[f % RB_RING] != v && f < g_rollback)
            g_rollback = f;
        g_remote_upto++;
    }
}

void rb_net(long type, const void *data, long len)
{
    const unsigned char *b = (const unsigned char *)data;

    if (type == RB_PKT_HELLO && len >= 24) {
        if (get32(b) != RB_VERSION)
            printf("rollback: the other game's netcode is version %u, this is %u\n",
                   get32(b), RB_VERSION);
        g_their_buttons = (int)get32(b + 4);
        g_their_setup[0] = (int32_t)get32(b + 8);
        g_their_setup[1] = (int32_t)get32(b + 12);
        g_their_setup[2] = (int32_t)get32(b + 16);
        g_hello = 1;
        return;
    }
    if (!g_on)
        return;
    if (type == RB_PKT_INPUT) {
        if (g_started)
            got_inputs(b, len);
    } else if (type == RB_PKT_HASH && len >= 8) {
        g_their_hash_frame = get32(b);
        g_their_hash = get32(b + 4);
        compare_hashes();
    }
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------- the fight */

int rb_active(void) { return g_on; }
int rb_quiet(void)  { return g_quiet; }
int rb_nodraw(void) { return g_nodraw; }
int rb_ready(void)  { return !g_on || g_hello; }

/* One line of the numbers report() logs, for the debug menu's NET STATS
 * (game_main.c draws it); 0 when no rollback fight is on. */
int rb_stats(char *out, int n)
{
    if (!g_on)
        return 0;
    snprintf(out, (size_t)n, "ROLLBACK  FRAME %u  DELAY %d  REMOTE %+d  "
             "ROLLBACKS %u  DEEPEST %u  HOLDS %u  DESYNCS %u",
             g_frame, g_delay, (int)g_frame - g_remote_frame, g_rollbacks,
             g_deepest, g_holds, g_desyncs);
    return 1;
}

/* The guest's fight waits, before anything loads, for the host's hello and
 * takes the host's level: each side picked one of its own on the select
 * screen, and the host's word (sendLevelPacket) can come after the guest has
 * begun loading. 1 while waiting; gives up after ten seconds. */
int rb_host_level(long *level)
{
    static int waited;

    /* the classic netcode too: its guest drew a level it never loaded when
     * the host's arrived mid-fight (RenderLevelBG) */
    if (isParent())
        return 0;
    if (!g_hello && ++waited < 600)
        return 1;
    if (g_hello && *level != g_their_setup[2]) {
        printf("rollback: the host's level %d, not %ld\n",
               (int)g_their_setup[2], *level);
        *level = g_their_setup[2];
    } else if (!g_hello)
        printf("rollback: no hello from the host in ten seconds\n");
    waited = 0;
    return 0;
}

void rb_online_begin(int c1, int c2, int level)
{
    const char *e = getenv("UMK3_RB_DELAY");
    uint32_t seed;

    if (getenv("UMK3_NETCODE") && !strcmp(getenv("UMK3_NETCODE"), "classic")) {
        printf("rollback: off (UMK3_NETCODE=classic)\n");
        g_me = isParent() ? 0 : 1;      /* the hello still says the level */
        g_setup[0] = c1;
        g_setup[1] = c2;
        g_setup[2] = level;
        send_hello();
        return;
    }
    g_on = 1;
    g_started = 0;
    g_me = isParent() ? 0 : 1;
    g_delay = RB_DELAY;
    if (e && *e >= '0' && *e <= '6')
        g_delay = *e - '0';
    g_frame = 0;
    memset(g_in, 0, sizeof g_in);
    memset(g_used, 0, sizeof g_used);
    memset(g_hash_frame, 0xff, sizeof g_hash_frame);
    g_local_upto = g_remote_upto = (uint32_t)g_delay;   /* the first are 0 */
    g_acked = 0;
    g_rollback = NONE;
    g_remote_frame = 0;
    g_remote_adv = 0;
    g_last_hold = 0;
    g_waiting = 0;
    g_linger = 0;
    g_next_hash = RB_HASH_EVERY;
    g_my_hash_frame = g_their_hash_frame = NONE;
    g_desyncs = g_rollbacks = g_resims = g_deepest = g_holds = 0;

    /* both machines know the fighters and the level, so both seed the
     * engine's generators from them, before anything loads */
    g_setup[0] = c1;
    g_setup[1] = c2;
    g_setup[2] = level;
    seed = 0x9e3779b9u ^ (uint32_t)c1 * 0x85ebca6bu ^ (uint32_t)c2 * 0xc2b2ae35u
         ^ (uint32_t)level * 0x27d4eb2fu;
    umk3_rand_seed = seed;
    rand_seed = (int32_t)(seed >> 1);
    send_hello();
    printf("rollback: online fight, player %d, %d vs %d on %d\n", g_me + 1,
           c1, c2, level);
}

void rb_online_end(void)
{
    if (!g_on) {
        g_hello = 0;                    /* the classic netcode's */
        return;
    }
    if (g_started)
        report();
    st_rb_end();
    g_on = 0;
    g_started = 0;
    g_hello = 0;
    g_linger = RB_LINGER;
}

void rb_poll(void)
{
    if (g_linger > 0) {
        g_linger--;
        send_inputs();
    }
}

```

`src/runtime/rollback.h`:

```h
/* rollback.h -- rollback netcode for ONLINE fights. Port, not in the binary;
 * see rollback.c. */
#ifndef UMK3_ROLLBACK_H
#define UMK3_ROLLBACK_H

#include <stdint.h>

/* the packet types, after the binary's 1..14 (limeMPGameSpecific.c) */
#define RB_PKT_INPUT  20                /* unreliable, every frame */
#define RB_PKT_HELLO  21                /* reliable, once a fight */
#define RB_PKT_HASH   22                /* reliable, once a second */
#define PORT_PKT_PALETTE 23             /* reliable: a side's colour pick (FrontEnd.c) */

/* 1 from an online fight's Task_GameInit to its Task_GameDestroy: both
 * machines run the fight engine, from both players' inputs. */
int  rb_active(void);
/* 1 while a frame is run again after a rollback (or a stall): no sound. */
int  rb_quiet(void);
/* the rollback's numbers on one line, 0 when no rollback fight is on */
int  rb_stats(char *out, int n);
/* 1 while a frame is run again after a rollback: nothing drawn. */
int  rb_nodraw(void);

/* Task_GameInit, state 0, of an online fight: the two fighters and the
 * level, which also seed the two generators. */
int  rb_host_level(long *level);
void rb_online_begin(int c1, int c2, int level);
/* Task_GameDestroy */
void rb_online_end(void);
/* Task_MultiplayerSync: the other machine said hello, the fight may start. */
int  rb_ready(void);
/* Task_GameMain: runs `frame` -- the game's own frame -- once, or again from
 * a snapshot after a rollback, or holds it while the other side catches up. */
void rb_frame(void (*frame)(void));
/* Inside the frame: the two players' inputs for it (rb_game_* packing). */
void rb_inputs(uint16_t *p1, uint16_t *p2);
/* processPacket, types RB_PKT_* */
void rb_net(long type, const void *data, long len);
/* game_main.c, every frame: the last inputs go on being sent for a while
 * after a fight, so the other side can finish it. */
void rb_poll(void);

#endif

```

`src/runtime/rollback_probe.c`:

```c
/*
 * rollback_probe.c -- step 1 of rollback netcode for ONLINE: measure before
 * building. A port feature, not in the binary. Nothing here changes how a
 * fight plays; it only watches the fight step (UpdateArcadeCode's
 * mk3_update) and, when replaying, hands it recorded sticks.
 *
 * Three switches, read once, all off by default:
 *
 *   UMK3_ROLLBACK_PROBE=1   Windows: one tick in 30, which 4 KB pages of the
 *                           state it changed and how long a whole save takes;
 *                           every 300 ticks a sync test --
 *                           save, step, load, step the same tick again, and
 *                           the two results must be the same bytes. A summary
 *                           goes to the log every 600 ticks.
 *   UMK3_REPLAY_RECORD=f    the first fight after launch: its setup, every
 *                           tick's sticks and a hash of what the tick did, to
 *                           file f beside the exe.
 *   UMK3_REPLAY_PLAY=f      the first fight after launch runs file f's setup
 *                           and sticks, and compares each tick's hash with the
 *                           recorded one. A record from another build (32/64
 *                           bit, Windows/Linux) tells whether they agree.
 *   UMK3_REPLAY_PAGES=1     Windows, while recording or replaying: a hash of
 *                           every 4 KB page of the state every 120 ticks, to
 *                           f.rec64.pages / f.play64.pages, so a tool can name
 *                           the first variable two runs of one exe disagree on.
 *
 * Recording and replaying hold the frame step at 1 (limeBegin), so the
 * number of ticks in each frame does not depend on the clock.
 *
 * The hashes cross builds, so they read nothing that holds an address: the
 * fighters' sprite list without its links, the health, the event queue
 * (after the step), and the fighters' and camera's positions (at the end of
 * the tick, as floats, to see whether the float maths agrees).
 *
 * Not a state file: what it keeps must survive the loads it does.
 */
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#ifdef _WIN32
#include <windows.h>
#else
#include <time.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#endif

#include "savestate.h"

extern int32_t  rand_seed;              /* lime_menu.c: limeRand's */
extern uint32_t umk3_rand_seed;         /* fight_runtime.c: the engine's rand() */

#define RB_MAGIC      "UMK3RPL3"
#define RB_EVENT_WORDS 21               /* MKEventQueue: 0x54 bytes */
#define RB_SETUP_MAX  24
#define RB_SYNC_EVERY 300
#define RB_REPORT     600
#define RB_SAMPLE     30
#define RB_REGIONS    3
#define RB_PAGES_EVERY 120
#define RB_PARTS      7

static const char *const g_region_name[RB_REGIONS] = {
    ".umkstd", ".umkstb", "arena"
};

static int g_read;                      /* the switches were read */
static int g_probe;                     /* UMK3_ROLLBACK_PROBE */
static int g_mode;                      /* 0 off, 1 record, 2 replay */
static char g_file[1024];
static FILE *g_f;
static int g_active;                    /* a recorded / replayed fight is on */
static int g_done;                      /* the one fight is over */

static uint32_t g_tick;
static int32_t g_joy[2];
/* A tick's result in parts: hashes of the sprite list, the event queue and
 * the three positions, and the two healths as they are. */
static const char *const g_part_name[RB_PARTS] = {
    "sprites", "health 1", "health 2", "events", "P1 position",
    "P2 position", "camera"
};
static uint32_t g_part[RB_PARTS];       /* this tick's */
static uint32_t g_want[RB_PARTS];       /* replay: the recorded ones */
static uint32_t g_ev[RB_EVENT_WORDS];   /* the event queue as it is */
static uint32_t g_want_ev[RB_EVENT_WORDS];
static uint32_t g_bad[RB_PARTS], g_first[RB_PARTS];
static uint32_t g_bad_ticks;

static int g_pages_on;                  /* UMK3_REPLAY_PAGES */
static FILE *g_pf;

/* the probe's numbers since the last report, and for the whole fight */
static int g_have_prev;                 /* probe slot 0 holds the last tick */
static int g_trial;                     /* a sync test's trial step ran */
static uint64_t g_trial_hash;
static uint32_t g_ticks, g_saves, g_sync_runs, g_sync_bad;
static double g_save_ms, g_save_max, g_diff_ms;
static uint64_t g_pages, g_pages_max, g_region_pages[RB_REGIONS];
static uint8_t *g_ever[RB_REGIONS];     /* per page: ever changed in a tick */
static uint32_t g_ever_n[RB_REGIONS];

/* --------------------------------------------------------------- helpers */

static double now_ms(void)
{
#ifdef _WIN32
    static LARGE_INTEGER f;
    LARGE_INTEGER c;

    if (!f.QuadPart)
        QueryPerformanceFrequency(&f);
    QueryPerformanceCounter(&c);
    return (double)c.QuadPart * 1000.0 / (double)f.QuadPart;
#else
    struct timespec t;

    clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &t);
    return t.tv_sec * 1000.0 + t.tv_nsec / 1e6;
#endif
}

/* `name` in the exe's folder; a name with a slash is refused, as
 * UMK3_PROFILES does, so the game keeps to its own folder. */
static int beside_exe(const char *name, char *out, size_t n)
{
    char *sl;

    if (!name || !*name || strchr(name, '/') || strchr(name, '\\'))
        return 0;
#ifdef _WIN32
    if (!GetModuleFileNameA(NULL, out, (DWORD)n))
        return 0;
    sl = strrchr(out, '\\');
#else
    {
        ssize_t k = readlink("/proc/self/exe", out, n - 1);
        if (k <= 0)
            return 0;
        out[k] = 0;
    }
    sl = strrchr(out, '/');
#endif
    if (!sl || (size_t)(sl + 1 - out) + strlen(name) + 1 > n)
        return 0;
    strcpy(sl + 1, name);
    return 1;
}

static void replay_finish(const char *why);

static void at_exit(void)
{
    if (g_active)
        replay_finish("the game closed");
}

static void read_switches(void)
{
    const char *e;

    if (g_read)
        return;
    g_read = 1;
    atexit(at_exit);
    e = getenv("UMK3_ROLLBACK_PROBE");
    g_probe = e && *e && *e != '0';
    if (g_probe && !st_available()) {
        printf("rollback probe: save states are off in this build, "
               "no page or sync measurements\n");
        g_probe = 0;
    }
    e = getenv("UMK3_REPLAY_PAGES");
    g_pages_on = e && *e && *e != '0';
    if (beside_exe(getenv("UMK3_REPLAY_PLAY"), g_file, sizeof g_file))
        g_mode = 2;
    else if (beside_exe(getenv("UMK3_REPLAY_RECORD"), g_file, sizeof g_file))
        g_mode = 1;
    if (g_probe || g_mode)
        printf("rollback probe: %s%s%s\n", g_probe ? "measuring" : "",
               g_probe && g_mode ? ", " : "",
               g_mode == 1 ? "recording the first fight"
               : g_mode == 2 ? "replaying the first fight" : "");
}

static uint32_t fnv(const uint32_t *w, int n)
{
    uint32_t h = 0x811c9dc5u;
    int i;

    for (i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        h = (h ^ (w[i] & 0xff)) * 0x01000193u;
        h = (h ^ ((w[i] >> 8) & 0xff)) * 0x01000193u;
        h = (h ^ ((w[i] >> 16) & 0xff)) * 0x01000193u;
        h = (h ^ (w[i] >> 24)) * 0x01000193u;
    }
    return h;
}

static int wr32(uint32_t v)
{
    unsigned char b[4] = { (unsigned char)v, (unsigned char)(v >> 8),
                           (unsigned char)(v >> 16), (unsigned char)(v >> 24) };
    return fwrite(b, 1, 4, g_f) == 4;
}

static void wr32f(FILE *f, uint32_t v)
{
    unsigned char b[4] = { (unsigned char)v, (unsigned char)(v >> 8),
                           (unsigned char)(v >> 16), (unsigned char)(v >> 24) };
    fwrite(b, 1, 4, f);
}

static int rd32(uint32_t *v)
{
    unsigned char b[4];

    if (fread(b, 1, 4, g_f) != 4)
        return 0;
    *v = b[0] | (uint32_t)b[1] << 8 | (uint32_t)b[2] << 16 | (uint32_t)b[3] << 24;
    return 1;
}

static uint32_t build_bits(void)
{
#ifdef _WIN32
    return (sizeof(void *) == 8 ? 1u : 0u) | 2u;
#else
    return sizeof(void *) == 8 ? 1u : 0u;
#endif
}

static const char *build_name(uint32_t b)
{
    static const char *const n[4] = {
        "Linux 32-bit", "Linux 64-bit", "Windows 32-bit", "Windows 64-bit"
    };
    return n[b & 3];
}

static void replay_finish(const char *why)
{
    int i;

    if (g_mode == 2) {
        printf("replay: %s after %u ticks -- %s\n", why, g_tick,
               g_bad_ticks ? "it DIFFERS from the recording"
                           : "the same as the recording");
        for (i = 0; i < RB_PARTS; i++)
            if (g_bad[i])
                printf("replay:   %-11s differs in %u ticks, first %u\n",
                       g_part_name[i], g_bad[i], g_first[i]);
    } else if (g_mode == 1)
        printf("replay: recorded %u ticks to %s\n", g_tick, g_file);
    if (g_f)
        fclose(g_f);
    g_f = NULL;
    if (g_pf)
        fclose(g_pf);
    g_pf = NULL;
    g_active = 0;
    g_done = 1;
    fflush(stdout);
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------ the probe */

static void count_page(int r, uint32_t off, void *ctx)
{
    uint32_t pg = off >> 12;

    (void)ctx;
    g_region_pages[r]++;
    if (pg < g_ever_n[r])
        g_ever[r][pg] = 1;
}

/* Ranges of pages that ever changed, largest first, at most `max` lines. */
static void report_ranges(int max)
{
    struct { int r; uint32_t a, b; } top[64];
    int ntop = 0, r, i, j;

    if (max > 64)
        max = 64;
    for (r = 0; r < RB_REGIONS; r++) {
        uint32_t p = 0;

        while (p < g_ever_n[r]) {
            uint32_t q;

            if (!g_ever[r][p]) {
                p++;
                continue;
            }
            for (q = p; q < g_ever_n[r] && g_ever[r][q]; q++)
                ;
            /* keep the largest `max` */
            for (i = 0; i < ntop && top[i].b - top[i].a >= q - p; i++)
                ;
            if (i < max) {
                for (j = (ntop < max ? ntop : max - 1); j > i; j--)
                    top[j] = top[j - 1];
                top[i].r = r;
                top[i].a = p;
                top[i].b = q;
                if (ntop < max)
                    ntop++;
            }
            p = q;
        }
    }
    for (i = 0; i < ntop; i++)
        printf("rollback probe:   %-7s +0x%08x .. +0x%08x  %6.1f KB\n",
               g_region_name[top[i].r], top[i].a << 12, top[i].b << 12,
               (top[i].b - top[i].a) * 4.0);
}

static void report(void)
{
    unsigned long sz[RB_REGIONS];
    uint32_t ever[RB_REGIONS] = { 0, 0, 0 };
    int r;
    uint32_t p;

    for (r = 0; r < RB_REGIONS; r++) {
        sz[r] = st_probe_region_size(r);
        for (p = 0; p < g_ever_n[r]; p++)
            ever[r] += g_ever[r][p];
    }
    printf("rollback probe: tick %u -- state %.1f MB (.umkstd %.2f, .umkstb %.2f, "
           "arena %.2f)\n", g_tick,
           (sz[0] + sz[1] + sz[2]) / 1048576.0, sz[0] / 1048576.0,
           sz[1] / 1048576.0, sz[2] / 1048576.0);
    if (g_ticks)
        printf("rollback probe:   whole save %.2f ms avg, %.2f max; page compare "
               "%.2f ms avg (%u samples)\n"
               "rollback probe:   pages changed in a tick %.1f avg (%.1f KB), %llu max"
               " -- .umkstd %.1f, .umkstb %.1f, arena %.1f\n",
               g_saves ? g_save_ms / g_saves : 0.0, g_save_max,
               g_diff_ms / g_ticks, g_ticks,
               (double)g_pages / g_ticks, g_pages * 4.0 / g_ticks,
               (unsigned long long)g_pages_max,
               (double)g_region_pages[0] / g_ticks,
               (double)g_region_pages[1] / g_ticks,
               (double)g_region_pages[2] / g_ticks);
    printf("rollback probe:   pages ever changed: .umkstd %u, .umkstb %u, arena %u"
           " (%.1f KB in all)\n", ever[0], ever[1], ever[2],
           (ever[0] + ever[1] + ever[2]) * 4.0);
    printf("rollback probe:   sync tests %u, failed %u\n", g_sync_runs, g_sync_bad);
    report_ranges(24);
    fflush(stdout);
    g_ticks = g_saves = 0;
    g_save_ms = g_save_max = g_diff_ms = 0;
    g_pages = g_pages_max = 0;
    memset(g_region_pages, 0, sizeof g_region_pages);
}

static void grow_ever(void)
{
    int r;

    for (r = 0; r < RB_REGIONS; r++) {
        uint32_t n = (uint32_t)((st_probe_region_size(r) + 4095) >> 12);

        if (n > g_ever_n[r]) {
            uint8_t *q = (uint8_t *)realloc(g_ever[r], n);
            if (!q)
                continue;
            memset(q + g_ever_n[r], 0, n - g_ever_n[r]);
            g_ever[r] = q;
            g_ever_n[r] = n;
        }
    }
}

static void print_page(int r, uint32_t off, void *ctx)
{
    int *left = (int *)ctx;

    if (*left > 0)
        printf("rollback probe:   differs: %s +0x%08x\n", g_region_name[r], off);
    (*left)--;
}

/* --------------------------------------------------------------- the API */

int rb_fixed_step(void)
{
    return g_active;
}

/* At Task_GameInit's start, before anything loads. `setup` is the fight's:
 * the two models, the level, the AI, the game mode, the settings. Recording
 * writes it; replaying puts the recorded one in and returns 1 (the caller
 * copies it back), and both seed the two generators the same. */
int rb_fight_setup(int32_t *setup, int n)
{
    uint32_t i, m, b, v;
    char magic[8];

    read_switches();
    if (g_active)
        replay_finish("a new fight began");
    if (!g_mode || g_done || n > RB_SETUP_MAX)
        return 0;

    g_tick = 0;
    if (g_pages_on && st_available()) {
        char pf[1100];

        snprintf(pf, sizeof pf, "%s.%s%d.pages", g_file,
                 g_mode == 1 ? "rec" : "play", sizeof(void *) == 8 ? 64 : 32);
        g_pf = fopen(pf, "wb");
        if (g_pf)
            printf("replay: page hashes every %d ticks to %s\n",
                   RB_PAGES_EVERY, pf);
    }
    if (g_mode == 1) {
        g_f = fopen(g_file, "wb");
        if (!g_f) {
            printf("replay: cannot write %s\n", g_file);
            g_done = 1;
            return 0;
        }
        fwrite(RB_MAGIC, 1, 8, g_f);
        wr32(build_bits());
        wr32((uint32_t)n);
        for (i = 0; i < (uint32_t)n; i++)
            wr32((uint32_t)setup[i]);
        wr32((uint32_t)rand_seed);
        wr32(umk3_rand_seed);
        printf("replay: recording to %s (%s)\n", g_file, build_name(build_bits()));
        g_active = 1;
        return 0;
    }

    g_f = fopen(g_file, "rb");
    if (!g_f || fread(magic, 1, 8, g_f) != 8 || memcmp(magic, RB_MAGIC, 8)
        || !rd32(&b) || !rd32(&m) || m != (uint32_t)n) {
        printf("replay: %s is missing or not a replay of this version\n", g_file);
        if (g_f)
            fclose(g_f);
        g_f = NULL;
        g_done = 1;
        return 0;
    }
    for (i = 0; i < m; i++) {
        rd32(&v);
        if ((int32_t)v != setup[i])
            printf("replay: setup word %u was %d, now %d -- using the recorded one\n",
                   i, (int)v, (int)setup[i]);
        setup[i] = (int32_t)v;
    }
    rd32(&v);
    rand_seed = (int32_t)v;
    rd32(&umk3_rand_seed);
    printf("replay: playing %s, recorded on %s, here %s\n", g_file,
           build_name(b), build_name(build_bits()));
    fflush(stdout);
    g_active = 1;
    return 1;
}

/* Before the tick's mk3_update. Replaying swaps in the recorded sticks.
 * Returns 1 when the sync test wants a trial step first: the caller steps,
 * calls rb_trial_done, and steps again for real. */
int rb_step_begin(int32_t joy[2])
{
    uint32_t a, b;

    read_switches();
    if (g_active && g_mode == 2) {
        int i, ok = rd32(&a) && rd32(&b);

        for (i = 0; ok && i < RB_PARTS; i++)
            ok = rd32(&g_want[i]);
        for (i = 0; ok && i < RB_EVENT_WORDS; i++)
            ok = rd32(&g_want_ev[i]);
        if (!ok)
            replay_finish("the recording ended");
        else {
            joy[0] = (int32_t)a;
            joy[1] = (int32_t)b;
        }
    }
    g_joy[0] = joy[0];
    g_joy[1] = joy[1];

    g_trial = 0;
    if (g_probe && g_tick % RB_SYNC_EVERY == RB_SYNC_EVERY - 1
        && st_probe_save(1) == 0) {
        g_trial = 1;
        return 1;
    }
    return 0;
}

/* After the trial step: keep its result, put the tick's start back. */
void rb_trial_done(void)
{
    g_trial_hash = st_probe_hash();
    st_probe_save(2);
    st_probe_load(1);
}

/* After the real step. `w` is the step's result in words that hold no
 * address (GameCode.c, rb_sim_words). */
void rb_step_end(const uint32_t *w, int n)
{
    /* GameCode.c's rb_sim_end: 24 words of sprites, the two healths, then
     * the event queue */
    g_part[0] = fnv(w, 24);
    g_part[1] = w[24];
    g_part[2] = w[25];
    g_part[3] = fnv(w + 26, n - 26);
    memset(g_ev, 0, sizeof g_ev);
    memcpy(g_ev, w + 26, sizeof(uint32_t) * (n - 26 < RB_EVENT_WORDS
                                             ? n - 26 : RB_EVENT_WORDS));

    if (g_trial) {
        g_sync_runs++;
        if (st_probe_hash() != g_trial_hash) {
            int left = 16;
            unsigned long k;

            g_sync_bad++;
            printf("rollback probe: SYNC TEST FAILED at tick %u: the same tick "
                   "stepped twice from the same state gave different memory\n",
                   g_tick);
            k = st_probe_diff(2, print_page, &left);
            printf("rollback probe:   %lu pages differ\n", k);
        }
    }

}

/* The page hashes of the whole state, for a tool to compare two runs of
 * one exe: the tick, then per region its page count and the hashes. */
static void write_pages(void)
{
    static uint64_t *h;
    static unsigned long cap;
    unsigned long n;
    int r;

    wr32f(g_pf, g_tick);
    for (r = 0; r < RB_REGIONS; r++) {
        n = (st_probe_region_size(r) + 4095) >> 12;
        if (n > cap) {
            uint64_t *q = (uint64_t *)realloc(h, n * sizeof *h);
            if (q) {
                h = q;
                cap = n;
            }
        }
        n = st_probe_page_hashes(r, h, n < cap ? n : cap);
        wr32f(g_pf, (uint32_t)n);
        fwrite(h, sizeof *h, n, g_pf);
    }
    fflush(g_pf);
}

/* At the end of the tick, after the camera. `w`: the fighters' and the
 * camera's positions, as the floats' bits. */
void rb_tick_end(const uint32_t *w, int n)
{
    int i, bad = 0;

    (void)n;
    g_part[4] = fnv(w, 3);
    g_part[5] = fnv(w + 3, 3);
    g_part[6] = fnv(w + 6, 3);

    if (g_active && g_mode == 1) {
        wr32((uint32_t)g_joy[0]);
        wr32((uint32_t)g_joy[1]);
        for (i = 0; i < RB_PARTS; i++)
            wr32(g_part[i]);
        for (i = 0; i < RB_EVENT_WORDS; i++)
            wr32(g_ev[i]);
    } else if (g_active && g_mode == 2) {
        for (i = 0; i < RB_PARTS; i++)
            if (g_part[i] != g_want[i]) {
                if (!g_bad[i])
                    g_first[i] = g_tick;
                g_bad[i]++;
                bad = 1;
            }
        if (bad && g_bad_ticks++ < 8) {
            printf("replay: tick %u DIFFERS (sticks %08x %08x):", g_tick,
                   (unsigned)g_joy[0], (unsigned)g_joy[1]);
            for (i = 0; i < RB_PARTS; i++)
                if (g_part[i] != g_want[i]) {
                    if (i == 1 || i == 2)
                        printf(" %s %d, recorded %d;", g_part_name[i],
                               (int)g_part[i], (int)g_want[i]);
                    else
                        printf(" %s;", g_part_name[i]);
                }
            printf("\n");
            /* the queue: a count, then ten records of two words */
            for (i = 0; i < RB_EVENT_WORDS; i++)
                if (g_ev[i] != g_want_ev[i]) {
                    if (i == 0)
                        printf("replay:   event count %u, recorded %u\n",
                               g_ev[0], g_want_ev[0]);
                    else
                        printf("replay:   event %d word %d: %08x, recorded %08x\n",
                               (i - 1) / 2, (i - 1) % 2, g_ev[i], g_want_ev[i]);
                }
            fflush(stdout);
        }
    }
    if (g_active && g_pf && g_tick % RB_PAGES_EVERY == 0)
        write_pages();

    if (g_active && g_mode == 1 && g_tick % 60 == 59)
        fflush(g_f);

    /* Every tick would cost two whole copies of the state: a sample, one
     * tick in RB_SAMPLE -- saved at its end, compared at the next one's. */
    if (g_probe) {
        double t0, t1;
        unsigned long k;

        if (g_tick % RB_SAMPLE == 0) {
            grow_ever();
            t0 = now_ms();
            g_have_prev = st_probe_save(0) == 0;
            t1 = now_ms();
            if (g_have_prev) {
                g_saves++;
                g_save_ms += t1 - t0;
                if (t1 - t0 > g_save_max)
                    g_save_max = t1 - t0;
            }
        } else if (g_tick % RB_SAMPLE == 1 && g_have_prev) {
            t0 = now_ms();
            k = st_probe_diff(0, count_page, NULL);
            t1 = now_ms();
            g_have_prev = 0;
            g_ticks++;
            g_pages += k;
            if (k > g_pages_max)
                g_pages_max = k;
            g_diff_ms += t1 - t0;
        }
        if (g_tick % RB_REPORT == RB_REPORT - 1)
            report();
    }
    g_tick++;
}

```

`src/runtime/savestate.c`:

```c
/*
 * savestate.c -- the game's own heap and the debug menu's save states. See
 * savestate.h for the idea. A port feature, not in the binary.
 *
 * The arena: one address range reserved at start (committed as it grows),
 * power-of-two size classes with a free list each, and every piece of
 * bookkeeping -- the top, the free lists -- in a header at its base. Blocks
 * never move and the arena never shrinks, so copying [base, top) and copying
 * it back is a whole, consistent heap at another moment.
 *
 * Not a state file itself: its own statics (the slots, how much is
 * committed) must survive a load.
 */
#include "savestate.h"

#undef malloc
#undef calloc
#undef realloc
#undef free

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdint.h>

#ifdef _WIN32
#include <windows.h>

/* The arena's address space, committed lazily: the largest of the sizes
 * in arena_init that fits (in the 64-bit build below 2 GB, beside
 * limeMalloc's region) */
static uint32_t g_reserve;
#define ST_RESERVE   g_reserve
#define ST_COMMIT    (4u << 20)         /* commit step */
#define ST_HDR       16u                /* per block, keeps 16-byte alignment */
#define ST_MIN_CLASS 4                  /* 16 bytes */
#define ST_CLASSES   25                 /* 2^4 .. 2^28 = 256 MB */
#define ST_MAGIC     0x5354u            /* "ST", in use */
#define ST_FREED     0x4652u            /* "FR", on a free list */

struct st_head {                        /* at the arena's base; in the state */
    uint32_t top;                       /* bytes used, from base */
    uint32_t free_list[ST_CLASSES];     /* offsets, 0 = empty */
};

struct st_block {                       /* ST_HDR bytes before each block */
    uint16_t magic;
    uint16_t cls;
    uint32_t next;                      /* while free: the next free offset */
    uint32_t pad[2];
};

static uint8_t *g_base;
static uint32_t g_committed;
static int      g_failed;               /* the arena ran out once: no states */

static struct st_head *head(void) { return (struct st_head *)g_base; }

#ifdef UMK3_LOW32
/* The 64-bit build: the game keeps its pointers in 32-bit words, and in
 * longs, which sign-extend, so its memory has to sit below 2 GB. Reserves
 * `size` bytes in the first free range there big enough; 0 if none.
 * Shared with limeMalloc's region (lime_platform.c). */
static void *reserve_low(size_t size, DWORD extra)
{
    MEMORY_BASIC_INFORMATION mi;
    uintptr_t q = 0x10000;

    while (q < 0x7FFF0000u && VirtualQuery((void *)q, &mi, sizeof mi)) {
        uintptr_t at = ((uintptr_t)mi.BaseAddress + 0xFFFF) & ~(uintptr_t)0xFFFF;
        uintptr_t end = (uintptr_t)mi.BaseAddress + mi.RegionSize;

        if (mi.State == MEM_FREE && at + size <= end && at + size <= 0x7FFF0000u) {
            void *p = VirtualAlloc((void *)at, size, MEM_RESERVE | extra,
                                   PAGE_READWRITE);
            if (p)
                return p;
        }
        q = end;
    }
    return 0;
}

void *umk3_reserve_low(size_t size)
{
    return reserve_low(size, 0);
}

/* A block below 2 GB that is never freed, outside every state: what the
 * game keeps in a 32-bit word and a save state must not take back (the
 * texture cache, draw_gl.c). The C library's heap lands anywhere in the
 * 64-bit space -- above 4 GB on some runs, as address randomisation has it. */
void *umk3_alloc_low(size_t n)
{
    static uint8_t *cur, *end;
    uint8_t *p;

    n = (n + 15) & ~(size_t)15;
    if (!cur || (size_t)(end - cur) < n) {
        size_t chunk = n > (16u << 20) ? n : (16u << 20);

        cur = (uint8_t *)reserve_low(chunk, 0);
        if (!cur || !VirtualAlloc(cur, chunk, MEM_COMMIT, PAGE_READWRITE)) {
            cur = end = NULL;
            return NULL;
        }
        end = cur + chunk;
    }
    p = cur;
    cur += n;
    return p;
}
#endif

static int arena_init(void)
{
    if (g_base)
        return 1;
    if (g_failed)
        return 0;
    {
        static const uint32_t sizes[] = { 1024u << 20, 896u << 20, 768u << 20,
                                           512u << 20, 384u << 20 };
        unsigned i;

        for (i = 0; !g_base && i < sizeof sizes / sizeof sizes[0]; i++) {
            g_reserve = sizes[i];
#ifdef UMK3_LOW32
            g_base = (uint8_t *)reserve_low(g_reserve, MEM_WRITE_WATCH);
#else
            g_base = (uint8_t *)VirtualAlloc(NULL, g_reserve,
                                             MEM_RESERVE | MEM_WRITE_WATCH,
                                             PAGE_READWRITE);
#endif
        }
        if (g_base)
            printf("savestate: arena of %u MB\n", g_reserve >> 20);
        else
            fprintf(stderr, "savestate: no room for the arena\n");
    }
    if (!g_base) {
        g_failed = 1;
        return 0;
    }
    if (!VirtualAlloc(g_base, ST_COMMIT, MEM_COMMIT, PAGE_READWRITE)) {
        g_failed = 1;
        return 0;
    }
    g_committed = ST_COMMIT;
    memset(g_base, 0, sizeof(struct st_head));
    head()->top = (sizeof(struct st_head) + 15u) & ~15u;
    return 1;
}

static int in_arena(const void *p)
{
    return g_base && (const uint8_t *)p >= g_base
        && (const uint8_t *)p < g_base + ST_RESERVE;
}

static int class_of(size_t n)
{
    int c = ST_MIN_CLASS;
    while (c < ST_MIN_CLASS + ST_CLASSES - 1 && ((size_t)1 << c) < n)
        c++;
    return ((size_t)1 << c) >= n ? c : -1;
}

void *st_malloc(size_t n)
{
    int c, i;
    uint32_t off, need;
    struct st_block *b;

    if (!arena_init())
        return malloc(n);
    c = class_of(n ? n : 1);
    if (c < 0)
        goto fallback;
    i = c - ST_MIN_CLASS;
    off = head()->free_list[i];
    if (off) {
        b = (struct st_block *)(g_base + off - ST_HDR);
        head()->free_list[i] = b->next;
        b->next = 0;
        b->magic = ST_MAGIC;
        return g_base + off;
    }
    need = ST_HDR + (1u << c);
    if ((uint64_t)head()->top + need > ST_RESERVE)
        goto fallback;
    while (head()->top + need > g_committed) {
        uint32_t step = ST_COMMIT;
        if (head()->top + need > g_committed + step)
            step = (head()->top + need - g_committed + ST_COMMIT - 1)
                   / ST_COMMIT * ST_COMMIT;
        if (!VirtualAlloc(g_base + g_committed, step, MEM_COMMIT,
                          PAGE_READWRITE))
            goto fallback;
        g_committed += step;
    }
    b = (struct st_block *)(g_base + head()->top);
    b->magic = ST_MAGIC;
    b->cls = (uint16_t)c;
    b->next = 0;
    head()->top += need;
    return (uint8_t *)b + ST_HDR;

fallback:
    if (!g_failed)
        fprintf(stderr, "savestate: arena full at %u bytes; save states off\n",
                head()->top);
    g_failed = 1;
    return malloc(n);
}

void *st_calloc(size_t n, size_t size)
{
    void *p;

    if (size && n > (size_t)-1 / size)
        return NULL;
    p = st_malloc(n * size);
    if (p)
        memset(p, 0, n * size);
    return p;
}

static size_t block_size(const void *p)
{
    const struct st_block *b =
        (const struct st_block *)((const uint8_t *)p - ST_HDR);
    return (size_t)1 << b->cls;
}

void st_free(void *p)
{
    struct st_block *b;
    int i;

    if (!p)
        return;
    if (!in_arena(p)) {
        free(p);
        return;
    }
    b = (struct st_block *)((uint8_t *)p - ST_HDR);
    if (b->magic != ST_MAGIC)
        return;                         /* not ours, or freed twice */
    b->magic = ST_FREED;
    i = b->cls - ST_MIN_CLASS;
    b->next = head()->free_list[i];
    head()->free_list[i] = (uint32_t)((uint8_t *)p - g_base);
}

void *st_realloc(void *p, size_t n)
{
    void *q;
    size_t old;

    if (!p)
        return st_malloc(n);
    if (!in_arena(p))
        return realloc(p, n);
    old = block_size(p);
    if (n <= old)
        return p;
    q = st_malloc(n);
    if (!q)
        return NULL;
    memcpy(q, p, old);
    st_free(p);
    return q;
}

void st_free_any(void *p)                  { st_free(p); }

void *st_realloc_any(void *p, size_t n)
{
    void *q;
    size_t old;

    if (!p || !in_arena(p))
        return realloc(p, n);
    old = block_size(p);                    /* from the arena: stays there */
    if (n <= old)
        return p;
    q = st_malloc(n);
    if (!q)
        return NULL;
    memcpy(q, p, old);
    st_free(p);
    return q;
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------ the states */

/* The exe's .umkstd and .umkstb, the game files' globals and statics, then
 * .umkntd and .umkntb, the ones a rollback leaves alone (UMK3_NO_ROLLBACK).
 * `max` 2 asks for the first two only. */
static int state_sections(uint8_t **p, uint32_t *n, int max)
{
    uint8_t *img = (uint8_t *)GetModuleHandleA(NULL);
    IMAGE_NT_HEADERS *nt =
        (IMAGE_NT_HEADERS *)(img + ((IMAGE_DOS_HEADER *)img)->e_lfanew);
    IMAGE_SECTION_HEADER *s;
    static const char *const name[4] = {
        ".umkstd", ".umkstb", ".umkntd", ".umkntb"
    };
    int i, j, k = 0;

    /* .umkstd first, whatever order the linker put them in */
    for (j = 0; j < 4 && k < max; j++) {
        s = IMAGE_FIRST_SECTION(nt);
        for (i = 0; i < nt->FileHeader.NumberOfSections; i++, s++)
            if (!memcmp(s->Name, name[j], 7)) {
                p[k] = img + s->VirtualAddress;
                n[k] = s->Misc.VirtualSize;
                k++;
                break;
            }
    }
    return k;
}

/* The menu's slots, then the rollback probe's own (rollback_probe.c). */
#define ST_PROBE_SLOTS 3

static struct {
    uint8_t *buf;
    uint32_t cap, used, arena;
} g_slot[ST_SLOTS + ST_PROBE_SLOTS];

/* The arena reserved now rather than at the first block: the 64-bit build
 * calls this first thing, before the graphics driver takes the low memory. */
void st_init(void)
{
#ifdef UMK3_LOW32
    umk3_alloc_low(0);                  /* the texture cache's first chunk */
#endif
    arena_init();
}

int st_available(void)
{
    uint8_t *p[2];
    uint32_t n[2];

    return g_base && !g_failed && state_sections(p, n, 2) == 2;
}

int st_has(int slot)
{
    return slot >= 0 && slot < ST_SLOTS && g_slot[slot].used != 0;
}

unsigned long st_size(int slot)
{
    return st_has(slot) ? g_slot[slot].used : 0;
}

static int save_slot(int slot, const char **why);
static int load_slot(int slot, const char **why);

int st_save(int slot, const char **why)
{
    *why = "";
    if (slot < 0 || slot >= ST_SLOTS)
        return *why = "no such slot", -1;
    return save_slot(slot, why);
}

int st_load(int slot, const char **why)
{
    *why = "";
    if (!st_has(slot))
        return *why = "that slot is empty", -1;
    return load_slot(slot, why);
}

static int save_slot(int slot, const char **why)
{
    uint8_t *p[4];
    uint32_t n[4], need, at;
    int k, i;

    if (!st_available())
        return *why = g_failed ? "the game's memory overflowed its arena"
                               : "this build has no state sections", -1;
    k = state_sections(p, n, 4);
    need = head()->top;
    for (i = 0; i < k; i++)
        need += n[i];
    if (g_slot[slot].cap < need) {
        if (g_slot[slot].buf)
            VirtualFree(g_slot[slot].buf, 0, MEM_RELEASE);
        g_slot[slot].buf = (uint8_t *)VirtualAlloc(NULL, need,
                                MEM_RESERVE | MEM_COMMIT, PAGE_READWRITE);
        g_slot[slot].cap = g_slot[slot].buf ? need : 0;
        g_slot[slot].used = 0;
        if (!g_slot[slot].buf)
            return *why = "not enough memory for the copy", -1;
    }
    at = 0;
    for (i = 0; i < k; i++) {
        memcpy(g_slot[slot].buf + at, p[i], n[i]);
        at += n[i];
    }
    memcpy(g_slot[slot].buf + at, g_base, head()->top);
    g_slot[slot].arena = head()->top;
    g_slot[slot].used = at + head()->top;
    return 0;
}

static int load_slot(int slot, const char **why)
{
    uint8_t *p[4];
    uint32_t n[4], at;
    int k, i;

    if (!g_slot[slot].used)
        return *why = "that slot is empty", -1;
    if (!st_available())
        return *why = "save states are off", -1;
    k = state_sections(p, n, 4);
    at = 0;
    for (i = 0; i < k; i++) {
        memcpy(p[i], g_slot[slot].buf + at, n[i]);
        at += n[i];
    }
    /* the arena only grows: what lies past the state's top is free space
     * for it now, and stays committed */
    memcpy(g_base, g_slot[slot].buf + at, g_slot[slot].arena);
    return 0;
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------ rollback's */

/* A rollback snapshot is .umkstd and .umkstb whole, and of the arena only
 * the pages written since st_rb_begin: GetWriteWatch names them, they join
 * `g_rb_track` for good, and a page a snapshot does not hold was not yet
 * written when it was taken, so the copy made at the start is its content. */
#define RB_PAGE 4096u

struct rb_slot {
    uint8_t  *sect;                     /* .umkstd then .umkstb */
    uint32_t *page;                     /* arena pages held, in order */
    uint8_t  *data;                     /* their contents */
    uint32_t  npages, cap, top;
    int       used;
};

static struct rb_slot *g_rb;
static int       g_rb_n;
static uint32_t  g_rb_sect;             /* bytes of the two sections */
static uint8_t  *g_rb_base;             /* the arena at st_rb_begin */
static uint32_t  g_rb_base_size;
static uint8_t  *g_rb_track;            /* per arena page: written since */
static uint32_t *g_rb_list;             /* the tracked pages, in order */
static uint32_t  g_rb_ntrack;

/* The pieces of the two sections a snapshot holds: all of them but the
 * range st_rb_skip names (the loaded fighters, which a fight only reads). */
static struct { uint8_t *p; uint32_t n; } g_rb_piece[3];
static int       g_rb_npieces;
static uint8_t  *g_rb_skip;
static uint32_t  g_rb_skip_n;

void st_rb_skip(const void *p, unsigned long n)
{
    g_rb_skip = (uint8_t *)p;
    g_rb_skip_n = (uint32_t)n;
}

static void rb_pieces(uint8_t *p[2], uint32_t sz[2])
{
    int i;

    g_rb_npieces = 0;
    g_rb_sect = 0;
    for (i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
        uint8_t *a = p[i], *e = p[i] + sz[i];
        uint8_t *sa = g_rb_skip, *se = g_rb_skip + g_rb_skip_n;

        if (g_rb_skip_n && sa >= a && se <= e) {
            if (sa > a) {
                g_rb_piece[g_rb_npieces].p = a;
                g_rb_piece[g_rb_npieces++].n = (uint32_t)(sa - a);
            }
            a = se;
        }
        if (e > a) {
            g_rb_piece[g_rb_npieces].p = a;
            g_rb_piece[g_rb_npieces++].n = (uint32_t)(e - a);
        }
    }
    for (i = 0; i < g_rb_npieces; i++)
        g_rb_sect += g_rb_piece[i].n;
}

static void rb_sect_copy(uint8_t *buf, int save)
{
    uint32_t at = 0;
    int i;

    for (i = 0; i < g_rb_npieces; i++) {
        if (save)
            memcpy(buf + at, g_rb_piece[i].p, g_rb_piece[i].n);
        else
            memcpy(g_rb_piece[i].p, buf + at, g_rb_piece[i].n);
        at += g_rb_piece[i].n;
    }
}

void st_rb_end(void)
{
    int i;

    for (i = 0; i < g_rb_n; i++) {
        VirtualFree(g_rb[i].sect, 0, MEM_RELEASE);
        free(g_rb[i].page);
        free(g_rb[i].data);
    }
    free(g_rb);
    g_rb = NULL;
    g_rb_n = 0;
    if (g_rb_base)
        VirtualFree(g_rb_base, 0, MEM_RELEASE);
    g_rb_base = NULL;
    free(g_rb_track);
    free(g_rb_list);
    g_rb_track = NULL;
    g_rb_list = NULL;
    g_rb_ntrack = 0;
}

int st_rb_begin(int n)
{
    uint8_t *p[2];
    uint32_t sz[2];
    int i;

    st_rb_end();
    if (!st_available() || state_sections(p, sz, 2) != 2 || n < 1)
        return -1;
    rb_pieces(p, sz);
    g_rb = (struct rb_slot *)calloc((size_t)n, sizeof *g_rb);
    g_rb_track = (uint8_t *)calloc(ST_RESERVE / RB_PAGE, 1);
    g_rb_list = (uint32_t *)malloc(ST_RESERVE / RB_PAGE * sizeof *g_rb_list);
    g_rb_base_size = g_committed;
    g_rb_base = (uint8_t *)VirtualAlloc(NULL, g_rb_base_size,
                                        MEM_RESERVE | MEM_COMMIT, PAGE_READWRITE);
    if (!g_rb || !g_rb_track || !g_rb_list || !g_rb_base)
        return st_rb_end(), -1;
    g_rb_n = n;
    for (i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        g_rb[i].sect = (uint8_t *)VirtualAlloc(NULL, g_rb_sect,
                                MEM_RESERVE | MEM_COMMIT, PAGE_READWRITE);
        if (!g_rb[i].sect)
            return st_rb_end(), -1;
    }
    memcpy(g_rb_base, g_base, g_rb_base_size);
    ResetWriteWatch(g_base, ST_RESERVE);
    return 0;
}

int st_rb_running(void) { return g_rb_n > 0; }
int st_owns(const void *p) { return in_arena(p); }

unsigned long st_rb_size(void)
{
    return g_rb_sect + g_rb_ntrack * RB_PAGE;
}

/* The arena pages written since the last call join the tracked ones. */
static void rb_watch(void)
{
    static void *hit[4096];
    ULONG_PTR count;
    DWORD gran;
    ULONG_PTR i;

    do {
        count = sizeof hit / sizeof hit[0];
        if (GetWriteWatch(WRITE_WATCH_FLAG_RESET, g_base, ST_RESERVE, hit,
                          &count, &gran) != 0)
            return;
        for (i = 0; i < count; i++) {
            uint32_t pg = (uint32_t)(((uint8_t *)hit[i] - g_base) / RB_PAGE);

            if (!g_rb_track[pg]) {
                g_rb_track[pg] = 1;
                g_rb_list[g_rb_ntrack++] = pg;
            }
        }
    } while (count == sizeof hit / sizeof hit[0]);
}

int st_rb_save(int slot)
{
    struct rb_slot *s;
    uint8_t *p[2];
    uint32_t sz[2], i;

    if (slot < 0 || slot >= g_rb_n || state_sections(p, sz, 2) != 2)
        return -1;
    s = &g_rb[slot];
    rb_sect_copy(s->sect, 1);

    rb_watch();
    if (g_rb_ntrack > s->cap) {
        uint32_t cap = g_rb_ntrack + 64;
        uint32_t *pg = (uint32_t *)realloc(s->page, cap * sizeof *pg);
        uint8_t *d;

        if (!pg)
            return -1;
        s->page = pg;
        d = (uint8_t *)realloc(s->data, (size_t)cap * RB_PAGE);
        if (!d)
            return -1;
        s->data = d;
        s->cap = cap;
    }
    for (i = 0; i < g_rb_ntrack; i++) {
        s->page[i] = g_rb_list[i];
        memcpy(s->data + (size_t)i * RB_PAGE, g_base + g_rb_list[i] * RB_PAGE,
               RB_PAGE);
    }
    s->npages = g_rb_ntrack;
    s->top = head()->top;
    s->used = 1;
    return 0;
}

int st_rb_load(int slot)
{
    struct rb_slot *s;
    uint8_t *p[2];
    uint32_t sz[2], i, pg;

    if (slot < 0 || slot >= g_rb_n || !g_rb[slot].used
        || state_sections(p, sz, 2) != 2)
        return -1;
    s = &g_rb[slot];
    rb_sect_copy(s->sect, 0);

    rb_watch();
    /* the slot's pages are the first s->npages of the list, in its order */
    for (i = 0; i < g_rb_ntrack; i++) {
        pg = g_rb_list[i];
        if (i < s->npages)
            memcpy(g_base + pg * RB_PAGE, s->data + (size_t)i * RB_PAGE, RB_PAGE);
        else if (pg * RB_PAGE < g_rb_base_size)
            memcpy(g_base + pg * RB_PAGE, g_rb_base + pg * RB_PAGE, RB_PAGE);
        else
            memset(g_base + pg * RB_PAGE, 0, RB_PAGE);
    }
    rb_watch();                         /* what the load itself wrote */
    return 0;
}

/* ------------------------------------------------- the rollback probe's */

int st_probe_save(int k)
{
    const char *why;
    return k >= 0 && k < ST_PROBE_SLOTS ? save_slot(ST_SLOTS + k, &why) : -1;
}

int st_probe_load(int k)
{
    const char *why;
    return k >= 0 && k < ST_PROBE_SLOTS ? load_slot(ST_SLOTS + k, &why) : -1;
}

/* Region r of the live state: 0 .umkstd, 1 .umkstb, 2 the arena up to its top. */
static int live_region(int r, const uint8_t **p, uint32_t *n)
{
    uint8_t *sp[2];
    uint32_t sn[2];

    if (!st_available())
        return 0;
    if (r == 2) {
        *p = g_base;
        *n = head()->top;
        return 1;
    }
    if (r < 0 || r > 2 || state_sections(sp, sn, 2) != 2)
        return 0;
    *p = sp[r];
    *n = sn[r];
    return 1;
}

unsigned long st_probe_region_size(int r)
{
    const uint8_t *p;
    uint32_t n;
    return live_region(r, &p, &n) ? n : 0;
}

/* Every 4 KB page of the live state that differs from probe slot k, by
 * region and offset; the arena's pages past the copy's top count as
 * different. Returns how many. */
unsigned long st_probe_diff(int k, void (*page)(int r, uint32_t off, void *ctx),
                            void *ctx)
{
    const uint8_t *p, *q;
    uint32_t n, have, off, len;
    unsigned long count = 0;
    int r;

    if (k < 0 || k >= ST_PROBE_SLOTS || !g_slot[ST_SLOTS + k].used)
        return 0;
    q = g_slot[ST_SLOTS + k].buf;
    for (r = 0; r < 3; r++) {
        if (!live_region(r, &p, &n))
            return count;
        have = r == 2 ? g_slot[ST_SLOTS + k].arena : n;
        for (off = 0; off < n; off += 4096) {
            len = n - off < 4096 ? n - off : 4096;
            if (off + len > have || memcmp(p + off, q + off, len)) {
                count++;
                if (page)
                    page(r, off, ctx);
            }
        }
        q += have;
    }
    return count;
}

/* A hash of each 4 KB page of live region r, at most `max`; how many. */
unsigned long st_probe_page_hashes(int r, uint64_t *out, unsigned long max)
{
    const uint8_t *p;
    uint32_t n, off, i, len;
    unsigned long k = 0;
    uint64_t h, w;

    if (!live_region(r, &p, &n))
        return 0;
    for (off = 0; off < n && k < max; off += 4096) {
        len = n - off < 4096 ? n - off : 4096;
        h = 0xcbf29ce484222325ull;
        for (i = 0; i + 8 <= len; i += 8) {
            memcpy(&w, p + off + i, 8);
            h = (h ^ w) * 0x100000001b3ull;
        }
        for (; i < len; i++)
            h = (h ^ p[off + i]) * 0x100000001b3ull;
        out[k++] = h;
    }
    return k;
}

/* A hash of the whole live state (one process only: it holds addresses). */
uint64_t st_probe_hash(void)
{
    uint64_t h = 0xcbf29ce484222325ull, w;
    const uint8_t *p;
    uint32_t n, i;
    int r;

    for (r = 0; r < 3; r++) {
        if (!live_region(r, &p, &n))
            break;
        for (i = 0; i + 8 <= n; i += 8) {
            memcpy(&w, p + i, 8);
            h = (h ^ w) * 0x100000001b3ull;
        }
        for (; i < n; i++)
            h = (h ^ p[i]) * 0x100000001b3ull;
    }
    return h;
}

#else   /* no arena elsewhere yet: the C library's heap, and no states */

void *st_malloc(size_t n)                 { return malloc(n); }
void *st_calloc(size_t n, size_t s)       { return calloc(n, s); }
void *st_realloc(void *p, size_t n)       { return realloc(p, n); }
void  st_free(void *p)                    { free(p); }
void *st_realloc_any(void *p, size_t n)   { return realloc(p, n); }
void  st_free_any(void *p)                { free(p); }
void  st_init(void)                       {}
int   st_available(void)                  { return 0; }
int   st_has(int slot)                    { (void)slot; return 0; }
unsigned long st_size(int slot)           { (void)slot; return 0; }
int   st_save(int slot, const char **why)
```

`src/runtime/savestate.h`:

```h
/*
 * savestate.h -- the debug menu's save states (a port feature, not in the
 * binary). Force-included into every file of umk3-game (-include).
 *
 * A save state is the game's whole memory at one tick: every global and
 * static of the game's own files, and every block those files allocated.
 * Loading copies both back -- the fight goes on from that exact tick, in the
 * same session, without reloading anything.
 *
 * So the game's memory has to be in two known places:
 *
 *   - Globals and statics of the game's files (decomp/, runtime/lime/, the
 *     runtime files that hold game state) are compiled with UMK3_STATE_FILE,
 *     which puts them in the sections .umkstd (initialised) and .umkstb
 *     (zeroed) of the exe.
 *   - Their malloc / calloc / realloc / free go to an arena of its own
 *     (savestate.c), whose bookkeeping lives inside it, so a copy of the
 *     arena is a consistent heap.
 *
 * Every other file (the platform, the debug menu, the main loop) keeps the
 * C library's heap, and its free / realloc check which heap a block came
 * from, because a buffer can cross over (a PNG decoded by runtime/lime and
 * freed by draw_gl.c).
 *
 * Textures are never deleted (draw_gl.c), and their cache lives outside the
 * arena, so a state keeps finding its textures. Sounds are part of the state.
 */
#ifndef UMK3_SAVESTATE_H
#define UMK3_SAVESTATE_H

/* the library's declarations first, so the macros below never rename them */
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <stddef.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#ifndef _WIN32
#include <strings.h>
#ifndef _stricmp
#define _stricmp strcasecmp
#endif
#ifndef _strnicmp
#define _strnicmp strncasecmp
#endif
#endif

void *st_malloc(size_t n);
void *st_calloc(size_t n, size_t size);
void *st_realloc(void *p, size_t n);
void  st_free(void *p);

#if defined(UMK3_LOW32) && defined(UMK3_STATE_FILE)
/* The 64-bit build (UMK3_LOW32): the game's words stay 32 bits, as on the
 * device. Its code spells a word holding an address uintptr_t; here that is
 * a uint32_t, which holds every address of the game, since the build keeps
 * the exe, its data and the game's heaps below 2 GB. The library's headers
 * come first, with the real type. */
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <math.h>
#include <time.h>
#include <ctype.h>
#include <stdarg.h>
#define uintptr_t uint32_t
#define intptr_t  int32_t
#endif

/* P32 marks a pointer the game keeps in a 32-bit word: a field of one of
 * its structures at the binary's layout, or a cast reading such a word
 * (`*(void *P32 *)(base + 0x10)`, `(char *P32 *)c`). In the 64-bit build it
 * is clang's 32-bit pointer (__ptr32, zero-extended), so the structures keep
 * the device's offsets and the code that indexes them by word still lands
 * on the right field; elsewhere it is nothing. Every file of that build
 * sees it, so a structure has one shape everywhere. mingw's headers define
 * __ptr32 away, hence the #undef. */
#if defined(UMK3_LOW32)
#undef __ptr32
#undef __uptr
#define P32 __ptr32 __uptr
#else
#define P32
#endif

/* A state file that holds the machine's side of the game -- the clock, the
 * sound table, the network session -- is UMK3_NO_ROLLBACK as well: a save
 * state keeps it (.umkntd, .umkntb), a rollback of the fight does not
 * (rollback.c). */
#ifdef UMK3_STATE_FILE
#ifdef _WIN32
#ifdef UMK3_NO_ROLLBACK
__asm__(".section .umkntb,\"bw\"");
#pragma data_seg(".umkntd")
#pragma bss_seg(".umkntb")
#else
__asm__(".section .umkstb,\"bw\"");
#pragma data_seg(".umkstd")
#pragma bss_seg(".umkstb")
#endif
#else
#pragma clang section data=".umkstd" bss=".umkstb"
#endif
#define malloc(n)      st_malloc(n)
#define calloc(n, s)   st_calloc(n, s)
#define realloc(p, n)  st_realloc(p, n)
#define free(p)        st_free(p)
#else
#define realloc(p, n)  st_realloc_any(p, n)
#define free(p)        st_free_any(p)
#endif

/* For the files outside the state: a block from either heap. */
void *st_realloc_any(void *p, size_t n);
void  st_free_any(void *p);

#define ST_SLOTS 4

/* 1 when save states can work (the arena is up and never overflowed). */
int  st_available(void);
int  st_has(int slot);
/* 0 on success; the reason in *why otherwise */
int  st_save(int slot, const char **why);
int  st_load(int slot, const char **why);
/* What a state holds, in bytes (for the menu and the log). */
unsigned long st_size(int slot);

/* The rollback probe's (rollback_probe.c): three slots of its own, the
 * live state's regions (0 .umkstd, 1 .umkstb, 2 the arena), the pages that
 * differ from one of its slots, and a hash of the live state. */
int  st_probe_save(int k);
int  st_probe_load(int k);
unsigned long st_probe_region_size(int r);
unsigned long st_probe_diff(int k, void (*page)(int r, uint32_t off, void *ctx),
                            void *ctx);
uint64_t st_probe_hash(void);
unsigned long st_probe_page_hashes(int r, uint64_t *out, unsigned long max);

/* Rollback netcode's snapshots (rollback.c): .umkstd and .umkstb only, and
 * of the arena the pages written since the fight began (a write watch),
 * against a copy taken then. st_rb_begin sizes `n` slots; 0 on success. */
int  st_rb_begin(int n);
int  st_rb_save(int slot);
int  st_rb_load(int slot);
void st_rb_end(void);
/* 1 between st_rb_begin and st_rb_end; st_owns says a block is the arena's.
 * limeMalloc (lime_platform.c) takes its blocks from the arena meanwhile. */
int  st_rb_running(void);
/* A range of the sections the snapshots leave out (set before st_rb_begin). */
void st_rb_skip(const void *p, unsigned long n);
int  st_owns(const void *p);
unsigned long st_rb_size(void);         /* bytes a snapshot copies */

/* Port, not in the binary: the C library's rand() for the game's files,
 * kept in the state so a load puts the sequence back and every build draws
 * the same numbers (fight_runtime.c). */
int umk3_rand(void);
#ifdef UMK3_STATE_FILE
#define rand umk3_rand
#endif

#if defined(UMK3_LOW32) && defined(UMK3_STATE_FILE) && !defined(_WIN32)
/*
 * Linux 64-bit (LP64) adaptation for 1:1 ARMv7 decompiled gamecode:
 * In ARMv7 iOS and Win32/Win64 (LLP64), sizeof(long) == 4.
 * On LP64 Linux, sizeof(long) == 8, which breaks 32-bit word offsets,
 * mesh loading, and binary file parsing.
 * Include POSIX and platform GL headers before remapping long to int.
 */
#include <sys/types.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <sys/mman.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include "platform/gl.h"
#ifndef UMK3_NO_LONG_REMAP
#define long int
#endif
#endif

#endif


```

`src/runtime/settings_menu.c`:

```c
/*
 * settings_menu.c -- the in-game settings menu (Esc). Port, not in the
 * binary: the iPhone game has no keyboard, no window and no launcher.
 *
 * What the launcher's GRAPHICS and CONTROLS sections set, changed while the
 * game runs, without starting it again. Esc (umk3.ini can rebind it as
 * key_settings=) opens it over the game, which freezes underneath as under
 * the debug menu (debug_menu.c, whose box it shares); Esc again, the pad's
 * east button (circle / B) or CLOSE closes it. Arrows or W/S move,
 * left/right change a value, Enter picks, Q / E or L1 / R1 change the tab;
 * the mouse works as in the debug menu, and its wheel moves the cursor (in
 * an open list too). Every change is written to umk3.ini
 * at once with the launcher's own names, so the launcher shows it (it reads
 * the ini again when it comes to the front) and the next start keeps it;
 * the ini's other lines are kept as they were.
 *
 *     GRAPHICS   DISPLAY (window, borderless, fullscreen) and RESOLUTION,
 *                both taken by APPLY DISPLAY; 3D RESOLUTION, ANTIALIASING,
 *                RENDERER (OpenGL, Vulkan, DirectX 12: written for the
 *                next start, render/rgl.h), TEXTURES, ASPECT, LANGUAGE,
 *                INTERFACE and ON-SCREEN
 *                CONTROLS at once; LANGUAGE loads the game's texts again
 *                (port_language_set). TEXTURES loads every texture again at the new
 *                quality (draw_gl.c, lime_textures_requality).
 *     KEYBOARD   PLAYER 1 / 2, LAYOUT 6 / 5 buttons (buttons=), then each
 *                key: Enter on it and press the new key (Esc cancels).
 *     GAMEPAD    PLAYER 1 / 2, the pad (AUTO, OFF, XINPUT, or the one the
 *                ini named), then each action's button: Enter on it and
 *                press the button on that player's pad (Esc cancels).
 *     PROFILE    the player's profile (profiles.c, shared with the
 *                launcher): the name (Enter, then type; Enter keeps it, Esc
 *                cancels), the icon (a fighter's bio art) and its colour,
 *                the installation's id, and RESET DATA (twice: the id
 *                stays). The icon shows above the box.
 *     Every tab ends in RESET (on KEYBOARD and GAMEPAD), CLOSE and
 *     QUIT GAME.

/* The colour grid, the launcher's picker in the game: 15 hues across, a
 * grey column, seven shades from light to dark -- any colour, not only the
 * named ones. */
#define PAL_COLS 16
#define PAL_ROWS 7
static unsigned g_pal[PAL_COLS * PAL_ROWS];

static unsigned hsl(float h, float s, float l)
{
    float c = (1 - fabsf(2 * l - 1)) * s, x = c * (1 - fabsf(fmodf(h / 60.0f, 2) - 1));
    float m = l - c / 2, r = 0, g = 0, b = 0;

    if (h < 60)       { r = c; g = x; }
    else if (h < 120) { r = x; g = c; }
    else if (h < 180) { g = c; b = x; }
    else if (h < 240) { g = x; b = c; }
    else if (h < 300) { r = x; b = c; }
    else              { r = c; b = x; }
    return (unsigned)((r + m) * 255 + 0.5f) << 16 | (unsigned)((g + m) * 255 + 0.5f) << 8
         | (unsigned)((b + m) * 255 + 0.5f);
}

static void pal_make(void)
{
    static const float L[PAL_ROWS] = { 0.88f, 0.76f, 0.64f, 0.52f, 0.40f, 0.28f, 0.16f };
    static const unsigned grey[PAL_ROWS] = { 0xFFFFFF, 0xD4D4D4, 0xAAAAAA, 0x808080,
                                             0x555555, 0x2B2B2B, 0x000000 };
    int r, c;

    for (r = 0; r < PAL_ROWS; r++) {
        for (c = 0; c < PAL_COLS - 1; c++)
            g_pal[r * PAL_COLS + c] = hsl(c * 24.0f, 0.85f, L[r]);
        g_pal[r * PAL_COLS + PAL_COLS - 1] = grey[r];
    }
}

    }

    g_want = 1;

    g_fsub = 0;

{

        return;
    g_want = 0;

    port_gfx_get(&g_gfx);
    g_disp_mode = g_gfx.mode;
    g_disp_w = g_gfx.w;
    g_disp_h = g_gfx.h;

    g_del_armed = 0;
    g_open = 1;

    g_esc_was = 1;                      /* the press that opened it */

}

 * keyboard (and mouse), 1 player one's pad, 2 player two's. */

static int pad_busy(const PLAT_PAD *p)
{
    return p->connected && (p->buttons || p->up || p->down || p->left || p->right);
}

void set_menu_pads(const PLAT_PAD *p1, const PLAT_PAD *p2)
{
    if (pad_busy(p1))
        g_using = 1;
    else if (pad_busy(p2))
        g_using = 2;
    else if (plat_key_any() || (g_using == 1 && !p1->connected)
             || (g_using == 2 && !p2->connected))
        g_using = 0;
    g_pad[0] = *p1;
    g_pad[1] = *p2;
}
```
